nga'i mi tshe dmyal se'i nang metso sbyang rtsung ba/rtsom pa po/ spel gong zlo mezang yon tan/'odadudagu 'a'i nyer bdun gyilga rgol mdzadanasayo gi thu dbor bar dranagatshushu/bod kyi dgu mecu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa/

7blo6 04khul cholalo'༄༅༅// spel gong blo bzang sku na tan nas rgya mi gung khran gyi btsan dbang 'ab / btson khang dang / ngawa rtso pa ra bhe9shā nang zaring dang / rogs zla tshas gle nad gcod dka' sdug ji ltar myangs pa'i lo rgyus brisajipa 'di dag la rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams nas zhib 'jug thog gzhan dbang du tshud phyin bde skyid bag phebs sku1nga thabs bral ba'i gnas lugs thob tags thub pa'i ༄/ nas rang yul rang dbang du spyod thub pa'i don du lhag bsam khur btson che bskye da byed dbo/sa/rangarigs du ma zhig ges lo mang reng tshad med dka'asdug myangs pa la brten nas spyi snos dkar min las ngan gyi 'bras bu thams cad byang zhing dag/ pa dang / baṣka na srid rang rigaru 5 kye la rgya snying bcangs stseng/ po rnamyo4sku / 'phral yun tshe rabs kunatu bde gi sa bde bar bgrod thub pa'i smin 'dun bcas/tu la'e bla mas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags ci la zla 4 tshes 1༷lngi/tsho lo na(nyi01 zla snyo tsheos 1 0///mtshan bajiod 'di bstsal nas la snyo lhag 'das kyang / da bar deb 'don ma thub par lus shing da skabs deb dngos su 'don skabs mtshan brjod gsar zhu ma dgos par byas yad/

dkar chag7gang sa skyabs mgan chen po mchog nas bstsal ba'i ched brjod/par skrun gsal bshad/ gcigagleng bajiod/ lnga/ne tshan dang po/ nga'i khyem tshang gi la rgyus/ 1ye tshan gartswas pa/ gces par 'os pa'i pha yul lha sa/ snyole tshan gaskum pa/ rgyal khab kyai sgram gzhi dang lha sa'i 5/la ljangs/ 14ye tshan bzhi pa/ btsan rgal rgyal gces kyai mtho rlabs/ 18ye tshan lnga pa/ mi yul gyi dmyal ba myong 'ag tshugs/— 33le tshan drug pa/ rnga chen glag khang sogs kyai las grwar btang ba/ 4zhale tshan bdun pa/ thag ram̐ng gi mi snyan pa'igatam/ tsho 71

dkar chagane tshan brgyad pa/ ram̐g gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab rtsod/ 83ne tshan dgu pa/ ngas nam yang mtha' 'khyangs byed pa'i rtsa dan dang langs phyags/ 100le tshan bcu pa/ dngangs skrag slang ba'i sngag bsher dang /spa bo gsum 'asdooms su btang ba/ 106le tshan bcu gcig la tshad thim nas las mir sgyur ba/ 112ye tshan bcu gartswas/ lha sar 'khor zhag tu btang ba/ 119ne tshan bcu gsum/ gral rogs ga chas nga shi lam du ba/glu0khri ba/ 151le tshan bcu bzhi/ bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i skyo gnas 197le tshan bco lnga pa/ ku shu gcig gis sems 'gul thebs nas maig chu shor ba/ 206le tshan bcu drug btson nas glad 'gral btang ba/ 215ye tshan bcu bdun/ ma'o kru'u zhi shi ba'i gtam bzang thos pa 3da5ye tshan bco brgyad/ 7gang sa mchog gi sku tshab bod du phebs pa dang / nga lha sar bskyad pa/ 23na51
dkar chagadaga' skya gnyis 'dres ngang rgya gar du yang ba dang /skal bzang bde skyed kyai nyin ma/ 338

dpar skrun gsal meshad/'dzwam gling ga la'i steng 'bur du don pa'i bod kha ba gangs can gyi ljongs 'di nyid spyi la'i sngan gyi la brgya phrag du ma nas bod kyai chos dang reg gzhung / 5/la gams gshis 'u/gas/ sa cha'i gnas babs sags sga gang sa nas rang btsan gtsang ma'i rgyal khab cig yin pa bsnyan med rtsod bral yin yang rgya nag gang ma rim byon skabs bod rgya gnyis mchod yan gyi 'brel lam de brgyud bod 'di ches snga ma zhig nas rgya 'og tu 'khyur mid gtong sems kyi re ngan thabs brgya jus stang byas yad rung /dngos su spyi la 1949 nas 'ag btsugs kyais mthar 1959 lar rgya nag dmar gzhung nas zhi bde snying 'jags su gnas pa'i bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams skudzings su drag po'i btsan 'dzul gyis gtor bcom 'phrog gsum gyi sga nas bod kyi rgyal rabs la rgyus nang byung myong med pa'i khrag gi 'khar la bskar/ bod mai rnams gzhis byes gnyis su 5111

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ gnyis/su rgyas te dus de nas bzung bde skyed kyai 'tsho bar rol rgyu lta ci/ 'jig rten 'dir dmyal ba mun nag gi sdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa myangs dgas byung ba red/rgya dmar gyis bod nang thog mar btsan 'dzul byed skabs bod la rogs ram bya rgyu'i kha g.yang bsgrags kyang don dngos thog la ngo stang phrag mang po'i ring gsag 'jogs byas pa'i bod kyai chos shes dpal gsum dang /yul gams gshis lugs/ rang byung skye dngos rtsi shing / gter rigs khag maing gi lhag mar btang ba ma zad/ bod mi 'bum bcu gsum la nye ba dus min rkyen 'das su btang ba dang shul lhag bod mi tshor ram̐g gnas gsar brje zer ba sags ming sna tshogs btags nas btson bcug dang do dam/ 'thab rtsod dang slab gas sags kyais nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i dka' sdug gi la zla de dus deng sang yang myong bzhin yad /7spyi nor 7gang sa skyabs mgan chen po mchag nas gsum cu'i dus dran thengs 28 thog bstsal ba'i bka' slab nang / de snga sa sa rang nid kyai thog la gnas tshul mang po zhig byung ba dang / de bzhin gzhan zer rjes 'brangs ma yin pa'i khungs ldan gyi gnas tshul rang gis mthong thos byung ba dag tshang mas do snang chen pos yig thog tu 'gad dgas/15

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ gsum/de 'dra ma byas na/ gnas tshul sdug bsngal ji snyed rang pog myangs pa'i mai mang po zhig ram̐m bzhin rdzogs 'gra yi yad/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus skabs shig la de'i tshe de'i dus sdug po zhe po zhig byung ba red ces spam tshig tsam ma gtogs gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa'i gnas tshul zhib tshags su la'ang bshad rgyu med pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten dngos byung la rgyus rgyas bsdus gang yin yang yig thog la bkod de yig cha mang tsam 'don thabs byed dgas/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgangs don dang / lhag par btsan byol spyi tshags nang tshogs sde dang mi sger gang rung nas deb rigs sna tshogs par skrun byas dang byed bzhin yad na yang las gzhi 'di'i 'og dmaigs bkar phyag las gnang mkhan med khar/rang yul bod nang gzhi rtsa'i smra brjod rang dbang tsam 4 rte med na mi tshe'i la rgyus ngag rgyun tsam las yig thog 'gad rgyu shin tu dka' bas skyed sdug mi 'dra ba rgyud pa'i mi dri'i dngos byung gi la rgyus de dag dang thog rang gi skad yig thog gsag sgrub bgyis te 'di nas bod dbyin gnyis thog rim pas dpar 'grems byed thub na/ la rgyus deb phreng kha thor du mai 'gra bar rjes rab klog pa po rnams la 'tshal bde dang / de bzhin mgan po gang nyid kyai dgangs gzhi rlabs po che sgrub thub pa ma zad/ bod 5

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ bzhi/kyai chab srid btson pa'i la rgyus rtsom sgrig dpar skrun gyi sta nga cha bskang thub pa sags la dmigs te 'di ga tshogs pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyais las gzhi 'di 'ag 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid btson pa'i la rgyus deb phreng bcu bzhi dpar skrun zin pa dang da dung par skrun zhu 'char mang dag cig ya da kha ngas nas da re sa chab srid btson pa'o la rgyus deb phreng bco lnga pa 'di bzhin sprel gang bla bzang yan tan gyi la rgyus (ngabai mai tshe dmyapha mernga nang btso sbyang byung ba/) zhes pa dngos su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis rgyal spyi'i steng bod don thog rgyab skyar gnang mkhan dang / de bzhin bod nang gi yid skya ba'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib gnang mkhan rnams la la rgyus kyai dpyad gzhir thugs phan sas re/lhag par bod phyi nang du gnas pa'i rang ram̐gs gzhon skyes rnams la rgan rabs tshas bod rgyal khab dang mai ram̐gs ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad pa gsal rtogs kyais mes po'i khrag rgyun ded nas bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gsa'i don du zungs khrag gsar pa zhig sbyin thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yad/ da lan deb phreng bco lnga pa 'dir 7gang sa mchog nas ched bajiod bka' drin bstsal ba dang / lhag par la rgyus kyai bdag po dang rtsom sgrig pa/ 'di ga'i las byed yangs nas phyar gru mnyam 'degs gnang ba'i 51

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brdzod/ lja/'bras bus mthar par skrun zin par bcos main snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/bod kyai dasdo/ bcu ga༄/ma las 'asdo/la tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso/ka tsha ngag dbang 'od 'bar gyis/spyi la 2007 zla 8 tshes 30 nyin/511

gleng brdzod/༄ṣṭha༅/ /'dzwam gleng gi yang rtser gnas pa'i gangs ljongs chos ldan rgyal khab 'dir/ phyi la 195༷ lar rgya dmar gung khran tang gis drag po'i btsan 'dzul byas par brten/ bod kyi rgya che'i ser skya mi mang nas rang dbang rang btsan gyi bden don dar cha mthon por bsgrengs te/ dpa' ngar zhum med ngang rgya dmar btsan 'dzul bar 'gog rgol 'thab rtsod rim pa byas/ 'on kyang blo pham pa zhig la bya rim de'i nang bod kyi rgyal rabs la rgyus nang bod rgyal khab dang / mi mang la byung ma myong ba'i god chags kyi khrag dang mig chu'i lo rgyus shin tu ya nga ba zhig byung ba de nga tsho'i mi thog 'dis dngos su myangs/rang nyid kyang de'i khongs su gtogs pa'i mi zhig yin par brten dngos myong gi mi tshe'i bde sdug rnams yig thog 'jog thub na/ snyam pa'i bsam blo 5111

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brdzod/ bdun/la shas sngon nas yad kyang le las de mur lus shing / de rjes mkhyen ldan rgyal gces lhag bsam can 'ga' zhig nas rang gi mi tshe'i lo rgyus shig bris nas 'jog thub na/ gung khran tang gis bod mir mi bzod pa'i btsan gnon ji ltar btang ba dang / bod rgyal khab kyi chos rig goms gshis/ mi rigs dang bcas pa rtsa brlag ji ltar btang ba'i gnas tshul dngos rjen rnams da lta dang / ma 'ongs pa'i gzhon skyes mi rabs bcas pas gsal shes yang rgyur phan thogs yad pa'i skul ma gnang byung la/ lhag par gsum bcu'i dus dran thengs zha1 pa'i thog spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas 'bod skul gnang don/nga tsho bod kyi la rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i dka' sdug cig nga tsho'i mi thog 'dir myang dgos byung ba'i lo rgyus rnams so so mig ma btsums gong / sgra 'jug 'khor thag gam/ yig thog 'jog thub na dge phan yad skor bka' slob phebs pa des nga la skul lcag chen po byung /rang nyid shes rig chu tshad dman pa'i dbang gis rtsom 'bri'i skabs dka' ngal 'phrad nges kyang de dag la gdong bsus te/ spyi la 1959 la phan rang 515

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/ brgyad/gi gces pa'i pha yul rang btsan skabs bod 'di phyi rgyal yar thon rgyal khab ltar dmangs gtso dang deng dus 'phrul chas/ dpal 'byor sogs rjes lus kyi skyon gnas shig yad na'ang / gzhi rtsa'i rgyal khab kyi sgrig gzhi cha tshang zhing / 'tsho ba dang / chos dang rig gzhung bcas gzhan la re ma dgos par rang 'go rang thon gyis mi mang rnams/ chos srid rang dbang bde skyed kyi 'tsho ba'i dpal la blo bde bag phebs ngang rol bzhin yad pa'i dngos yad gnas stangs rob bsdus dang / spyi la 1959 la nas rgya dmar gyis gangs ljongs drag pos btsan bzung dbang sgyur byas nas bzung la bzhi bcu lhag ring rang thog dngos myong gi la rgyus rnams/ he bag med pa don dngos gsal po mtshon thub pa zhig las zhor du ngal ba khyad bsad kyis bri thub na/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod sprin du gyur ba smos ci/ deng shes rig gi dpal yan rgyas bzhin pa'i gzhis byes gzhon nu rnams nas sdug dran skyid bsam la rgyus kyi chab srid bsam blo'i slob gso yang re'i kun slang bzang pos/ (nga'i mi tshe dgral me'i nang btsosbyang byung ba/)zhes pa'i la rgyus yig cha 'di bris/5sto

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brdzod/ bdun/ rang nyid shes yan dman pas yi ge'i brjod dag sogs la skyon cha yad nges pas gzur gnas mkhyen ldan rnam shās dkrerdzongs yangs yang ba zhu rgyu bcas/pha lha'i phyag mjood sprel gang ba'i bu bla bzang yan tan gyis/spyi la 20༷7 zla 8 tshes sku0 nyin/5sto1
lnga

dang po/nga'i khyim tshang gi lo gyus /( 1943———1948)phran phyi lo 1943 'o/ra bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar pha lha'i phyag mdzod spel gong zhes pa'i khyim tshang du skyes shing / nga'i skyed byed mtshan la phur bu dbang rgyal zhu ba dang / gzim shag pha lha'i phyag mdzod kyi las 'gan bzhes kyi yod/ khong ni chos srid gnyis kyi mkhyen sku na gang 'tshams ldan pa zhig dang / skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi nyams myong can zhig yin pas skye bo mchodag dman bar gsum nas re ltos byed yul yid ches tshad 'dzin gyi skye bo zhig tu ngos 'dzin zhu yi yod/pha yis 'dzugs gnyer gnang ba'i spel gong slob grwa zhes pa'i nang sku drag dang / tshong rigs/ grong mi dkyus ma bcas pa'i bu skrug pho mo mang dus grangs 170 lha ra yod pa de dag gi dge rgan yang pha

2 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/yis gnang zhing / slob sbyong gi cha rkyen tshang ma gcig gyur yin/phyi lo 1950 lor rgya dmar gyis bod la btsan 'dzul gyis gom stabs sgos nas bzung pha yis dgra bo'i chab srid kyi mgo skor dang /nā yang gi bslu 'brid 'og ma tshud par blo brtan 'gyur med btsan rgol rgyal gces 'thab rtsod las 'gul rim pa'i nang dpa' ngar zhum med gdong len dang / gtso shugs kyi nus pa gang che 'don spel gnang stabs/rgya dmar gyis do snang dang sdang zug che shos byed yul mi sna'i gras su gyur pa dang / tha na rtsa che'i sku srog kyang bod kyi bstan srid ched legs skyes phul gnang yod pa ni rgyal gces ser skya mang ngo sa mkhyen rtogs yod/nga'i a ma nyi ma lags ni chos srid rig gnas kyi mkhyen yon cher med kyang / rang bzhin chos dad che ba dang / thugs gshis 'jam pa/ nam rgyun khyim skyong gi las la mkhas pa zhig sku da/ gasku ga pho mo chod dang de bzhin mo bran rgan gzhon kun nas dga' zhen brtsi bkur byed/a ma lags ni phyi lo 1957 lor khyim du snyun mnar gyi sman bcos rim 'gro gang sku nga zhus kyang phan nus ma thon par dgung grangs 51 la dgongs pa rdzogs/ nga la spun mched gcen mo lnga dang / gcen po gcigagacung mo gnyis yod pa sde/ gcen mo rgan thodas dbyangs can lags dang /gcen ngo bkra shis lha bas rgyal lags/ gcen mo chos 'dzoms lags/2

nga'i khyim tshang gi lo rgyus/ 3gcen mo spen sgron lags/ gcen mo blo bzang padmo lags/ gcen mo chos mtsho lags/ gcung mo rig 'dzin padmo dang / bsod nams sgrol ma bcas yin/sbun mched rgan gzhon de dag gi nang nas pha ma gnyis dang /lhag par a ma lags kyis nga la byams brtse che shos gnang ste/ lha sa nas rta lam gcig gi sar yod gzim shag pha lha'i gzhis khongs spel snang gzhis ka nga tshos bzung nas/ gzhis sdod du nga'i sru mo lags dang khong gi sku zla nyi ma rgyal po lags bzhugs yod cing / khong tshos lo ltar bod zla bdun pa'i nang gdan zhus ltar/ 'brom thod spel snang 'ong skor dus chen la pha ma gnyis phebs skabs nga mnyam 'khrid gnang ba dang / de bzhin bar lam brag yer pa'i lha khang dang / mchod rten/ rtsa che'i rten gtso mang che ba nyams chag je cher gyur pa dang / dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor yod pa'i mchod rgyun sogs nyams nyes chen po byung ba rnams mi nyams gong 'phel dang / nyams pa sor 'chud yong ched dgon pa'i gnad yod las sne tshos skyed byed mchog la thugs 'khur rogs mgon yong ba'i re 'dun zhus pa ltar/ khong gis dag snang chen pos zhal bzhes kyis spel gong khyim tshang nas dpal 'byor rgyu gron gang yod btang thog de min gzhung dang 'byor ldan sger pa khag nas zhal 'debs bsdu slong zhus 3

ri4 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/te/ brag yer par pha ma gnyis zla gnyis tsam bzhugs te nyams gso'i gtso 'gan bzhes nas lha sa mo gas nas 'jim baX ba dang / lha bris pa/shing bzo ba/ rdo bzo ba mkhas can/ sku'i gzungs gzhug gi thugs 'gan bzhes mkhan bla ma bcas brag yer par gdan zhu dang / de bzhin ar las pa dkyus ma mi grangs 30 tsam bsdu bskong gis lha khang dang /mchod rten/ rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten khag dang / de bzhin dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa'i mchod rgyun sogs nyams pa sor 'chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi legs snu gas gamo ga thub pa'i grub 'bras la dad ldan gnas mjal ba ser skya mang pos rjes su yi rangs dang / bsngags brjod zhu 'os su gyur ba ma zad/ dgon pa'i las sne tsho dang dge 'dun dmangs kyi bka' drin rjes dran gyi lo ltar bod zla 7 pa'i nang brag yer pa'i tshes bcu dang / dge 'dun pa'i 'cham gzigs dus chen la pha ma gnyis gdan zhus ltar phebs skabs dgon pa'i sbyin bdag dang / sku mgron gtso bo zhig tu brtsis nas las sne sbos dgon gsham du ched phebs kyis sne len phebs bsu gnang ste gus bkur che mthong chen po zhu yi 'dugade dus kyang nga pha ma gnyis dang mnyam 'khrid gnang /de bzhin shug gseb dgon dang thag ring lho gnas khag la pha ma gnyis phebs skabs nga dang bral mi phod pa lta bus mnyam 'khrid gnang dus 4

nga'i khyim tshang gi lo rgyus/ 5rta shed legs shing / bgrod bzang la lhing po zhig la rta sga spus legs brgyab pa go sgrig gnang ba'i steng bzhon nas/ rtsa che'i rin thang bral ba'i byin can sku brnyan bzhugs pa'i mtshon srung dngul la gser tshag ldan pa'i ga'u 'bral spang gyon bcug gnang ste/ nga'i tshe srog bde 'jags ni pha ma rang nyid kyi sku srog bde 'jags las rtsa cher brtsis kyi yod/ rgyun gtan zas go sa mthun rkyen se gas sbun mched gzhan las lhag pa'i dmigs gsal gzigs skyong gnang stabs/ gces lang shor ba'i nga'i byed stangs nor 'khrul yong dus spun mched rgan pa tshos nga la gshe gshe btang ba a ma lags kyis mkhyen na/ da lta bu lo na chung bas skyon sna ra yong srid pas der khyod tsho spun mched rgan pa tshos 'jam bshad blo sgug gi slob gso byed pa las/ nga'i phru gur gshe gshe ma gtong zhes gsungs te nga'i rgyab rtsa gnang bas/ skabs 'gar spun mched rgan pa tshos slo yon ma galta gas nga tsho a ma lags kyi phru gu min pa 'dra/ bus spyod ngan gang byas kyang bka' skyon mi gnang ba/ a ma lags nas bu gces lang btang gi 'dug ces phan tshun gsungs res gnang ste/ a ma lags su nga'i ched spun mched tsho'i zur za phog gi yod/ mdor na byams brtse bka' drin mtshungs med pha ma gnyis kyis spun mched tshang ma nas nga la byams skyong che shos gnang gi yod/5

gahaṃs pa /gces par 3ros pa'i pha ༷/la rwani sa /nga'i dga' gces 'os pa'i pha yul lha sa ni/ mdzes sdug brjid chags yid du 'ong ba zhig yod/ dper na/ 'dzam gling thodag snyan grags che la brjid nyams ldan zhing / phyogs kun tu gser 'od chem chem 'a'o/ ba'i gser zangs rgya phibs kyis brgyan pa'i pho brang po tā ‘ra yod cing de'i nang 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung dang / bod gzhung gi mdzad chen khag tshugs yul tshoms chen/ bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang chen po'i bka' shag lhan rgyas dang / rtse shod las khungs khag tshugs yul sku da pa ma zad/7rgyal mchog sku phreng rim byon gyi gser sde nga khag dang / lhag par 'phags pa lo ki sha rwas dbus rtsa che'i rten gtso dang / rin thang bral ba'i rin po che sna hrūgs las grub pa'i rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten grangs med bzhugs la/ rin chen gser dngul la sogs pa'i gzhung 6

gces par 'os pa'i pha yul lha sa/ 7gi rnam sras gan mdzod kyang yod/ de bzhin rnam rgyal grwa tshang nang rgyal ba'i gsung zhabs dge 'dun zhal grangs 175 tsam bzhugs/grong khyer gyi dbus su sku ngas su grags pa'i lha sa gtsug lag khang yod cing / de'i nang bod rje srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor rgya nag gong ma'i sras mo wun shing kong jo bsu skabs rten skal du byon pa'i ngo bo shākya mu ne rten gtso ra bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin 'phags pa thugs rje chen po rang byung lnga ldan gyis mtshon byin can gyi sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa grangs med yod/ru mo che gtsug lag khang nang bal bza' khri btsun gyi rten skal du byon pa'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje rten gtsor bzhugs pa'i rtsa tshe'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po dang / dpal ldan rgyud stod grwa tshang gi 'du khang / chodas ra bcas yod/ de bzhin sgrol ma lha khang dang / tshe dpag lha khang / zhi khro lha khang / brag lha klu sgug lha khang / rigs gsum lha khang / snyung gnas lha khang sogs rtsa che'i chodas lugs byed lha spel yul lha khang yang mang po yod pa ma zad/ rgyud smad grwa tshang / rme ru grwa tshang /bzhi sde grwa tshang / tshe smon gling grwa tshang / kun bde gling grwa tshang / grib tshe mchog gling grwa tshang sogs lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i grwa tshang khag kyang yod la/ rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon gyi yab gzhis khag kyang yod/7

8 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/lha sa gtsug lag khang nang rje tsong kha pa chen pos se la 'dzugs gnang ba'i gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos dge 'dun khri stong mang ngo yod pa de dag lo ltar smon lam tshugs yul 'khyam ra dang / shing ra/ gsung chos ra ba bcas gzhi rgya che ba'i chos ra yod cing / jo bo dbu skra'i 'og bod 'di rang btsan bsnyon med yin pa ra trod dpang po 'pher ba'i bod rgya phan tshun 'dra mnyam dang / gnyis phan zhi bde sku nga ched bod bod yul la skyid/ rgya rgya yul la skyid/ ces pa'i nge da rgya shan sbyar kyi yig 'bru brkos pa'i rdo ring yod la/ lha sa'i zhol du de dang 'dra ba'i rdo ring phyi ma dang / rdo ring nang ma zhes pa ngo da rang btsan yin pa'i bden dpang gi tshul du 'gying nger gnas yod/sman bcos 'ahrod bsten thad bod gzhung gis 'dzugs gnyer gnang ba'i lcags po ri sman khang dang / sman rtsis khang bcas sman khang che khag gnyis yod pa dang / gzhan yang sger pa khag gi sman khang kha shas yod kyang ngo da kyi sa khams dang gnam gshis mkha' rlung gtsang ba sdu/gas kyi khyad chos las/ nad pa de tsam mang po med cing / sman pa bsten gtug byed mkhan nad pa nyung ngu yin/ lha sa'i bar stodar gyis mtshon 'ong stod zhing kha dang / khrom gzigs khang sogs la tshong khang dang / khrom ru shin tu mang wa yod pa dang / phyi rgyal mi rigs kyang mang po yod pa dper na/8

gces par 'os pa'i pha yul lha sa/ 9rgya mi dang / ka shi smir kha che/ la dwags kha che/ rgya kha che/ bal po/'byug pa/ 'bras ljongs sogs yod pa ma zad rgya gar dang / bal po/'grag sdudags kyi gzhung tshab khang yang yod/phyi rgyal mi rigs de dag la bod gzhung nas dmigs gsal gzigs skyong 'og bod 'bangs spyi las lhag pa'i thob thang yod/ de dag mang che ba'i 'tsho thabs tshong las dang / lag shes tshem bzo sogs la brten gyi yod/ spyir nga tsho nge da gangs can pa rnams kyi 'tsho thabs ni zhing 'brog gnyis la brten gyi yod cing / yar thon can gyi rgyal khab nang gi mi dmangs ltar gyi khra khra sig sig dang / deng dus 'phrul chas sogs med pas rjes lus thebs yod kyang / gzhi rtsa'i chos dang rig gzhung gzhan la smon mi dgos pa/ lto gos kyang rang mgo rang thon byed thub pas/ mi dang / dud 'gro/ sems can ltog shi thebs pa sogs kyi nyam thag pa'i gnas tshul bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung myong med/nga tsho bod gangs can pa mang che ba nang pa sangs rgyas kyi che sa lugs la dad pa byed mkhan yin na'ang chodas lugs grub mtha' gzhan la bkag 'gog byed mkhan med cing / kha tsam min pa'i chodas dad rang mos kyi khe dbang cha tshang yod pa ma zad/ bod gzhung nas phyi rgyal ba bal po dang / ka shi rmir kha che'i chos lugs la brtsi 'jog gnang ba las/ de 9

)() nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/tshor dngos shugs brgyud ga3/ma nas bkag 'doms dang gnon shugs gang yang med pa'i kun la ris med byams brtses skyong ba'i khong yangs dkyel che'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi mdzad phyogs srid byus 'og mi rigs de tsho blo bde bag phebs ngang mi tshe don dang ldan pa skyel bzhin yodad/lha sa'i mi mang rnams ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs bskyed dang / blo dkar sems dkar/ gzhan phan byang sems che ba/ nyam chung dang ya rabs byed dgos sar nyam chung ya rabs dang / gyong mkhregs byed dbo sa sar/ gyong mkhregs byed thub mkhan zhig dang / rgyun gtan las la brtson zhing / chos srid byed sgo dang / spro skyid byed sgo sna chodags spel rgyur dga' ba/ gtong phod che ba bcas kyi phul byung gi mi rigs shig yin/lha sa'i byang phyo gas su gdan sa chen po se ra dgon pa khra lham mer mjal rgyu yod pa de'i nang rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po yod pa ma zad/ bla ma dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa'i dge bshes mang po dang / dge 'dun lnga ltong lnga brgya lhag tsam yod/ de'i nye 'khor g.yas g.yon du shin tu nyams dga' ba'i dben pa'i ri khrod mang po yod pa de tsho'i nang thun mong gi lam dang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la gzhol ba'i bya btang gi rnal 'byor mang po bzhugs/ lha sa'i nub lnga sa su mdzes 10

gces par 'os pa'i pha ༷/la lha sa/ 11sdug yid dbang 'phrog pa'i nor bu gling kha yod cing / de'i nang 7rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i skabs bzhengs pa'i skal bzang pho brang dang / mtsho dkyil pho brang rim bzhin rgya bskyed gnang ba'i spyan gsal pho brang / rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang semags 7rgyal ba'i pho brang dang / bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang chen po'i ches mtho'i las khungs bka' shag dang / rtse shod las khungs sde khag rnams tshugs yul dang /dpon rigs khag gi las shag bcas yod/ nor bu gling kha ni 7rgyal ba rin po che dbyar dus bzhugs yul pho brang yin la/ ser skya mang tshogs la mjal mang dang / dus 'khor dbang chen sogs bka' chodas gnang yul chos ra dang / dbyar dus sngar srol zho rnyedan dang chab zhugs spro skyid gnang yul yang yin/ gnas de ni/ yangs shing rgyal che la de'i nang yid dbang 'phrog pa'i me tog sna hrūgs kyi ldum ra dang / 'bras ldan shing sna sna tshogs yod/ ga'an yang sbyar lcang sogs shing sā sna chodaḍa star sgrig bkod legs kyis brgyan pa dang / gcan gzan spra dang / spre'u la sogs pa'i ri dgas sna tshogs kyi spyan gzigs khang yang yod/ gling kha de'i nang bya rdi rdi sogs bya byi'u sna tshogs kyi gsung snyan gyi sgras mi rnams kyi sems la dga' skyo gnyis 'dres dang / zhi bde bag phebs kyi 'tsho ba zhig kyang rang bzhin gyis sku nga / nor bu gling ga zhes yongs su grags pa ni ming

12 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/don mtshungs pa'i nor bu'i gling zhig yin/de'i nub ngo sa su gdan sa chen wa 'bras spungs dgon pa khra lham mer mjal rgyu sku da cing / dgon pa de'i nang rten gce byin can shin tu gyon legs shing / ji tsam mjal ba de tsam gyi mjal 'dod je cher 'gro ba'i byams pa mthong grol gyi dbus rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten grangs med yod la/ dge 'dun zhal grangs khri kha lon pa de tsharare khrodad nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum ldan pa'i dge bshes mang lnga skyed sring lju nga brdar yod pa de snu sa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyun 'dzin dang / srung skyob/dar spel bcas kyis bstan 'gro'i 'khur 'gan chen nge bzhes kyi sku da/de'i gsham du bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i bstan srung gi gnas dpe har lcog dang / gnas chung rdo rje sgra dbyangs gling grwa tshang yod pa de'i nang gnas chung rdo rje grags ldan gyi sku brnyan gzi ldan 'jigs su rung ba zhig yod pa ma zad/ gzhung dmangs rnams nas 'o/ ltar sku gsol zhus te 7rgyal ba'i sku phywa'i skor la gegs bar sku da med dang /bsnyan srid sra tshugs sra brtan go nga 'phel yong slad zhu sgo'i lung zhu phul bar chos skyong nas dus gsum gsal gzigs kyi cad rje'i bka' lung gnang ba sogs mi rnams la lnga mtshar che ba'i snang ba byin/lha sa'i shar phyo gas rta lam phyed gnyis sar brjid nyams ldan pa'i 2

gces par bo sa pa'i pha sa/la lha sa/ 13gdan sa chen po dga' ldan mjal rgyu yod pa'i nang rten gtso bo/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i gser sde nga chen mos mtshon gser dngul sogs las bskrun pa'i sku gsung thugs rten pha lam dang / rin chen sna tsho gas kyi phra tshom bkod pa shisna tu mang po mjal rgyu sku da/ chos spyod slob gnyer mthar son pa'i dga' ldan khri pas dbus bstan 'gro'i 'khur 'gan bzhes nus pa'i bla ma dge bshes mang po yod pa ma zad/ dge 'dun zhal grangs sum stong sum brgya lhag tsam bzhugs yod// dzo13

gsum pa/ ’rgyal khab kyai cesam gzhi dang tsho/ sa'i ༷/la nywasnongs/nga tsho bod mi dza sa rang gi rgyal khab nas bstodan pa'i bod gzhung dga' ljan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes 'khod pa'i bod dngul brgya lor dang / lnga bcu'i lor/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lor/ bcu lor/ srang lnga lor bcas kyi shog dngul dang / gser ṭam to/ la gcig gi ljid tshad can/ de bzhin lhad med dngul dkar las bskrun pa'i bcu sgor dang /lnga sbor/ srang gsum sgor/ ṭam bcu'i sgor/ ṭam dkar sna tshogs sogs yod pa ma zad/da dung zangs las bskrun pa'i zho lnga sgor mo dang /zho gyosum sgor mo/ 'o gang dang phyed brgyad/ skar chen/ skar chung /skar phyed gsum bcas rgyun gtan 'a/rdo ba'i nang 'bo rgyugs bed spyod kyi

rgyal khab kyi sgrom gzhi dang lha sa'i ༷ la ljongs/ 15yod/ rgyal srung dang spyi dzadags bde 'jags srung skyob ched/ ka dang /sku srung dmag sgar dang / kha dang / grwa bzhi dmag sgar/ ga dang / gzhis rtse dmag sgar/ nga dang / rgyal rtse dmag sgar/ bde srung pu li si'i dmag sgar/ ca dang / ding ri dmag sgar sogs kyi nang dpa' rtsal dang rgyal gces lhag bsam snying stobs ldan pa'i dpa' dmag stodang phrag mang po yod cing / dmag sgar so so'i thog steng bod rgyal khab chen po'i rgyal dor mkha' dbyings su brjid nyams ldan pa'i ngang lhab lhab g.yo bzhin yad/de bzhin spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags dang mi mang gi khe phan srung skyob ched ngan pa tshar gce da ma byas na bzang wa sprod ba mi 'phel ba chos nyid la so/nga / rkun jag dang / mabo skor gto/nga mkhan/ mi gsod mkhan/khram pa'i dza gas khag dang / de min spyi dza gas kyi sgrig lam galtasner bshig tshabs che byed pa'i mi ngan bcas la rtsa khrims gzhir bzung 'alha ga gce na dang khrims gcod byed pa'i khrims ra dang / snang rtse shag btson khang dang snyadal bce na khang bcas bce na khang khag gnyis sku da kyang / chodas srid kyi byin mthu lta bus nyes can nyung ngu las med pa dper na/ btson khang nang btson pa lnga'am bcu/ mang dus nyi shu tsam las mi sku nga ba ma zad/ skabs 'gar bce na khang nang bce na pa gcig kyang med par stong pa chags pa'i 15

16 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gnas tshul yang yang yong gi yod/ btson srung bas yang bskyar nyes gsoog boce napo mi yong ba'i gto bcos kyis btson khang nang sa dkar gsal sral kugad/lha sa'i nye 'khor 'gying nger gnas pa'i dge 'phel dbu rtse dang /shin tu dbyibs bkod legs pa'i bum pa ri/ brjid chags ldan pa'i mi 'khrug rdza ri bcas su lha sa'i mi mang rnams nas dus chen khag la dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha srung rnams dbu 'phang bstod cing / mthu stobs rgyas pa dang / spyi sger gyi bya ba lam lhongs yong ched bsang gsol byed/lha sa'i skyid chu'i zam chen 'og bsdus pa'i sngo zhing dwangs gtsang gi skyid chu dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par shar phyogs nas nub phyogs su shar rer rgyugs bzhin yod pa'i steng ko grur rten nas dngos po dbor 'dren byed/ de bzhin dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu phran mang po de tshos lha sa'i phyogs bzhi gang sar rgyugs te zhing las thon skyed la phan nus chen po 'dren gyi yod/lhag par dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhad pa'i dus lha sa'i 'ong kha'i nang pad kha'i me tog ser thing thing bzhad pa dang / g.yu ltar sngo ba'i spang ljongs thog me lta ga sna tshogs dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad la sdudags pa'i 'ja' tshon ri mos brgyan pa'i sdod gur bzo dbyibs sna tshogs kyi 16

rgyal khab kyi sgrom gzhi dang lha sa'i yul ljongs/ 17phra rgyan btab pa lta bu'i steng lha sa'i mi mang rnams nas 'dzam gling spyi bsang dang / yang na spro skyid gling gtong gi gzhas dang / zhabs bro'i dga' skyid dpal la rol ba dang / de bzhin ngang pa dkar po dang / ngang pa ser po/ khrung khrung dkar mo sogs bya byi'u sna tshogs rang rang gis gsung snyan lha ga bzhin du zhi bde bag phebs ngang gnas shing / gnam gshis kyang tsha grang snyoms pa/ rtag tu char chu bzang ba/ mdor na lha sa ni dbyibs bkod bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi mtshan nyid tshang ba'i brjid chags ri bos bskor ba'i dbus na gnas pa'i lha yul lta bu zhig yin pa phyi nang skye bo bsam yod can kun la rang shugs kyi tshor snang yong /rang nyid de 'dra'i phun sum tshogs pa'i yul lung zhig twa skyes pa ni 'phags mchog phyag na padmos rjes su bzung ba zhig yin pa'i ngo sa 'dzin gyis rtag tu dad sems dang dga' spobs skye bzhin 'dug17

bzhi pa/btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi mtho rlabs /( 1948———1959/3/22)phran rang lo drug nas khyim du snyadab sbyong byed 'go tshugs shing /de rjes bod nang rgya dmar btsan 'dzul bas bsam spyod ngan pa khong du sbas te lcags kyus nya dang / wa mos sha 'khrid lta bus slob phrug pho mo mang wa zhig spel bo nga slob grwa dang / sbyar pa khang gsar slob grwa lho byang gnyis/nang shar we ba grwa/ gor kha'i slob grwa/ tar khang rsāwab grwa/ nang nub snyadab grwa/ btsan khang dzā ba grwa la sogs pa'i phra da pa'i slob grwa khag nas rtsa dgongs zhus te/ rgya mis 'dzugs gnyer byas pa'i rgya nag che ba grwa khag nang slob sbyong du bskyod de slob phrug ji nyung du song ba dang / skyed byed mchog kyang skabs de'i dus bab nyin bzhin dza drag tu gyur rkyen phyag las mdzad brel je ches/ slob phrug lhag lus chodar yang slob 'khrid gnang 18

btsan lha la rgyal gces kyi mtho rlabs/ 19khom dben stabs/ spel gong slob grwa mtshams 'jog gnang bar brten rang lo bcu gnyis la slebs skabs sbyar pa khang gsar zhes pa'i slob grwar/nga'i gcung mo rig 'dzin padmo dang / bsod nams sgrol ma mnyam du slob grwar bskyal zhing / bod yig shog thog khyug yig gang 'tshams 'bri shes stsabs spyi lo 1959 lor btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi rlabs chen 'thab rtsod las 'gul gyi mtho rlabs gong du 'phyur nas/ lo de'i bod zla 2tshes 1 dang / phyi zla 3 tshes 10 nyin lha sa nor bu gling gar mi mang khri stong mang po glo bur 'du 'dzoms kyis 7gong sa mchog rgya dmar nas si ling pu'u dmag khul khang nang / gdan zhu byas yod pa der chibs sgyur mi gnang ba'i phyag 'tshal zhu bar nga rang yang mi mang spyi mtshungs ltar bskyod/nyin de 'phags pa lha'i gcen po mkhan chung bsod nams rgya ma27 ni rgyun gtan rgya zhen che ba dang / bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs las bo sa phud de kha ras dkar po zhig brgyab ste rkang 'khor bzhon nas nor bu gling khar yong skabs/ mi mang gis rdo gzhus nas bsad pa dang / bsam 'o/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi dbu la rdo gzhus nas rmas skyon btang ba'i gnas tshul byung zhing / de'i skabs ser skya mi mang tshang ma sems skyo zhing khong khro che ba'i ngar shugs kyis khengs /19

20 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/phran yang skabs der lo na chung yang rang khyim pha ma bzang po'i rgyun gtan mdzad bzang shugs rkyen dang slob stodan 'og 'tshar longs byung stabs/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por bcos min dad gus lhag bsam ldan zhing / rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs la lar zhen rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yod pas mi mang spyi dang 'dra ba'i skyo snang dang / khong khro chen po byung /nga'i byams brtse can gyi skyed byed kyang de nyin nor gling du phebs te khong rnam pa'i gras mi khag cig mi mang gi 'thus mir dza drag 'dems bsko byas te nor gling gzim sgo'i nang phebs/ ngas gus brtsi 'os pa'i gcen mo spen pa sgrol ma lags kyang khyim du dbu skra bshig nas 'khru grabs byed skabs/ rgya mis 7gong sa mchog dmag khul khang lī / gdan zhu bya rtsis byed pa'i gnas tshul gsan thos byung 'phral dbu skra 'khru khom ma byung bar zing zing gis nor gling du phebs/ de nyin nga'i grogs po tshul khrims mnyam du yod pa/ grogs po khong rgya mi'i slob grwar bskyod bzhin yod pas mi mang gis rgya mi'i lho ba grwa ba red/ ces bshad nas rdung rdeg phog dogs kyis khyim du phyir log kyang / phran ni mu mthud sdod skabs gzhung zhabs rtse drung kha shas mang tshogs khrod phebs te/ de ring chu tshod dang po tsam la dmag khul khang nas 7rgyal ba rin snga che gdan zhu bya mi yong 20

btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi mtho rlabs/ 21gi yod pas/ mang dzargags nas gdan zhu bya mir rdo gzhu ba la sogs pa'i 'khrug rkyen ma bslangs par gzhung lam steng nyal nas 7rgyal ba rin po che gdan zhu ma byed rogs/ zhes zhu 'bod byed dgos gsungs/nga chodas kyang de ltar yid la bcangs nas gra sgrig gis sdod skabs chu tshod gnyis par son yang rgya mi'i gdan zhu'i mo ṭa ma slebs/ chu tshod gsum pa yol tsam la nor gling gzim sgo'i steng nas sa dbang zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / pha lha mgron che thub bstan 'od ldan/ sku srung mda' dpon stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis bcas phebs te khong rnam pas mang tshogs la/ 7rgyal ba rin po che dmag khul khang du chibs sgyur mi gnang ba'i thugs gtan 'khel bas/ khyod tsho mang tshogs rnams thugs bde por bzhugs rogs/ so so'i khyim du phebs nas bsang gsol dang thugs smon yag po gnang rogs/ da lta khyed tsho mi mang gi 'thus mi khag gcig nang du 'gyor nacis mi mang gi sku srung / dang blang dmag btsugs kyi yin zhes brjod par 'di gar sku srung yod mus kyis 'thus/ dang blang sku srung mi dgos brjod kyang / 'thus mi tshos dang blang sku srung nges par bzhag cog pa'i re zhu u tshugs byed/ de ni khyod tsho'i re ba yin pas de ltar byas 'thus zhes bka' gnang /de rjes sku srung mda' dpon stag lha phun chodags bkra shis kyis 21

22 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/spo ga brnyan gyi 'dra par rgyag skabs nga chod mang tshadags nas wa da rang btsan gyen langs kyi rnam pa mtshon ched/ tshang mas gri dang / dbyug pa/ khu tshur mkha' dbyings su mthon por bsgrengs/ 'phags pa lha'i mkhan chung gi ro nor gling gzhung sgo'i g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i rdo'i seng ge'i g.yas phyogs su yod pa der/ mang chodags kyis the gzhu ba sku gas kho nga khro chen pos chol rdung drag po btang zhing / de skabs bud med tso lhag par ngar shugs che/ de nas sa khul khungs so so sku srung dang blang gi ming tho len skabs nga tsho'i khungs su rmar lam pa'i phyag mdzod red zer ba zhig 'dug pa/ des bu khyodad rang bsam blo gtong stangs zhe drag yag po red/ 'on kyang lo na chung bas dang blang khongs tshud kyi ma red/ ces gsungs pas/ ngas dang blang 'jon gyi red/ mde'u gcig las med kyang skyel rogs byed thub ces ngu skad thon bzhin u tshugs nan po zhus pas/ khong gis de 'dra yin na ngas ming sprod 'god chog ces gsungs te ming lnga brgyab/de rjes dgong dro chu tshod bzhi pa tsam nas mi mang rnams ru star bsgrigs nas lha sar kha gtad de bskyod cing bod rang dbang rang btsan yin/ rgya mi lnga da nas phar rgyugs shig ces bden pa'i 'the/da tshig skad gsang mthon po sa sgrog bzhin du bskyodad skabs/ rgya dmar dpon 22

btsan lha la rgyal gces kyi mthege rlabs/ na3rigs mthod cadas sngo da yul g.yu thog gzim shag gi gzhung sgo brgyab ste/sgo srung dmag mis lcags ri'i 'dzing rag nas me mda'i so kha nga tshor gtad kyang nga chodas pho zad mo la thug pa dang / lag zad dpung la thug kyang bden pa'i 'thab rtsod mtha' 'khyongs byed kyi yin/ zhes 'brug sgra ljir ba ltar gyi 'bod sgra bsgrags/mu mthud lha sa'i bar skor du skad 'bod byed bzhin bar spor gnyis tsam 'kho ra skabs nyi ma la ru bzhud/ de nyin zhogs pa nas nyin gang mi mang tshang mar zas skom chu thigs tsam med kyang zas gting brjed kyis brjid rngam che ba'i kho ma stodar de byas/ de nas rgyal gces mang chodags rnams khungs so sor phyir log pa dang / phran yang nang du log nas de ring nor gling du byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams nang mir bshad rjes nga nor gling du sku srung dang blang khongs ming tho brgyab pa yin/ nga la rnya chas dang go lag gra sgrig byedas/ zhes brjod skabs nang mis nga tshos thag mi chod/skyed byed mchog la bka' 'dri zhu dgos zer/ dgong dro phyi por skyed byed macog nang du phebs rjes nga dang blang gi ming tho brgyab pa dang / nor gling du bskyod rgyu yin zhu skabs/ nga'i bsam blo'i 'khyer sor khong thugs dgyes kyang / khyed rang phrug gu yin pas dmag thodag 'bo rgyu dka'/ de bas nga mnyam du sku nga na de'ang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dodan red ces 23

24 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gsungs pa ltar/ ma 'dod bzhin brtsi bkur zhus te skyed byed mchog mi mang 'thus mir slar yang 'os 'dems byung stabs khong gi zhabs phyi lta bur zhol dpar khang dang / kun bde gling du mi mang 'thus mi'i tshogs 'du tshogs yul du bskyod/kun bde gling du bskyod nyin bod zla 2 tshes 6 dang phyi zla 3 tshes 15 nyin yin/ de gong bod zla 2 tshes 3 spyi zla 3 tshes 12nyin bod kyi bud med tshogs pa dza drag ngang btsugs rjes/ kun bde gling kun bzang lags dang / dga' gling shag gi chos btsun sogs kyis dbu khrid pa dang / nga'i gcen mo spen sgrol lags drung yig red/ de bzhin bud med stong phrag mang pos lcags po rir brjid rngam che ba'i bsang gsol byas pa kun gling nas cha tshang mthong / lcags po rir bsang gsol byed pa'i bud med kyis ri mgo nas gsham bar yongs su khengs/bud med rnams kyis ki ki bsdud bso 'then nas bsang rtsam nam mkhar gtor rjes ri rtser yod pa'i dar phung chen po de mes 'tshig nas me lce nam mkhar 'phyur zhing / der yod chodags 'thus rnams kyi zhabs phyi mang po 'du 'dzoms yod pa'i nang nas mi kha shas kyis dar cing 'tshigs pa de rtags rten yag po red zer ba dang / mi kha shas kyis de 24

btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi mtho rlabs/ 25rnam rtog dang zhan pa red ces shod smeng du ma byung / skabs der dar phung tshig skabs nga'i bsam blo'i nang 'jigs dngangs kyi rang bzhin byung bas/ rtags rten mi legs pa zhig yin pa'i rnam rtog byung / de rjes mi mang 'thus mi'i tshogs 'du zhol dpar khang du gnang rgyu gtan 'khel zhing / tshogs 'dus slar yang 'thus mi hrag bsdus gnang ste skyed byed mchog 'thus mi'i khongs slar yang 'os 'dems byung ste/ 'thus mi rnams gnas skabs dus bde zhi 'jags ma byung bar lha sar yar mar phebs bgrod ma dbo sa par zhol rang du gnas bzhugs gnang legs zhes bka' gros byung ba ltar/ bod zla 2 tshes 7 nyin skyed byed mchog zhol du gnas spo gnang skabs nga dang gcung mo chung ba bsdudad nams sgrol ma/ nang g.yog bu tshe dpag bcas gnas spos byas shing zhol dpar khang du tshogs 'du gnang skabs skyed byed mchog gi zhabs phyi lta bur bskyod/tshogs 'dus mi mang mthus mi hrag bsdus gnang bar skyed byed mu mthud mthus mi'i khongs bdams thodan byung nas tshogs 'du'i bka' bzhin/ skyed byed kyi sku'i nyen srung ched bod dmag gnyis sgo srung du btsugs/ ngo da dmag gis nga tsho ngo ma shes par 'gog skabs nga'i bsam par skyed byed ni gzhung dmangs tshang mas yid ches thugs re gnang 'os kyi gnad yod mi sna zhig yin pa'i tshor snang dang/ lta stangs gsar pa 25

26 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/zhig 'dzin dgos byung nas skyed byed mchodag la sngar lhag gus brtsi zhu 'os shig tu gyur/bod zla 2 tshes 11 nyin tho rengs mtshams su nub phyo gas nas 'ur 'ur zer ba'i sgra zhig thos par skyed byed mchog dang nga tshos thog steng nas nyams zhib skabs/ nor bu gling kha khul du dmag 'thab byed 'go dzaXgs/ grong pa g.yas g.yon ceras da dmag langs 'dug ces dngangs skrag gis dmag grabs byed/ nga dzarta so sos dad mos byed pa'i mazon srung gyodan pa dang nga tshor me mda' ji'i ka'ang gcig yod pa der mde'u 50 sgo ra yod pa dang / me mda' pi si tog gcig yod pa der mde'u grangs 25 tsam yod par rnams gra sgrig gi sdod mur zhogs pa chu dza da 9 tsam la dmag spyi khang nas bang mi zhig sku nga ste/ dmag drung nas mi mang 'thus mi rnam pa tsho'i me mda' rtsis bzhes par phebs rogs gsungs kyi 'dug ces lan brda 'byor bar/ skyed byed mchodag nas zhabs phyi tshe dpag ngos gnyis la me mda' rtsis len du 'gro dgos gsungs pa ltar bskyod de/ dmag spyi khang nas me mda' dbyin ji kha thung grangs bdun/ dbyin ji kha ring grangs bzhi/ rtse gri rang 'grig dang /mde'u stong sgam gcig dang / nyis brgya rtsis sprod gnang /phran me mda' rtsis len gyi dmag spyi khang nas thodan sku/nga skabs 26

btsan rgodal rgyal gces kyi mthe rlabs/ 27rgya mis grib phyogs nas me sgyogs kyi mde'u bya 'ang gu'i khyu tshogs 'phur ba bzhin pho brang la brgyab pa'i shugs rkyen gyis rang sar 'gyel byung /mi mang 'thus mi mang che ba lha sar bzhugs sku da stabs me mda' rtsis sprod bya yul med par gnas tshang du nyar zhing / de rjes lha sa sogasaci sa gnas gang sar nge da rgya phan tshun me mda' rgyag res byas te dmag 'khrug gi me lce shugs che 'bar/ bzhugs khri gling kha dang / lha sa'i skyid chu'i pha rol du gnas pa'i grib me skyogs dmag sgar nas rgya mis me sgyogs kho na shugs che bed spyod byas stabs/ nga tsho'i me mdas phar rgol byed par dgra bo gcig kyang mi mthong / gzhung gis rtsis sprod gnang ba'i me mda'i khongs nas nga tshos re re bdag nyar byas pa dang / zhol du gnas spos gnang ba'i mi mang 'thus mi yab gzhis phyag zur dkon mchog lha skyabs lags su me mda' gcig dang / mde'u 50 rtse gri rang 'grigs re rtsis 'bul zhus 'phros me mda' rnams/ zhol sdod mi mang me mda' med pa rnams la/ me mda' rtse gri rang sgrig re dang mde'u 50 rtsis sprod kyis byung 'dzin sa rtags sbyar ma re len dgos zhes skyed byed kyi bka' 'brel ltar byas/pho brang nub ngos rnam grwa'i grwa shag gi go thal bsho yul ri 'bur steng nas‘ bod dmag gnyis kyis me shin ghan shugs che brgyab par/ rgya 27

28 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/mis khong gnyis la dmigs te me sgyogs re rgyag skabs thal rlung gi kho da nas khong gnyis mthong rgyu med pa thengs gnyis tsam byas/ dgra bos pho brang la me skyogs kyi mde'u bcu tsam sdebs cig la 'phen skabs pho brang dmar po'i btsag rdul dmar long nger shugs che langs te/ yud tsam pho brang mjal rgyu med par gyur skabs/ da ni pho brang gtor bshig mi bzod pa byung song snyam nas blo pham sems 'tshab che yang / de nas btsag dmar gyi rdul rim bzhin yal skabs pho brang sngar bzhin brjid chags ngang khra lham mer mjal skabs sems dga' ba dang / pho brang ni sra mkhregs ha las ngo mtshar che ba zhig yin pa'i tshor snang byung ba dang / chabs cig bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i shin tu yid skyo ba'i gnas tshul zhig nga tsho'i mi thog 'dis mthong song snyam nas sems skyo/skabs der zhol sdod mi mang rgan mo tshos bsang gasdudal byas te dgra bo'i me mda' dang me sgyogs kyi gnod 'tshe phog bzhin pa'i pho brang chen ngo ra kha gtad de sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nub pa dang / kha ba can 'di mi stong pa/ 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku tsher bar chad mi 'byung ba sogs kyi ngo gdong mchi mas khengs shing gdung shugs drag pos smon lam 'debs/ skabs der zhol btson khang du yod pa'i btson pa tshos kyang skyo snang dang dad gus chen pos pho brang la kha gtad de gong bzhin smon 28

btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi mtho rlabs/ na9lam 'debs bzhin 'dug de nyin zhogs pa dmag spyi khang gi dmag drung gnyis la me sgyogs phog ste sku srog shor/zhol chibs ra'i nang me sgrogs gnam glugs kyi mde'u lcags phog ste mi kha shas dang / rta dang mdzo mo kha shas shi rmas byung / dmag 'khrug gi me mda' dang me sgyogs kyi sgra'i khrod du rgya mis rgyang bsgrags nang rnam thar dang glu gzhas gtong ba dang 'brel khyod tsho mgyogs po mgo sgur ma zhus na/ sngon la bed spyod byas pa'i me sgyogs las shugs drag che ba'i me sgrogs dmar po kha phye nas po ta la thal bar gtong gi yin/ zhes sdig mo byed skabs khong khro dang skyo snang ha cang chen po byung /skyed byed mchog dmag spyi mkhan chung gi gzim shag tu bzhugs skabs dmag mi'i 'go khrid tshos lcags po ri shor song zhes snyan seng zhus par/ dmag spyi mchog nas rtse la yod pa'i me sgyogs rnams gcig bsdus kyis lcags po ri btsan bzung byed pa'i rgya dmag la phar rgol byed pa dang / chabs cig dmag mi khag gcig btang ste rang sa len thabs byed dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ bod dmag gis nus shugs gcig sgril gyis phar rgol byas stabs slar yang lcags po ri bod dmag gis yud tsam bzung thub kyang / rgya dmag rnams de nas phyir 'then gyis sngar bzhin me sgrogs drag char babs pa ltar brgyab stabs bod dmag mang po shi rmas 29

3༷ nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/byung ste/ mthar rgya mis lcags po ri nas drag po'i me mda' brgyab ste phan tshun 'gro 'ong bya rgyur dka' nyen sdon ma zhig 'phrad/bod zla 2 tshes 12 dgo nga dod mi mang rgas wa rgan mo mang po zhig gis dmag spyi'i gzim shag tu bcar nas rgya mi dang bka' mo la gnang rgyu sku da na gnang mo gas/ gal srid bka' mo la gnang thabs med na gnas skabs mgo sgur na ma gtogs pho brang dmar po thal bar gaho nga thag chod red/ ces ngu 'bod byed/ skabs der gang yong med pa'i dkrog gtam zhig la sang nyin bod tshes 13 nyin a ri'i gnam gru lnga brgya tham pa bod la rogs ram yodang gi red zer ba thos stabs/ der re ba chen po byas te phran dang bu tshe dpag nga chos khag gcig gis mang tshogs la mgo skur rgyu med/ sang nyin a ri'i gnam gru lnga brgya tsam zhig nga rang mo ra mo gas ram yong gi yod pas/ nga tsho sa gro gas ram de tshang ma yong bar tshang mas sdug rus byed dgo sa la/ phar me mda' ma brgyab par sdod dasga sa zhes dril bsgrags byas kyang phan nus ma thodan par dgo nga dro nyi ma la ru ma bzhud mtshams/ lo la lcags ri'i steng nas mi kha shas kyi kha btags g.yugs te mgo sgur pa'i rnam pa bstan/de dus sems sdug che zhing kha nas khrag dri phra gi 'dug phran nas skyed byed mchodag la 7rgyal ba rin po che gang gnang gi red dam/ zhes 30

btsan rgol rgyal gces kyi mthe rlabs/ 31bka' 'dri zhus par khong biriri/ 7rgyal ba rin po che bod tshes 8 nyin nor gling nas rgya gar du phebs bgrod zin pas blo bde po gyis gsungs byung bas/ 7rgyal dbang rin po che rgya gar 'phags yul du chibs bsgrur zin pa gzhi nas shes te bsam blo'i rdog khres phab thub/dmag spyi mkhan chung dang / skyed byed mchog gi chos grogs dang mdza' mthun 'thab grogs yab gzhis phyag zur lha skyabs/ nga rang / bu tshe dpag bcas nga chod mnyam du bros byol du phebs rgyu'i bka' gros byung yang / nga chos gnas tshang du gra sgrig byas te dus tshos gang 'tshams song nas dmag spyi bzhugs yul du bskyod skabs dmag spyi bros byol du phebs zin 'dug de nas nga tshos dngul dang / rtsam pa/ ja mar phran bu sdog ste me mda' thung mda' gnyis dang / rtse gri gnyis/ mtshon srung bcas gra sgrig gis bskyodad rtsis byas shing / skabs der yab gzhis phyag zur gyi ngo mkhyen pa mi dar ma zhig 'dug pa des kyang khyed rnams gang du phebs kyang mnyam du 'khrid rogs gnang / gal te 'chi yang 'gyod pa med ces u nan byas stabs kho rang mnyam du 'khrid rgyu gnang ste nga chod mi lnga gnas tshang khyim nas thon skabs/ nga'i gcung mo rang lo bdun la son pa bsod nams byedal ma mig chu phrum phrum bzhur bzhin/ nga yang mnyam du 'khrid rogs zhes ngu 'bod byed skabs sems ha cang skyo po 31

32 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/byung zhing / spun mched dang kha bral dka' ba zhig kyang byung /stabs mi legs par de'i dgong mo'i zla 'od gsal bas/ nga tsho pho brang gi shar chen lcog ngos su 'gro bskyod byed skabs lcags po ri nas dgra bos mthong ste/ me mda' brgyab stabs ma thar bar phyir log gis skyed byed mchog dang / yab gzhis phyag zur gnyis bka' gros gnang ste da rgya mis gsod kyi yod kyang las red bakhrod thabs med ces gsung res kyis bzhugs rgyur thag bcad/ de'i sang nyin nyi ma ri rtser shar tsam la gnam gru zhig slebs byung bas/ a ri'i mo gas ram gnam gru min nam bsam pa'i re ba chen po byung yang / de ni dgra bo'i gnam gru red/ de nas rgya dmag mang ngo snyadal du yong nas khyodad tsho'i nang yod mtshon cha che chung tshang ma de gar rtsis sprod byed dgos/ gal te khyab bsgrags byas rjes mace na cha rtsis sprod ma byas par nga dza sa zhib bsher byas nas mchosan cha thon na nag nyes chen ngo ra brtsis te thag gcod nan po byed kyi yin zhes brdzod//32

shāsdi pa/mi yul gyi dmyal me myong 'go tshugs/dus de nas bzung nga tsho bod gangs can pa rnams ches kla klo dang /ches mun nagaches gdug rtsub/ches log spyod kyi dgra bo'i dbang bsgyur 'og mi yul gyi dmyal ba dngos su myong 'go tshugs/ de nas mchodan cha tshang ma zhol gzhung sgo'i 'og tu rtsis len byas shing /gzhung sger gnyis ka'i mdzadan cha rtsis sprod byed skabs gzhung gi me mda' rnams ches kha gsar yin stabs rtsis sprod byed dus phangs sems chen po byung / rgya dmag gis rtsis len byas pa'i go mcho na rnams la 'dra dpar mang po brgyab/de rjes khyim tshang so so'i nang yod pa'i mi tshang ma phyir thon dgos brjod par mi tshang ma gzhung lha re 'gram yong skabs mchodan cha med pa rnams phyogs gcig sdod dgos pa dang /mtshon cha yod pa rnams phyogs gcig sdod dbo sa bshad stabs/gzhung zhabs dpon rigs tsha rong dza sag dang /

34 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/mu bya mda' dpon/ gsum mdo rim bzhis mamon skyed byed mchog dang /yab gzhis phyag zur lha skyabs lags bcas nga tsho me mda' yod mkhan dza phyogs gcig tu bsdad/me mda' yod mkhan nga tsho'i phyogs der mi grangs phal cher tshod dpag byas na 200 tsam sku/da pa rnams lag gnam la bsgrengs bcug ste/ rgya dmag gis me kam mnan cesag gis nga tsho bang gsum sgrig bcug nas klu sbug nag ther gyi thang chen thog 'khrid skabs/ bod mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren pa rgya mi'i lto zan bod rigs bud med kha shas kyis nga tshor bltas te mthu lud 'phen pa dang / pang gdan brdabs nas log spyod pa khyod tshor gung khran tang gis che ba gso/ ga tshod byas kyang nyan 'jog ma byas pa'i 'bras bu red/ phan po byung zhes sdug thog sdug rtseg gi kha rdung btang bas snying mgo rting log pa lta bu'i blo pham dang khong khro che yang gnas skabs khro sems mnan nas sdo rgyu las gzhan bya thabs dbeen/bod dmag lnga la bod gzhung gi me sgyogs 'khor lo can (ha wa dza ra )chen po zhig 'drud bcug ste/ rgya dmag gi lam g.yas g.yon nas me kan mnan chog gi 'bo ba mthong skabs sems sdug dang skyo snang chen po byung / nga tsho 'dzin bzung byas pa'i mi rnams sa la sdod bcug ste/ nga tshor ming dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi go gnas ji yod/34

mi ༷༅la gyi dmyal ba myong 'go tshugs/ 35ngo log zing 'khrug nang dmigs bsal las 'gan ga re yod ces mi re ngo rer tho blangs rjes rang skyong ljongs zer ba'i phyogs nas mo ṭa 'jib 'kho ra gcig slebs nas nga tsho 'dzin bzung byed mkhan dmag dpon zhig nas 'di mu bya red/ 'di tsha rong red/ 'di gsum mdo red ces 'jib 'kho ra nang yong ba'i rgya dmag gzhan der rtsis sprod kyis/ gzhung zhabs dbu 'khrid khong rnam gsum 'jib 'khor nang bcug ste rang skyong ljongs zer ba'i phyogs su 'khrid/skabs der mi kha shas kyis khong rnams gsod par 'khrid pa red ces shub bur brjod/ nga'i bsam par btson 'jug gi sdug sbyong tshad med gtong ba las gsod kyi ma red bsam/ de skabs drung 'khor snar skyid kyi dmag zhwa zhig bzhes 'dug par/ rgya mi'i zhi drag dpo na rigs khu/ shas yong ste dmag dpon gcig gis thung mda' zhig lag tu 'khyer te snar skyid khong gi dmag zhwa der me mda' btsugs/ snar skyid kyi thugs la kho rang srog thog gtong gi red bsam pa'i dgongs tshul byung nas khong gis phyag ya gcig gnam la bkyag nas/ 6/ la tog byurgam bsdokyigs rogs/nga skad cha tshig gcig shod rgyu yod gsungs par/ dmag dpon des khyodad rang gsad kyi ma red ces bod gzhung gi dbu gnas mtshon pa'i spa lcog mdun du bton pa dang / dmag zhwa rgyab tu gasku ga nas 'dra dpar zhig 35

36 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/brgyab/ skabs der 'dre dmag de tsho'i byed stangs la gzhigs na khong rang dmar gsod gtong rtsis yod pa'i dgongs tshul byung yang / a la skad cha tshig gcig shod du bcug mo gas zer gsungs te 'jigs zhum med pa'i rnam 'gyur der yid smon skyes/ de nas nga tsho ru gnyis sgrig gi lha sa'i phyo gas su 'khrid/ lam kha'i g.yas g.yon ngo da mi mang snga bsad pa'i ro mthong /lha sa'i bar bskor brgyud ka ṇi sgo bzhi'i 'gram du slebs skabs ka ṇi sgo bzhi'i mchod rten dbu rtse me sgyogs kyis gtor te sa la lcung / de bzhin snang rtse shag las khungs kyi lharware g.yas g.yon bkal ba'i khrims rgyugs kyang sa la lhang / ra mo che brgyud skabs skya chas spras pa'i bla ma rgyud pa mang po bsad 'dug de nas nga dza gzim shag bon zur nang 'khrid/ bon zur gyi sgo ra'i steng shod bar gsum la 'dzin bzung byas pa'i ser skya mang por rgya dmag gis mtha' bstodar te bsdad/ nga cho bon zur gyi sgo ra'i nang bzhag ste de'i dgong mo gnam gshis grang ngar che yang mi 'argang mar nyal gos sogs ga la yod/bu tshe dpag ngos gnyis nas der yod rta sbang skam gses byas pa rnams gang thub rub rub bzos te skyed byed mchodag gi bzhugs gdan du phul/ mtshan mo nam phyed tsam la skyed byed mchog gi snyan g.yu bkrol 36

mi yul gyi dmyal ba myong 'go tshugs/ 37te thugs smon mang po zhig gnang nas khyod gnyis phal cher glod bkrol gtong gi red/ nga blos bta/nga zin/ nang mi tsho thug skabs nga la sems khral mi dgos/ de las khyed cho 'cham po dang lta ba ma log pa byed rogs zhes ngas zer gyi 'dug ces brjod dgos gsungs pa dang / thugs smon gnang ba'i snyan g.yu de nga la gnang nas rab byung na g.yu de rgyal ba rin po cher 'bul thabs byed dgos/ gal te 7rgyal ba rin po cher 'bul ma thub na rdzong gsar mkhyen rtse rin po cher 'bul thabs byed dgos zhes bka' mngags gnang / skyed byed mchog gi snyan byil dang / snyan g.yu gnyis ka med par snyan cog stong par song stabs sems ha cang skyo po byung zhing / tha mag sgam chung nang rdzas dngul shog zhig ril ril bzos nas snyan cog la bsgron pa 63na/sang nyin bod zla 2 tshes 24 nyin zhogs pa bon zur lha lcam gyis steng thog nas skyed byed mchog 'dzin bzung khongs yod pa gzigs te/ zhabs phyi zhig brgyud khong la bod ja khog stir gang dang / gsol ja mngar mo ja dam gang / zhal stob bag leb che ma gang bcas 'bul bar btang ba rnams rgya dmag gis brtag zhib byas te len du bcug byung /skyed byed mchog dang nga tshos ja dang bag leb phran tsam bzhes rjes khong 37

38 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gis nga tsho'i nye 'gram du yod pa'i bka' drung ldum ra lags zhu ba'i gzhung zhabs bgres po zhig 'dug pa der/ gsol ja dang bzhes bag 'bul —dgos pa dang / de bzhin g.yas gasku na mi rnams la gse la ja dang bzhes bag gang khebs byed dgo sa gsungs pa ltar byas/ de rjes rgya dmag gis da lta chu grang gis spags za'am/ cung nas chu 'kho la gyis spag za/ zhes dris par/ mi tshang mas da lta chu grang gis spag za yi yin/ zhes brjod kyang / mi tshang mar kha phor med pas bon zur gyi ra 'khor nang sdod bod mi tshos phag kring lha nga pa mang po zhig dbyug byung ba'i nang spags bzas shing / bka' drung ldum ra lags zhu ba'i gzhung zhabs bgres po der rtsam pa gzed pa gnang ched mgo skur skabs kyi kha btags de'i nang / rtsam pa gzed de macod skabs nyam thag pa'i gnas tshul de lta bu mthong ba thengs dang po yin pas ha cang sems skyo ste/ da ni mi mthe nga rgu mthodang mthodang ngo snyam / de nas thodag steng nas rgya dmar zhi drag las byed tshos mi tshang ma zhwa mo phud dbo sa zhes bka' btang ba ltar/ tshang mas zhwa mo phud cing /de 'dra zhwa mo phud bcug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs sku drag yin min gyi mgo bor spa lcog yod med brtag dpyad byed ched yin chod/gang 'tshams shig nas rgya mi'i dmag srid dpon rigs lnga tsam 38

mi yul gyi dmyal ba khyedang 'go tshugs/ 39zhig gi lag tu me mda' thung mda' re brgyag chog gi nga cho mang tsho gas khrod yong ste/ dmag dpon zhig gis bka' drung ldum ra yar longs zer rdog rgyag gzhus te yar bslangs pa dang / de nas pha lta phyag mdzod spel gong yar longs zer nas mar dkyil nas spu bton pa ltar skyed byed mchodag 'khrid skabs/ ngas kho nga la 'thams 'khyud kyis nga mnyam du sku nga gi yin/ zhes brdzod par khong nas khyod 'chi bar yong ngam/ phar rgyugs zhes shugs che gsungs pa ma zad/ rgya dmag gis khyedad ga re yin nam phar rgyugs zer 'bud rgyag btang /ngas ngu 'bod byed bzhin phar u tshugs kyis 'di nga'i pha yin/nga tsho gnas tshul gcig yin/ nga yang mnyam du 'khrid mo gas brjod par/g.yas g.yon yod pa'i mi rnams kyang sems ha cang skyo ba'i rnam pa bstan pa'i ngang bu lags khyed rang gang byed par phebs kyi yod/ tshur phebs zhes nga la sha tsha'i rnam 'gyur gyis bshad/ nga gnyisku/ pha bu gnyis drag pos gson bral gtong ba'i nyam thag pa'i gnas tshul mthong mkhan tshang ma skyo snang gis mig chu bzhur/ bris mtshams 'dir slebs dus da lta'ang sna la na zug gtong gi 'duganyin de nas bzung nga'i tshe 'dir bskos pa'i byams brtse che la bstan srid mi rigs la gces zhen che ba'i skyed byed mchog dang nam yang 39

40 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/yid skyo ba'i ngang zhal bral/ bon zur gyi steng shod bar gsum la bcug bzung byas pa'i nang nas ngo log zing 'khrug gi byed gte'i ming btags pa'i skyed byed mchog khong rnam pa'i gras mi grangs bcu gcig dbye 'byed kyis bang sgrig nas phyi la 'khrid/nga chod mang tshogs rnams mi grangs nyi shu re tsho gas chung re bzos te bcu dpon rgan gzhon re bsko bzhag byas te brjod don/ khyod tsho nor bu gling gar 'gro dgos/ lam bar dmag mi'i bka' la brtsi srung yag po zhu dgo sa/ se ra khul da lta dmag thag chod med pas dmag mis mgyogs po rgyugs zer na mgyogs po 'gro dgos pa dang / mar lha da zer na mar bsdad dgos sogs bskadad mngags byas/ nga tsho mi chig stong tsam yod pa rnams bang sgrig nas nor bu gling gar 'khrid pa'i lam kha'i g.yas gasku na la mi dang / rta drel du ma bsad/ lcags po ri me sgyogs kyis gyang ror btang zhing ri gsham bod dmag grangs med bsad pa dang bar zhi yang rtsa med btang / nor gling gzhung sgo'i 'gram du bod mi bsad pa'i sku phung ya nga ba mang po mchis/nga tsho sku srung dmag sgar du 'khrid de dmag sgar gyi thang steng bzhag nas rgya dmag dpon po zhig gis khyedad tsho tang dang mi mang gi dgra bo red/ khrims srung byas te bsdad na nga tshos gsar brje'i mi chos ring 40

mi yul gyi dmyal ba myong 'go tshugs/ 41lugs kyi srid jus lag len byas te khyod tsho'i tshe srog bde 'jags 'gan srung byed/ gal te gang byung gi 'gul bskyod byas nas srung dmag gis me mda' brgyab ste bsad na sdug gyong red/ shes sam/ zhes rnam 'gyur drag rtsub chen pos kha rdung btang / dgong dro gnam gshis grang ngar che bas nga tsho tshang ma ha cang 'khyag byung /sang nyin nas sku srung dmag mi'i sdod khang chung ngu re'i nang mi nyi shu nas sum cu bar bcug ste zla gcig lhag tsam sdod ring nga tsho tshang mar lus lnga ra shig brgyab/ nyin zhig yab gzhis phyag zur lha skyabs lags kyi bu mo dzadas mdza lags dang / nga'i gcen mo chos mtsho lags mnyam du nor gling dmag sgar gyi gyang ral pa zhig nas nga tsho phan tshun mthong res byung ma thag gcen mos a tsi blo yon lags pha gir 'dug ces brjod de skyed byed mchog gang du yod ces/ 'bod yong / phran gyis khong kha sngon bon zur nas 'khrid pa dang / yab gzhis phyag mdzod sku zhabs 'dir bzhugs yod ces brjod nas phyag mdzod sku zhabs gdan 'dren zhus te/khong gnyis sar mnyam bskyo da byas te ngu rgyu las gzhan bya thabs med kyang gyang ral de nas nga tsho phan tshun ngo 'phrad byung ba ma zad/ phyag zur lha skyabs lags nas nga tsho bde po yin/ sems khral byed mi dgos/ khyed tsho'i nang mi hrū bde thang yin nam/ zhes bde mtshams ngo sprod byed pa'i 41

4na nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/go skabs yud tsam byung / de min mi mang wa sa rang gi khyim mi rtsad gce da byed par slebs/nga tsho 'dzin bzung byas khongs nas bstan srung dang blang dmag mi sogs mi khag gcig rgya nag tu ngal rtsol sgyur bkod la btang / nga tsho mi mang che bar rgya mi'i zhi ba'i dpon rigs shig nas tshang ma tshogs chen bskong ste mi ni ngal rtsol la rten nas byung / ngal rtsol ni gzi brjid dang rlabs chen yin pa'i skor mang po slob 'khrid lta bu byas/ zla gcig nor gling du sdod ring ngo log zing 'khrug nang ji byas sogs kyi 'dri zhib mang po byas te mi kha shas sgru da 'artsodal btang /nyin zhig dmag dngo na zhig nas nga la 'dri zhib bya rgyur skad btang byung ba ltar bskyod skabs dmag dpon des 'di phru gu rang red/ gang 'dra byas nas 'dzin bzung byas sam/ zhes skad sgyur der rgya skad kyis shod skabs/ ngas mig ngo chod pa'i lha sa wa gling khul sdod kha che skad sgyur des kho rang btson pa yin yang rgya dpon der ngo dga' sprel las kyis/'di sa bdag gi phru gu red//ces bshad/ de nyin phal cher nga slod 'grol gtong ba 'dug kyang / stabs mi legs par skad sgyur kha che des gce da bskyal bas spyodad bkrol btang ma byung /42
