44 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rnga chen sgru ga khang bakhrod skrun gyi las grwar thodag mar slebs skabs lcags skud gzer ma ra mgos rwa ba bskor ba'i nang nga zo bcug ste/tshogs chen bskong cho gas kyis rgya mi'i dmag dawa na zhig gis khyedad dza tang dang mi mang la ngo log rgyab gtod dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs la lnga lha la byed mkhan/ mi mang la gnya' gce na bshu gazlo ga byed mkhan/mi sha za mkhan dang / mi khrag 'thung mkhan gyi skusteg spyodad pa zhig red/ krung go gung khran tang gis khyod tshor srid jus gu yangs dang mi chos ring lugs srid jus lag len byas nas ngal ce la sgyur bkod kyis mi gsar pa zhig yong re byed kyi yod/ dngos 'brel khyod tsho'i nag nyes la bltas na srog thog btang yang chung skyon red zer ba sogs/ rdzigs nyams nam mkhar mi shong ba bstan nas ngar shugs chen po sa kha rdung yun ring btang stabs/mi tshang ma 'jigs snang dang sems sdug chen po byung zhing / de nas nyin ltar sa rdo dbor 'dren gyi ngal rtsol byed dgos pas mi tshang mar ngal rtsol goms gshis med rkyen nga tsho mang che ba'i sgal par rma bzos pa dang / rkang lag la chu lgang thon nas dus shin tu 'khyol dka'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar stabs/ mtshams re zing 'khrug skabs me sgyogs sgyu ga ste ma shi bar phangs sems skyes pa dang / yang skabs 'gar dka' sdug ma bzod par snga rjes gnyis skyid chur rang srog lcebs grabs skabs/ rang srog rang gis bcad 44

rnga chen sgyu ga khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ 45na tshe lo lnga brgya'i ring rnam smin de ltar myang dkos pa'i bshad tshul dran nas rang srog lcebs ma phod/nyin zhig nga tshad btson pa mi grangs bcu tsam dbye 'byed kyis gser btul jo lags kyi bza' zla red zer ba zhig gis/ spyi cho gas rnying pa'i mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis mo ra drang po ma byas pa'i lo rgyus sdug bsngal zhu 'bod byed pa'i mang chodags kyi chodags rar/ kho mos bshad pa'i sdug bsngal zhu 'bod zer ba nyan par dmigs bsal gyis 'khrid de tshogs chen grol rjes las byed pas/ khyedad chongs mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi langs phyogs nas kha bral te/ tang dang mi mang gi phyogs su langs nas snga dran deng bsdur gyi bsam blo'i sgyur bkod dang / ngal rtsol sgyur bkod yag po gtang na 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam yod zer ba sogs dril bsgrags che/ba gso mang po byas/zla ba brgyad tsam ngal rtsodal sgyur bkod byas rjes nyin zhig btson pa yongs sgyu gas cerags chen bskong tshogs kyi tshogs chen thog ru chen gyi gtso bo'i 'bo khrid rgya dmag dru li yan (go ming /) zer bas gtam bshad byas te/ khyod tsho sa zla shas rnga chen slog khang 'dzugs skrun bya rim nang mi mang che bas ngal rtsol rlabarngashaṃ chen yin pa dang / nag nyes lnga sa 'dzin gyi sgyur bkod hur btson byas par brten khyod tsho de ring nas bzung 45

4snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ las mi ru khag tu bsgyur gyi yin/'on kyang tang gi srid jus la yid ches dang nag nyes ngos len gsal zhu mi byed mkhan dang / ngal sgyu la sgyur bskadad kyi rnam 'gyur yag po med pa mi nyung shas shig yod pas mi de tsho mu mthud nag nyes sngo sa len —gsal zhu dang / ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed dgos/ da lta mi de tsho'i ming tho bton rjes 'di gar yong dbo sa zhes khyab bsgrags byas te ru khag lnga pa'i bcu shog bzhi pa'i slo bzang yon tan zhes/ nga tsho mi grangs 82ming bton gyi tsha gas chen mdun yud tsam langs bcug ste mang tshogs la ngo sprod byas te tshogs chen grol/ btson pa lnga stong tsam mang che ba las mir bsgyur yang / nga chos nyung shas shig glod bkrol ma btang bas sems sdug che tsam byung / nyin de nga'i gcen mo chos 'dzoms lags kyi sku zla ye shes bsod nams lags glod bkrol las sgyur byung stabs khe nga gis rlo pham ma byed/ gtso bo gzugs por bdag gces yag po dang bde 'jags la gzab gzab gyis/ rim bzhin bden mtha' gsal gyi red/ngas gcen mo chodas 'dzoms lags yang yang thug par btang yong zhes gsungs nas kho nga gis nga la zas gos gang 'tshams gnang nas nga gnyis kha bral skabs phan tshun gnyis ka yid skyo po byung /nga tsho mi 82 yod pa de so so'i nyal gos 'khyer te bang sgrig 46

rnga chen gle ga khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ 47nas srung dmag gis rjes snyegs kyis glog khang a ma'i brag ri gshog yul du btang / ru chen dang po'i khongs nas kyang nyin der tshogs chen bskong nas mi mang che ba las sgyur gyis mi 80 skor/ nga tsho dang gcig mtshungs dbye 'byed byas pa rnams zla sgril btang nas mnyam du ru khag gcig bakhrodas/ nga tshor phyogs gcig nas nag nyes ngos len dang gzhan skyon ther 'don byed dgos/ byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel dgos zhes dril bsgrags slob gso yang yang byed pa dang / phyogs gcig sna sa nas brag rdo dawa ra 'dren byed bcug ste shin tu dza drag gi ngal rtsol skul 'ded byed thabs ni brag phye slel po gang dbor na lag 'khyer re len dgos pa dang / dgong dro lag 'khyer mang nyung bsdur nas nyung ba rnams la ngal rtsodal sgyur bkodad kyi rnam 'gyur yag po med pas/rgyu mtshan ji yin bsam blo'i rtsa ba sngog dgo sa zer ba dang / yang na bcu shog nang skyon brdzod 'thab rtsod kyang byed kyi yod la skabs 'gar dza drag gi las yin/ zhes bshad de nyin bzhi bcu tsam ring dgong dro'i chu tsho da bdun tsam nas las 'bo btsugs te/ sang nyin chu dza da bdun pa bar chu mod bcu gnyis ring dza drag gi ngal rtsol 'ar 'ded byas shing /skabs der gnam gshis shin tu grang ngar che bas grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal myong dgos/47

48 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/nga tsho btson ra de'i nang lha sa phreng ring btson khang nas btang ba'i btson pa brgya tsam yod pa dang / de'i nang bud med btson pa kha shas yod pa'i nang rgya mahrū bkra shis kyi btsun ma blo bzang chos nyid lags dang /em chi a nan lags kyi sku zla a yongs lags/ ko dngo na gnyer pa'i bu mo a skyid lags/ bsod nams bde chen lags/ (ha yang len par zer/) spyi mda'i za khang gi snyi'i lags/ 'brom stod tshe brtan sgrol ma lags sogs yod cing / khong tsho mang che ba bud med tshogs pa'i gras yin snyabs khong tshor lnga log zing 'khrug gi zhwa mo g.yogs te ngal rtsol sgyur bkod kyi ming btags nas don du mnar gcod zad mtha' med pa zhig myangs/btson khang de nang nga tsho rnga chen nas dbye 'byed byas pa'i btson pa brgya dang drug cu lhag tsam yod pa'i thog lha sa phreng ring nas btson pa pho mo snga rjes su 'byor ba grangs nyis brgya tsam bcas bsdoms btson pa bzhi brgya ma zin tsam yod pa rnams/ zla shas ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed ring sa rdib shor nas dus gcig tu rgyal gces spun zla mi grangs 12dus min sku srog shor skabs/ nga hrūs spun zla'i brtse gdung zab mo bcangs te sems sdug gis mig chu lhung lhung 'bab bzhin dngangs 'tshab ngang / spun zla rnams skyobs thabs gang yong byas te nga chosas sa 'og nas 48

rnga chen sgru ga khang sku gas kyi las grwar btang ba/ 49bton thub tsam byung yang tshang ma 'das grongs gyur/de rjes brag nyil nas btson grogs sbun zla gsum tsam skabs der sku srog shor ba dang / kha shas rkang pa chad/ skabs der nga rang yang tog tsam ma gtogs khong tsho'i mnyam du brag rdo'i 'og shor grabs byas/nga tsho'i tshe srog bde 'jags la 'gan srung med par 'jigs snang 'og rtag tu dza drag gi ngal rtsol byed dgos shing / ngal rtsol bya rim nang hur brtson gyi rnam pa thodan thabs shig ma byas na skyon brjod 'thab sna da rag nyen yod/ skabs 'gar bsam blo'i nang na tsha lci po zhig phog na snyam pa dang /yang skabs 'gar rmas skyodan zhig phog na sman khang la lus nas tsha grang gi sdug spyong 'di lta bu myong mi dgos par ngal gso brgyag rgyu yong gi red/snyam pa'i bsam tshul 'khor myong la nga dang 'dra ba'i bsam tshul 'khor myong mkhan btson grogs mang po yod/ de nas nyin zhig btson grol tshogs chen zhig bskongs tshogs byas nas btson pa mi grangs bzhi brgya lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nas mi grangs 350 tsam glod bkrol btang / nga chos mi grangs 50 tsam mu mthud sgyur bkod bya dgos kyi gras su bzhag nas sngar bzhin dud 'gro las zhan pa'i bkol spyod tsha grang gi sdug bsngal myong dgos par brten sems skyo po byung /skabs der nga'i gcen mo chos 'dzoms lags nga thug 'phrad du 49

50 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/phebs nas de nyin nga tsho'i btson pa'i 'go khrid las byed mdun ngu 'bod byas te/ btson pa mang che ba blo da bkrol btang yang nga'i spun mched thengs gcig min gnyis min glod bskadal mi galta nga ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin/zhes zhu gtugs byas kyang phan nus ga la thodan/ de nas na/ mthud btson khrung nang ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed mur/ nyin zhig dgong dro'i pe cing chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la nga chod mtshan las 'bo mi tsho sdod gur nang nyal sdod skabs/ lha sa'i shar phyogs khongs mi chod bzang yon tan zer ba zhig sku da pa red dam/ zer ba sogs nga chod mi kha shas shig ming 'phra da byas/nga tsho'i 'go khrid las byed bod rigs shig yod pa des khyod rang gi ming thod don pas/ nyal go sa tshang ma 'khyer nas lha sa spyi bde las khungs su 'apo dgos/ de nas khyod kyi gnas tshul thag gcod byed kyi red ces bshad de nyin de zhol khang phyag mdzod sku zhabs dang / 'brom stod tshe brtan sgrol ma lags/ pha lha'i gnyer pa dbang rgyal lags/ snang rtse shag gi khang gnyer lags sogs nga chod mi bdun ming bto/na dbye 'byed kyis rang rang so so'i nyal gos gang yod rnams sgal par 'khyer te bang sgrig nas lha sa'i phyogs kha gtad de 'khrid/nga tsho bang sgrig nas 'gro ba'i lam bar zhi drag las byed tsho sa nga tshor sdang zug chen po byed pa dang / lhag par du snang shag khang gnyer 50

rnga chen sgru ga khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ 51lags su dmigs bsal sdang zug gis de sngon nga tsho'i ngo shes tshong dpon bsam chos lags kyi g.yog po pho gsar zhig yod pa kho pa hūr brtson can gyi gras shig red/ kho pas snang rtse shag khang gnyer lags su gom pa mgyogs tsam spo dgos/ khyed rang de sngon mi mang la gnya' gnon bshu ga'og byed dus byed rgyu ga tshod yod/ ces sogs sdug thog sdug rtseg gi kha rdung mang po btang thog nyal gos dza dzor mang po bsnam rgyu yod stabs chad grabs byed/ nga rang lo na gzhon la nyal gos stabs bde las med pas dmigs bsal dka' ngal che ba ma byung /zhi drag las byed de chos nga la rnam 'gyur phran bu yag pa 'dug pas zhol khang phyag mdzod lags kyis phran la/ las byed de chosar nga tsho phran tsam ngal gso bzhag nas chu phran tsam 'thung bcug rogs gsungs dang / da phal cher thang chad nas 'chi ba 'dug ces gsungs/ phran nas khong tshor shin tu ya nga bas de don las byed tshor zhus pas kho pa tsho gros bsdur byas te tog tsam sdug rus byed dgos/ gsham gyi gur der slebs na ngal gso byed chodag ces bshad nas ngal gso rgyag tu ma bcug par mu mthud tsha 'ded btang /mtshan mo chu tshod 10 tsam la de sngon 'jar man gyis brgyab pa'i smog khang yod sa der slebs skabs der las ka byed mkhan lha sa 5/

52 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ba mang po yod pa'i gur zhig nang 'khrid/ gur nang yod pa'i mi mang che ba nyal tshar yang / las byed de tsho sa nga tsho ra ja zhig ster rogs zer bas gur nang yod pa'i mi de tshos nga tsho ngo shes te tshang mas nga tshor gdung sems mnyam skyed kyis sems rtsa 'kho la sngo sa ja dang / spags/ tshal bcas ster ba ma zad/ nga tsho 'gro khar ngo shes tshos kha stodab sna tsho gas dang tha mag sogs mang po ster/las byed cig gis slo la khang phyag mjo da lags su spo bo rang 'gro mi thub na/ nga tsho'i rkang 'khor thodag khyodad rang gis nyal gos bzhag nas rkang 'khor khrid de phyin tshe/ tog tsam mgyogs pa 'bo thub mi yong ngam/zhes bshad par thugs rje che de ltar skyabs 'jug gnang rogs gsungs/de nas rkang 'khor the ga kho nga gis nyal gos tshang ma bzhaban nas bsdams bkyigs bya rogs byas shing / nga chod mu mthud 'gro skabs lo la khang phyag mdzod lags nas rkang 'kho ra 'khrid ma mkhyen par de bas dka' ngal byung stabs/ phran nas rgan lags rkang 'alta ra ngas 'khrid chog pa gnang rogs lab par de 'grigs kyi red bshad byung / nga'i nyal gos yang po yin stabs phyag mdzod lags su bskur ba dang / da dung nga'i nyal go sa kho ngas nas lci ba zhig rkang 'khor thog bzhag nas phyag mjo da lags su yang bzod byung ste/ khong mnyes po zhe drag byung nas thugs rje che/ khyed rang nga'i 52

rnga chen glog khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ 53phru gu las phan thogs che ba byung zhes gsungs/phyag mdzod lags nam rgyun nas sku gzugs thang po med par brten rnga chen du bzhugs skabs nga tso btson par sa rdo thengs re dbor bar lag 'khyer re sprod gnang mkhan yin/ khong gi nga la gsang ba'i sgo nas lag 'khyer snon pa mang po gnang myong zhing / des nga'i lus sems dka' ngal mang po sel ba'i bka' drin gsol rgyu yod pa rnams de nyin gsol ba'i go skabs dmigs bsal byung bar/ nga rang lus por dka' ngal che yang sems pa skyid po byung /dgong mo nam phyed mtshams su lha sa phreng ring btson khang du (lha sa grong khyer gyi lta srung khang zer ba/) 'byor 'phral btson srung bod mi las byed ye shes bstan pas nga tshor lus bsher byas te ngo shes tshos snying rjes ster ba'i kha stob rnams btson khang nang 'khyer mi chog ces 'phrog pa dang / de bzhin sged rag dang / jur sgrog tshun 'phrog nas nga dang phyag mdzod lags gnyis btson khang sgo dang po'i nang dang / pha lha'i gnyer pa lags kho nga tsho sgo ang gnyis pa/ tshe brtan sgrol ma lags bud med kyi btson khang khongs bcas su bzhagasang nyin nam langs skabs btson khang 'di nang btsog pa byur khengs red/ btson pa mang che ba dgon pa khag gi las sne dang / grong 53

54 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gseb khag gi gzhis sdod/ tshong pa/ mi tshang cung drag pa'i pha rgan sha stag red/ nga hrū ni shin tu dka' ngal dang / dza drag che ba'i las yul nas slebs pas btson khang nang ngal rtsol la 'gro mi dgos stabs dbugs ngal gso ba'i go skabs lta bu byung / de'i sang nyin btson khang re re byas te bsgu na pa rnams bang sgrig nas chab gsang galta nga bar 'khrid/ ngas btson khang sge'u khung nas lta skabs bud med chab gsang gtong bar 'gro mkhan nang nga'i gcen mo spen sgrol lags dang / pha lha'i lcam chung gnyis rgyang nas mthe nga skabs sems nang skyod snang shin tu chen po byung /zla gcig tsam song rjes slar yang dri ba len 'go tshugs te/ khyod kyis ngos len gsal zhu byas med pa dang / rnga chen du ngal rtsol sgyur bkod kyi rnam 'gyur yag po byung med/ der brten rang nyes ngos len dang /gzhan skyon ther 'ange na byed dbo sa/ tang gi srid jus ni kha gsal gu yangs dang sbas skum drag gce na la nam yang 'gyur ba med/ byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel thabs byed dgos/ da lta khyod rang lo na chung ngu red/tang dang mi mang srid gzhung nas khyod la re ba chen po gnang gi sku da/ nag nyes che chung ma yin par gtso bo tang srid la yid ches kyi ngo sa len rnam 'gyur la rag lus pa zhig red/ ngo 'o/ga zing 'khrug nang khyedad kyis gang byas blo khog chen ngo sa lnga sa len byed dgos pa dang / khyedad kyis pa pha dang 54

rnga chen sgru ga khang sku gas kyi las grwar btang ba/ 55gcen mos zing 'khrug nang gang byas rogs ram ther 'don byed dgos/de 'dra byed pa ni byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel zer ba de red/ byas rjes chen po bzhag na 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam mo da ces thengs mang zhu ba len yang / nga la pha dang / gcen mo'i nag nyes gang yang 'azer 'don bya rgyu med/ nga rang phru gu'i snang bas pha ma spun mched kyi las ka ji byas la do snang byed kyi med ces u nan brdzod par/ kho tshos khyod rang phru gu'i snang ba byed mkhan yin na nor bu gling gar log spyod pa mnyam du phyin pa ma zad/ bod rang btsan yin zhes skad 'bod byed skabs log spyod kyi 'bod tshig skul mkhan byed mi thub brdzod/ngas nor bu gling gar phyin pa dang / bod rang btsan gyi 'bod tshig sgrog mkhan khungs su sku da pa las 'ange da tshig skul mab/ na yin pa'i khas ma blangs/ de nas zla shas song rjes btson pa'i 'tsho ba nyin bzhin je zhan je sdug tu song nas bce na pa tsho'i gzugs po'ang ha cang nyams zhan gyur te yar langs skabs mgo yur 'khor ba dang / dmar thom langs nas sa la 'gyel ba'am/ 'gyel grabs byed/ nyin re snga dgo nga chab gsang gtong bar sgo'i phyir 'gro skabs rang rogs bce na pa tshang ma'i ngo gdong dang / lag pa sogs skya ser la gyur nas mi tshang ma'i lus por khrag gtan nas e yod snyam pa'i gnas stangs skyo wa sku da pa mthong skabs 55

5snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang bstosbyang byung ba/sems ha cang skyo po yong /nyin zhig nga dza'ire btson khang gi btson pa tshang mas ma gros bsam pa gcig mthun gyis 'tsho ba legs bce sa byed dbo sa pa'i lha ra/ las byed phur bu sgrol mar re bdun 'don skabs kho mos gong rim la snyan seng zhu chog ces bshad/ de nas btson khang 'o krang nor bu rdo rje yong nas nga tsho'i tsu'u krang gnyis zur du skad btang nas khyod tsho'i tsu'u nang btson khrims la brtsi srung med par/ ltog skad brgyag dgos zhes thodag ma skul slong byed gte su yin/ nges par rtsis sprod byed dgos zhes nan 'dri byas 'dug la/ de rjes tsu'u nang lan kho'i krang dang / (tshal smad bu rgya ma bod/) nor bu rdo rje gnyis yong ste don der tsha nan gyis dris kyang tshang mas byed gte dang ngan skul byed mkhan med/ de ni nga mo tshang ma'i re ba yin/zhes mi brgya kha gcig lta bu byung bas/ kho pa chodar byed thabs med par gyur nas mthar lan khotshe/ krang nas deng skabs rgyal yongs su thon spel skra/na chung gi las 'gul spel bzhin yod pas/ spyi tshogs steng gi mi mang gi 'tsho ba'ang dka' ngal sku da/ khyedad tsho nyes can tsho'i 'tsho ba legs bcos 'gro rgyu khag po red/ ces 'grel bcadad byas pa tsam las de min bya thabs dmigs bsal ma byung /56

rnga chen sgru ga khang sdudags kyi las grwar btang ba/ 57nga zo btson khang sgo dang po'i nye 'khris btson sgo ang gnyis pa'i nang sbra zhol rgya mdza bkra shis kyi thub bstan mkhas btsun lags yod pa khong dang / ngo sa gnyis skabs de'i btson pa'i nang nas lo na chung shos kyi gras yin la/ kho nga gi a ma lags dang nga'i gcen mo spen sgrol lags gnyis 1959 'o/ra bod sger langs las 'gul skabs bud med tshogs pa'i 'thus mi gcig pa'i 'thab bo gas yin pa dang / yang khong gi gcen mo dang nga'i gcen mo spen sgrol lags gnyis btson khang nang btson rogs dang slo mthun dam gtsang zhig red/ngo sa gnyis kyang blo mthun dam gtsang zhig yin zhing / nga gnyis skabs re ngal rtsol so/gas mnyam du khel nas ru star sgrig 'gro dus/ nga gnyis kyi gral mnyam du khel ba byas nas ngal snyungal gyi lag cha 'jo ra dang sbyag ma me mda' yin khul dang / ngos gnyis bod rang btsan gyi 'thab 'dzings pa yin zhes phan tshun shodad res byed pa ma zad/ skabs 'gar mnyam 'dzoms skabs re 'dod phugs bsam skor snying gtam shod res dang / sems gso bskul lcag byed pa/ de skabs 'azo ba shin tu zhan la nang mi'i ca dngos len srol ye nas med stabs za 'thung gi rigs dang /'then rgyu'i rigs ha cang dkon stabs snga dgong chab gsang du btson khang sgo phye nas su sngon du btang yang gsang spyod g.yas g.yon du srung dmag 57

(8 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gis dbyugs pa'i tha mag 'then 'phro rnams bsgrugs nas lnga sa gnyis phan tshun sprod res byed pa/ gcin pa'i nang gi tha mag kyang ha cang zhim po yong gi yod/yang nga tsho'i btson khang nang lha sa ba kha che 'a man nu'u zer ba rgya gar gyi glu gzhas dang / wa da gzhas nang ma'i rigs shin tu mkhas pa zhig sku da pa/ lnga sa gsum ngal rtsodal mnyam khel skabs glu gzhas btang ste ngal dub dang ltogs bkres kyis mnar ba'i nyin ring po de mgyogs tsam 'khyol thabs byed kyi sku da/ btson khang nang bsnyu na khrims dang 'gal ba'i gnas tshul phran tsam byung na'ang lam seng rkang lcags dang lag lcags brgyab kyi yod pa dper na/ nga tsho'i btson khang nang de sngon 'phan po mkhar rtse rdzong gi rdzong tshab byams pa cho gas nyid lags kyis tsu'u krang rgyal lags su phran bu rnam 'gyur ngan pa thon pa'i nyes par rkang lcags lo gcig tsam brgyab/de bzhin stag lung zhabs drung rin po che'i gsol dpon rmi rmi zer ba des rin po cher snga dgo nga btson khang nang la gzim chas yar bsdus mar bzos byas par/ stag lung zhabs drung gis btson khang nang du'ang bran g.yog ring lugs mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs byed kyi yod pa'i nyes ming btags nas zhabs la lcags brgyab ste yun ring bzhag de 'dra ba'i btson khang nang rkang lcags lag lcags brgyab pa mang ngo mo da pa de chod phran 58

rnga chen sgru ga khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ 59bu 'gro bzo sdod mkhas ma byung ba'i nyes pa tsam las don dngos nag nyes zhi/da pa min/btson pa tshang ma sdug thog sdug rtseg gi nyes pa phog yong bsams nas sems khral 'jigs snang gis 'gul med lha gral sgrig pa ltar sdociod dgos/ de bzhin btson khang nang bsgu na pa phan tshun 'thab snyungad byed bcug pa'i dpe mahrūn ni btson grogs a mdo ye shes zer ba zhig yod cing /khong rgya gar nang yod pa'i mi zhig dang 'brel ba yod pas gsang nyul gyi las ka byed kyi yod dogs kyis dgong mo mang po chu tshod bzhi tsam 'thab rtsod sdug sbyong sna mogs btang ba ma zad/ rkang lag la lcags yod pa'i dbang gi shig sgrug dang shig brjes byed ma thub pa'i dmigs bsal dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i skabs/ phran gyis kho par gdung sems mnyam skyed kyis shig sgrug rogs dang / chab gsang la 'dzad ba/ nyal chas baX ba sogs la rags pa byas/nga sa skabs 'gar btson khang phyir ngal rtsol la gtong skabs kho pa'i bza' zla dbang mor bde 'tshams dang / dgos mkho lan bskur rnams dam dodan 'alnga da thabs/ phyi nas nang mi lnga thug dang ngo shes/ mi mang bcas kyi gdung sems mnyam skyed kyi za rgyu ster ba rnams bsngo na khang nang 'khyer mi chog kyang / thabs shes kyi nyen khar ma 'dzems par phran bu thar / 59

snyo0 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/thabs byas nas ye shes dang / de min rkang lcags lag lcags sku da pa'i bcoman rogs rgya mi kraso/ wun tshal mo gas la ster skabs kho mo sa nga la yid ches dga' zhen dang / snying gtam lhug por shod kyi 'dug ngas khong gnyis la sems 'khur mo gas ram byas par bce na pa'i nang nas rgya mir ngo dga' sprel lad kyis rang nyid la lta stangs yag po dang / gzigs bakhrodas bstod bsngags sogs mdun lam yong ched phra da mi rigs kyi la rgya dor ba'i sems med sdar ma nyung shas shig gis phran la/ ye shes la rogs ram byas pa ni mi ngan las ngan la ngan skyor byas pa zhig red ces skyon brdzod byas kyang / rang nyid la nyes skyon yong rgyur ma 'dzems par rogs ram mtha' 'khyedangs byas /btson pa tshor nyin re rtsam pa srang bzhi dang / dgong dro thug pa chu masdadag log tsam zhig las med stabs ltogs shi thebs grabs byed kyang / da dung bal las sprun dog ha cang phra mo 'khal bcug ste daswong drod spun dog 'khal mang nyung gi grangs 'awa ra rgya mar bkyag nas rgya tshad ma lon pa dang / spus tshad kho pa tsho'i 'dod slo khengs pa zhig ma byung na/nag nyes ngos 'dzin dang sgyur bkod rnam 'gyur yag po med pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa red/ ces bshad nas kha rdung gto/nga ba dang / la lar lcags brgyab pa sogs byas/ btson pa tshang ma'i gzugs po'i gnas 60

rnga chen glog khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ 61stangs shin tu nyam thag pa zhig yod pa dang / nam rgyun gzugs lha bas che ba'i mi tsho'i gras sngon la 'das hrongs gyur/ de dus grib pa gsol thab slo bzang dpal ldan lags nas de sngon nor gling dang po twa lar 7rgyal ba'i gsol thab kyi phyag las gnang skabs kha zas snyu/ga thung dang /mi nyag spo slog bag tsha mar khu sku gas bzas skor dang / spyi lo 1954lor 7gong sa mchog rgya nag tu zhabs sor 'khod dus chibs zhabs gso/la thab tu bskyod skabs rgya nag nas gsol tshigs sgrog tse btang skor gsungs skabs/ mi tshang ma 'gram chu 'kho la gyi yod/yang / khong gi skabs 'gar a tsi gnam nas rtsam pa thang khug gang mdun du rdobs zer zags rogs bya na gang drag ces yang yang gsungs/ de skabs btson khang nang nyin re'i rtsam pa slebs skabs dri zhim mngar sing nger kha ba dang / rtsam par de lta bu'i dri zhim yod pa skabs der ma gto/gas shes rtewags ma myong / rtsam pa za skabs mngar seng gi bro ba ni deng sang ro bcud ldan pa'i tan shin la sogs pa'i lto chas gang bzas pa las zhim mngar che/ skabs de'i bsam blo'i nang de sngon rang btsan skabs kyi 'tsho ba ni dngos 'brel bde skyid yin pa dang / 'jig rten na zhim lha sa ni ltogs pa'i zas yin/ zhes pa ni bden pa yin pa shes rtogs byung / de rjes rgya sran gyi rtsam pa rjen dri yod pa zhig ster 61

snyo2 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rjes bce na pa mang lnga khrag bshal nas nyin rer ha lam mi bcu grangs 'das hrongs gyur/ nyin zhig nga'i gral rogs gnyis ka 'das cadangs gyur ba'i dkyil nas langs dbo sa pa'i gnas tshul byung /skabs de dus gro mo dge bshes rin po che'i yongs 'dzin lha ram dge bshes byams pa chodas 'phel lags kyang bsgu na khang sgo rtsa'i lam du 'gyel bas/ las byed pas kho phar tsam gyi gsang spyodad nye 'gram du zhog ces brdzod byung bas nga tsho btson pa gsum gyis khong nyi ma yod sa zhig tu bzhag rjes/ chu chodad gcig tsam nas dgongs pa cadags/ de rjes phran gyis cung ngo shes gras stag brag rin po che'i yab de sngon phra da gzhung gi gzhung zhabs thub bstan rig mchodag lags dang / rtse drung rgyal dzadas lags/em chi a nan lags sdunags zla ba sa/cig gi dus chosad nang dus min 'das grongs gyur/ phreng ring btson khang khang mig sum cu tsam yod pa'i nang btso na pa pho mo chig stong tsam yod/phran btson khang nang zla bdun tsam bcug ste nyin zhig lha sa'i shar phyogs bde chen phur me shing gcod par btang nas der phreng ring btson khang nas btang ba'i btson pa lnga bcu lha ra me shing gcod bzhin 'dug nyin re me shing bcad de khres po 'khyog tshad re sa thag ring po nas dbor 'dren dbo sa kyi sku da stabs/ mi tshang ma ngal dub kyi mnar 62

rnga chen sgru ga khang se gas kyi las grwar btang ba/ 63yang dgong dro khang chung gnyis nang mi lnga bcu yongs rdzogs ra lug bcug pa ltar lhod por sdod pa'i gu yul med/ dgong mo zhig phran slo bur stod gzer brgyab ste mtshan gang gnyid ma khug par a ru a ru zhes skad ngan brgyab nas sdod dgos byung ba dang / sang nyin der las kar 'gro ma thub par dgongs pa zhus nas sdod skabs rgya mi 'go khrid ya nga snying rje spu tsam med pa kha gdang tshad la rma'o g.yang kung /(las g.yol/) rma'o g.yang kung zhes gshe gshe gtong mkhan zhig yod/ kho pas btson khang nang lag lcags shig 'khyer te bskor ba brgyab par sku nga nas khyod rang las kar ma phyin par sdod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhes dris par/ nga mdang dgong mtshan gang na nas da lta drag mi 'dug pas/ dgongs pa zhus pa yin/ zhes shod skabs khyod las g.yodal byas pa red/ ces brdzod nas las kar skul 'ded byed rtsis kyang phran 'gro mi thub stabs/ lag lcags blta na nas brgyag gi yin/ zhes bshad kyang las kar 'bo ma thub pas kho ba ci bya lto sa bral du gyur nas btson pa'i ma byan la nga la rtsam pa dang ja ma sprod ces mngags te kho pa btson pa dmangs kyi rjes su phyin/der mi gnyis la lag lcags brgyab nas bzhag 'dug de rjes rgya rgan des phreng ring btson khang gi ther ge 'gro mkhan mnyam du nga phyir log btang byung bas sems mun 'thibs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal la dga' tshor 63

snyo4 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/chen po byung /phreng ring btson khang du 'gyor skabs de ga'i nad khang nang bzhag ste/ bce na pa nad pa cho ra brtag dpyad byed skabs 'cho ba ma 'dang pa'i rkyen red ces em chi tshang mas gcig gyur brdzod/ btson pa mang po ltogs shi thebs stabs nyin zhig sman rtsis khang gi sngaged mi em che khag gcig btso na khang nang nad par brtag dpyad byed par btang 'dug pas/khong choms bce na pa'i gzugs po'i gnas stangs shin tu nyam thag wa yod pa gzigs stabs/ yid skyod nas gdung sems mnyam skyed kyi rnam 'gyur bstan nas khyodad chod sems lhod po byas te sdod/ nga chodas khyodad tsho'i gzugs po'i gnas stangs rnams bo nga rim la snyan seng zhus te 'tsho ba legs bcos sku nga thabs byed kyi yin/ zhes gsungs/ de rjes dngos 'brel 'chod bar lta rtog phran bu drag tu song / spyi lo 19snyo0 lo'i lo mjug tu nyin zhig mtha' ma'i zhu ba yin zhes thengs gcig zhu ba len dodan/ khyodad kyi pha lnga 'o/ga zing 'khrug gi byed gte'i gras shig dang khyod kyi gcen mo yang de 'dra red/ khyed kyi pha dang gcen mo'i 'o/ga spyod langs phyogs dang kha bral nas tang dang mi mang srid gzhung gi phyogs su langs te/ khong gnyis la skyon bsngo da dang rogs ram byas te mi gsar pa zhig yodang ba'i re ba byed dgos/ de 'dra 64

rnga chen sgyu ga khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ snyo5byed thub min ni khyod 'od zer ldan pa'i lam phyogs su 'gro dang / mun nag gi lam du 'bo gnyis kyi dbye mtshams 'byed pa'i tshad gzhi zhig red/nga tsho'i re ba la khyod rang lo na chung chung yin stabs glod 'grol thob nas lag shes bzo las sam/ de min phru ba grwar rig gnas slob sbyong la bskyodad thub pa'i re ba yod ces dril bsgrags slob gso/ mang po byas/ phran nas skyed byed mchodag dang / gcen mo'i log spyod kyi bya ba sogs la skyon brjod dngos yod cig byed dgos kyang de ltar bya rgyu med ces brjod par/ zhu ba len mkhan rgya mi de dang skad sgyur gnyis kas/ da 'o na/ nga tshos khyodad skyabs pa'i thabs shes med pa red ces bshad nas zhu mtshams bzhag ste nyin lnga tsam 'gro skabs/ nga tsho btso na pa lnga thag gcod byed kyi yin zhes gsal bsgrags byas rjes khrims gcod dpyad khra lha ga sbyang byas pa'i nang don du/ slo bzang yon tan/ pho/ rang lo 16 bod rigs/ kho pa 1959 lo'i zla 3 tshes 10 nyin nor gling du bskyod nas ngo log zing 'khrug nang dalnga sa su zhugs pa ma zad dang blang gis ming thod brgyab pa dang / bod rang btsan yin/ rgya mi rngo da nas phar rgyugs shig ces sku/ga spyod kyi 'bod tshig sgro ga pa dang / phyi zla 3 tshes 27 nyin kho pas pa phar gzhogs 'degs kyis zhol dmag spyi khang nas me mda' 11 dang /mde'u 1200 blangs te mi gzhan la sprad nas tang dang mi mang la sngo 65

66 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/log kha gtad gce ga dgos pa'i ngan bskul byas pa ma zad/ phyi zla 3tshes 18 nyin zhol du dzadad pa'i mi mang nas tang gis dril bsgrags slob gsor yid ches brtsi srung zhus te mgo bo sgur dgos pa'i re ba byed skabs/ kho pas mang tshogs la mgo sgur rgyu med/ sang nyin a ri'i gnam grus nga dzargar rgyab skremar yod tshul dmo/ga gtam bshad nas mang tshogs la mgo bslor btang ba dang / sdig mo byed pa/ de bzhin gung khran tang gi srid jus ni ko ba rlon pa'i zhwa mo red ces 'o/ga spyod kyi dril bsgrags byas pa/ kho pas pa pha dang mnyam du phyi rgyal la bros byedal 'alha rtsis byas kyang / mi mang bcings 'asgo la dmag gis mtha' brnyedar ba'i ra ba nas thar ma thub par mthar mi mang gi khrims kyi ra ba'i nang tshud pa red/kho pa lo na ma mo na pa ma gtogs lo ga spyod kyi bsam blo'i ngan shugs kho pa'i pa pha las che ba yod ༷/gas sogs sgrog sbyang byas te dus bkag btson 'jug 'o/ 10 dang srid dbang lo bzhi 'a'o/ga pa yin zhes bshad/ de min mi bzhi thag gce da byas pa'i nang nas bud med a cag lha mo tshe ring lo tshad bdun/ de min mi gsum la lo tshad lnga nas drug bar btang / de nyin nga tsho lnga'i nang nas lo na chung shos nga yin pa dang /lo tshad mang shos nga red/ phreng ring btson khang ni ngal rtsol dud 'gro las zhan pa'i skul 'ded dang / 'tsho ba yi dwags lta bu bkres lha ma gyi mnar 66

rnga chen sgru ga khang se gas kyi las grwar btang ba/ snyo7bas don du dmyal ba mi yul du 'asgyu sa pa rang yin/19snyo1 'erware lo 'bo ra nga tsho btson pa mi grangs brgya tsam zhig rlangs 'kho ra nang srung dmag dang sbrags slar yang rnga chen spyodag khang las grwar bskyal nas/ der yod btson pa mi grangs lnga brgya tsam yod pa mnyam du ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed du bcug skabs der nga tsho phreng ring btson khang nas yong ba'i btson pa rnams gzugs po ha cang skyo po yod pas/spyir btang ngal rtsol skul nus bral ba sha stag yin yang / snying rje med par ngal rtsol skul 'ded byas 'og nyin mo mi 'khyol ba'i dka' sdug myong dgos byung / 1961 lo'i 'o/ mjug mtshams rnga chen glog khang spyir btang bskrun zin nas nga dza brgya cadag gcig snye thang rdza phag las grwar (3/na dba' khrang ) 'gro dgos kyi bka' btang nas rlangs 'kho ra gsum nang las byed dang / srung dmag sbrags te gtong skabs nga'i brtse ba'i gcung mo rig pad rang lo 13 se na pa rnga chen las grwar las kar yod pas/ gcung sna/sa nga rnga chen nas btang ba shes te tha mag rdar tshan gcig dang bu ram phran tsam 'khyer nas rlangs 'khor nye 'gram du ngu gin yong sne/ gcen po khyod tsho gang du 'gro mkhan red ces dris par/ ngas nga tsho snye thang rdza phag las grwar 'bo dasku sa kyi sku da pa 'dra/ nga la sems khral ma byed brdzod stabs gcung mos rlangs 'khor mjug tu ngu 'bod byed 67

68 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/bzhin slebs byung bas nga rang ha cang sems skyo po byung /snye thang rdza phag bzo grwar lo gcig tsam sdod ring / btson grogs sum cu skor glod 'grol btang yang nga rang da dung slod 'grol ma thob de rjes 1962 lo'i lo 'gor snye thang du yod pa'i btson pa dang / tsha khur gling khar yod pa'i btso na pa khyodan bsdoms 500 tsam yod pa'i nang nas dge 'dun pa rnams grwa bzhi batho na khang du btang ba dang / nga tsho btson pa khag gcig phreng ring btson khang nang slar yang khrid de zla gcig tsam bzhag rjes nga tsho mi grangs nyis brgya skor 'phan po zhing rar ngal ce la byed par btang zhing / 'phan po rgyal lha khang gi dbo na pa'i 'du khang ka ba bcu drug tsam byas pa zhig nang ba༄6ga pa dang / dgong mo chab gsang gtong sa ni dgon pa'i tshogs khro chen po gnyis yod pa de'i nang skyag gcin gtong du 'jug gi yod/nyin mo zhing las gsar sbol byas te sbyag ma dang 'jor la brten nas mu mtha' med pa'i sa stodang gsar dzadal byed dgo sa pa ma zad/ mi gnyis kyis dud 'gro'i tshab byas nas hphong gsho la 'then te zhing rmo 'debs byed dgos pas/ mi la dud 'gro'i mthong las med pa 'dir bsam blo gto/nga skabs skyod snang tshad med yong gi sku da kyang / skabs 'gar bsam blo'i 'khor phyogs zhig la dud 'gro yin yang rtsa chu bo da pa rgyag tshad za 68

rnga chen sdudag khang sogs kyi las grwar btang ba/ 69rgyu yod pa red bsams nas dud 'gror yang yid smon skye myong / de lta bu'i bsam tshul 'khor mkhan nga gcig pu min par bcodan gro gas mang po yod/ nga tshor nyin rer rtsam pa srang bzhi tsam las med pa dang / dgong dro thug pa chu mdodag 'o/ga tsam zhig las med stabs bo da khog ltogs nas shi grabs byas kyang / da dung ngal rtsol sgyur bkod kyi rnam 'gyur yag wa med sgor gshe gshe gtong ba dang / hrūgs chung so so'i nang mi de tsho'i gras la tshang mas skyon brjod dang / bsam blo'i rtsa ba sngo ga dgos zhes ngan skul byas stabs btson pa'i nang nas klad med 'ga' zhig gis rang nyid btson nas thar ched/ byas rjes yong res hur brtson gyi rnam 'gyur bstan nas dgra bo ra ngo dga' sprel lad kyi rgyal gces lhag bsam can dang /nyam chung tshul ldan gyi btson mi tshor skyon brjod 'thab rtsod kyi sdug sbyong gtong du bcug gi yod/1962 lo'i lo mjug tu bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags dpar nang rgya dkar nag gnyis sa mtshams su dmag 'khrug rgyag bzhin yod skor zur tsam shes rtogs byung zhing / btson khang 'go khrid las byed pas deng skabs rgya dkar nag sa mtshams ྅/ dmag 'khrug rgyag bzhin yod pas/gal te hin dmag 'di khul slebs na khyod tshos su'i phyogs su langs kyi yin/ zhes dri ba sna tshogs bskul pa dang btson pa kha shas zur du bstodangs 69

70 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/nas skad cha dris shing / btson pa la las hin dmag slebs na nga tshos bcings 'grol dmag gi langs phyogs su langs te hin dmag la phar rgol bya rgyu yin/ zhes pa sogs 'dra min sna dzamags kyi bce sa ma'i bsam tshul shod mkhan byung yang / nang don btson pa tshang mas hin rdur re ba chen po brgyab nas rgya dmag pham pa zhig yodang ba'i spyodan lam 'debs kyi yod/lha sa nas bathongan pa thug 'phrad byed mkhan nang mi kha shas kyis rgya mi'i las byed mdun kha nas bshad ma nus kyang rnam 'gyur thog rgya dkar nag sa mtshams/ dmag 'khrug rgyag gi sku da pa dang re ba chen po yod lugs gsang gtam phran tsam btson khang nang thos skabs/ dga' mor dang re ba chen po byas pa yin/ de rjes rgya gar pham nyes byung ba lta bu'i gnas tshul mthong thos byung skabs nga tsho slo pham ngang sdug thog sdug rtseg gis gnya' chag pa lta bu byung /70

bdun pa/thag ring gi mi snyan pa'i gtam /( 1963———19snyo5)1963 'e1ra gasdusal thab dzadas rgyal lags grwa bzhi bathenan khang nas 'phan po zhing rwar stodan bsdu btsas rogs su phebs nas/ khong gis nga la khyed kyi pa lags rgya nag kan su'u ngal rtsodal sgyur bkod du nga chod mnyam du yod/ skabs der si ling pu'u sogs nas dbye 'byed kyis nga tsho btson pa mi grangs 76 kan su'u ru sgyur bkod la btang nas nga chod 'o/ gnyis lhag rgya nag tu sdod ring / 'byu rigs za rgyu med pa'i thog ngal rtsol 'ar 'ded byas stabs mi mang che ba stodags shi thebs so/ khyedad kyi pa lags kyang dang po'i gras su dgongs pa rdzogs so/ nga tsho lo gnyis lhag tsam rgya nag tu sdod ring thog mar bod nas kan su'u du gtong skabs mi 76sku da thog nas nga tsho 'khyar 'khyodar ngang mi 33 ma gto/gas tshang ma 'das 71

72 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/sgo ngas gyur/ cadan kyang gnas tshul de ma gsang na rgya mis dkrog gtam bshad pa red ces shod nyen yod gsungs byung / de nas pa lags dbo ngas pa rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul shes rtogs byung / rtag tu ngos chod pha bu mjal 'dzoms kyis pha ma'i drin lan myur du gsab thub pa'i re ba byas pa de/sgrub ma thub par slo pham dang sems sdug chen po byung yang byed thabs dben/ de rjes nga'i gcen mo spen sgrol lags kyang btson khang nang sdug gnon kho na'i 'og dgongs pa sgyu gas pa'i gtam ngan gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyi go thos byung stabs/ skyid po nyis rtseg med par sdug po gsum rtseg zer ba'i bod kyi gtam dpe de rang thog tu dngos su byung / de bzhin phyi lo 1959 zla 10 tshes 29 nyin nga'i byams brtse che ba'i pa lags dang mnyam du dmag khul khang bsguran khang nas/ rgya nag kan su'u ngal rtsol sgyur bkodad la btang ba da lta btsan byedal bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs zur pa/ sku lnga bstan pa bakhrodad pa lags su skabs de'i gnas tshul bka' 'dri zhu skabs kho nga gis gsungs don/ 1959 zla 10 tshes 25 nyin dmag khul khang btson khang nang lo da bce na pa'i khongs nas dbye gsesashus/ nga tsho mi grangs bcu grangs shig glo bur du btson pa'i mo ṭa zhig nang sbug tu nyal chas rnams bcug pa dang / mo ṭa'i mdor nga ce ra lug ltar bcug nas mo ṭa sgo brgyab stabs mi tshang ma sbug bsub 72

thag ring gi mi snyan pa'i gtam/ 73thebs te shi grabs byed mur mo ṭa bskyod song bas/ gang du 'khrid kyi 'a/da dam snyam pa byung zhing / de nas gang mtshams shig nas mo ṭa nas mar bton skabs nor gling sku srung dmag sgar du slebs/ de gar nyin lnga tsam bzhag ring gzhi nas nor gling sku srung dmag sgar nang yod btson pa khag gcig dang / dmag khul khang nas slebs pa'i bsgu na pa khag gcig mnyam du tshogs 'du zhig bslongs te/ khyod pho rgya nag tu ngal rtsol sgyur bskadad la 'gro dgos pa red ces khyab bsgrags byas/1959 zla 10 tshes 39 nyin nor gling nas nga tsho btson pa mi grangs 300 skor yod pa rnams dos skyel thog med rlangs 'khor che ba bcu grangs shig nang bcug ste/ byang brgyud 'ahro skabs lam bar btson khang gzhan nas slebs pa dang bcas khyedan bsdoms mi grangs 400skor yod 'dug nag chur slebs skabs gnam gshis ha cang grang ngar che ba/ nyin mtshan med par kha ba babs nas mi tshang ma sems skyo zhing /rus zug rgyag pa'i grang ngar gyi dka' sdug bzod dka' ba zhig byung /skabs der shin tu ya mtshan la ngo mtshar gyi gnas tshul zhig byung ba ste/zam mi chad par babs pa'i kha ba'i dbyibs gzugs ni gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan/ 'kho ra lo rtsibs brgyad/ pa ṭa/ me tog padma/ gser nya kha sprod/ bum pa/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil bcas bkra shis rtags brgyad 73

74 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/kyi dbyibs gzugs rtsodad med gsal thag dzadad mi tshang mas ngo sa zin rgyu yod pa zhig byung ba des nga phor rtags mtshan legs po byung ba ma zad/des nga tshor sems gso dang kha ba'i khrod du me shing skyel ba lta bu'i lus sems dka' ngal sel rgyur phan thodags byung / kan su'u la nga chod mi grangs 7snyo btang zhing de min mang che ba me 'kho ra nang bcug nas lan kra'u dang /ko yon/ shing cang sogs sa gnas gzhan la btang /nga tsho ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byas te sdod sa'i sa gnas de'i gnam gshis ni dbyar kha shin tu tsha ba che la mi la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i dug sbrang 'bu srin mang ba dang / dgun kha shin tu grang ngar che bas gangs yang yang babs stabs/ btson khang so so'i sgo'i steng 'khyag ral zing zing dgun dus rtag tu mthong rgyu yod pa des nga chosar skyo snang snon ma zhig yong gi sku/da/ snga dbo nga gnam gshis grang bas lus po 'khyag nas dka' sdug cadang dgos pa smos ci/ rgyun gtan 'che ba ni 'byu rigs nyin gcig la mi rer srang bzhi las med pa dang / ngal rtsodal ni sa lha nga gsar sbol dang / zhing las sogs 'ar ded byed pa/ btson khang nang btson pa rgya bod mi grangs chig stong lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nga tsho bod pa mi grangs bdun cu nge na drug yod pa dang / de min tshang ma rgya mi yin zhing / rgya mi de che khag gcig go ming tang gi dpon rigs dang / dmag dpon/74

thag ring gi mi snyan pa'i gtam/ 75de bzhin rgya gzhung gi khrims la rtsis med byed mkhan nag chen du rtsis te gzhung gi sdang zug che shos byed yul gyi mi sha stag red/btson khang der btang ba'i btson pa rnams btson khang nang sdug ci rgyag rgyu las/ de nas thar ba'i re ba dang 'dun lam med pa sha stag red ces pa sogs kyi gnas tshul go thos yong gi 'dug nga chod cadad rigacis btson pa'i nang nas khyod kyi phar btson pa'i 'go khrid tshos sdang zug che thodas byed pa dang khong la lcags kyang brgyab yod/ phas btson grogs chodar nga rang tsho bod nas byang brgyud yong skabs bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbyibs gzugs yod pa'i kha ba babs pa de me tog gi char pa zer ba de red/ de min me tog rang gi char pa babs rgyu med/ de ni rtags rten yag po red ces sems bzang gi btson rogs tshor gsungs pa dang /btson pa'i 'go khrid nas shes te khong la tshogs chen thog 'thab ce da rgyun ring byas/ nam rgyun khong gis nga tsho lo gzhon tshor snying stobs 'phel ba'i zhen skul gnang gi yod ces gsungs/de bzhin rgya nag tu mnyam du phebs myong ba'i sku zhabs gar dpon pa sangs dodan gyub lags nas gsungs nge na/ khyed kyi pa lags dang ngos gnyis yun ring mnyam du btson khang nang gral mtshes byas te bsdad pa yin/ btson las 'go khrid dza sa slob gse dang / 'jigs skul/ 'thab 75

7snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rtsod sogs gang byas kyang khong 'jigs zhum med la slo rtsa brtan pa dang /rtag tu zhal 'dodan la 'bad brtsodan gnang nas bzhugs shing / nga snu btson rogs mang rngege ltog shi thebs skabs pa lags nas gang 'dra byas te sbas skung gnang ba yin nam/ gang ltar 'chi khar mi mang wa ra byin rlabs gnang rgyu 'dug pa lags nas bce na mo gas shig la gu ru'i ma cadangs lung bstan nang nam zhig rgya du ru kha bod nas phyir ldog ste/ bod kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa bskyar du dar rgyu yod skor dang / gong gsal me tog gi char pa'i skor gsungs nas nga tsho lta ba ma 'o/ga pa byed dgos pa'i zhen bskul gnang ba'i gnas tshul rnams rgya las 'bo khrid nas shes te/ 'thab ce da phog nas dmigs bsal sku ngal 'phrad/ des rkyen byas pa lta bus snyun mnar gyi dpo ngas pa cadags so/ zhes gsungs/ bogeng gsal mi grangs 76 tshang ma'i mtshan chod nges med kyang / mi grangs 57 gyi mtshan gzhung gnang son byung ba gsham gsal/ bce na nang 'das gro ngas gyur pa/1) rje 'bum sgang gi spyi khyab mkhan zur ngag dbang rnam rgyal/2) don dbang mkhan chung rgyal mtshan grags pa/3) shod drung rim bzhi mu bya mda' dpon/4) rim bzhi sa lung ba/76

80 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/23) zur khang gnyer pa bstan 'dzin/gong gsol mi grangs 23 spyi lo 1962 zla 10 byedros 19 nyin lha sar 'byar/yang / skabs der grwa bzhi btson khang nas phebs pa'i skyabs rje lha btsun rin po che sku gong ma'i gso/la dpon lags nas nga tshor sangs rgyas bstan pa'i la rgya dam bzung gis gsung don/ 1960 lor nga tshos skyabs rje rin po cher gang byas kyang bod nang bzhugs bzod bde po zhig yong bzo mi 'dug der brten bo skabs shig btsal nas gsang thabs kyi rgya gar du chibs sgrur gnang na mi legs sam/ zhes zhus par rin po ches nga tsho rgya gar du 'gro dgos don med/ gang yin zer na bod kha ba can de 'dzin skyodang byed pa'i bsod nams dbang thang ni 'phags mchog phyag na padmo kho nar ma gtogs de min skye bo su zhig la'ang yod ma red/'on kyang de sngo na nga tshos 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bka' dgongs dang 'gal nas las 'bras tshul bzhin ma srung ba'i nyer len la rten nas/da lta rgya mi'i dbang sgyur 'og dka' sdug myong nas sdod dgos kyang da res kyi las sgrib de nges par dag pa'i dus shig yod/rgya mis nga tsho'i bod kyi snod bcud yongs rdzogs za sems dang dbang sgyur byed bsam pa'i 'char gzhi dang ham sems tan tan yod kyang /80

thag ring bi mi snyan pa'i gtam/ 81kho pa tsho'i bsod nams dbang thang gis gtan nas 'ju thub kyi ma red/de 'dra song tsang nga rang lo na mtho yang ma shi gong rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho thengs gcig mjal thub pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/ khye/ da tsho ni da lta 'o/ na chung bas rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho tan tan zhal mjal thub pa'i nyin mo zhig shar nges yin/ 'on kyang khong mjal ma thub pa'i bar brgal dus tshod nang nga rang tshor dka' sdug chen po zhig myong dgos pa yong srid kyi red/ de'i dus su nga tshos bsam blo zab zab cig gtong rgyu shin tu gal chen po yin/ gal te rang gi lus thog mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gang zhig 'phrad kyang ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal kun/ da res rang gi lus thog 'dir smin pa'i bsngo smon rtse gcig tu byas te dka' sdug rnams don dang ldan pa'i sgo nas khyad bsad thub pa byed dgos/ yang rgya mis tshe 'di las phyi ma med lugs dang / dkon mchog dang / las rgyu 'bras med lugs sdudags kha nas slob gso dril bsgrags mang po byed kyi red la/ mig la'ang 'dra min sna tshogs bstan gyi red/gnas tshul kha shas dasngo sa min nam snyam pa yong srid/ de dus blo rtsa ma 'grims na 'di phyi gnyis med yong nyen yod/ 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mche bod la tan tan zhal gzigs kyi red la bod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang sngar las lhag pa zhig dar nges yin/ gal te sangs rgyas 8/

82 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/bstan pa slar yang wa da la dar rjes 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bka' bzhin tshang mas las 'bras brtsi srung yag lnga byed ma thub na/ 'byung 'gyur de bas sdug pa'i dus ngan yong srid kyi red/ ces bka' slob gnang ba rnams rang gi yid la yang yang dran gso/ byed kyi yod/82

brgyad pa/rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thame rtsod//9snyo66———96796snyolo'i zla 6par 'byor med gral rim rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul spel 'go tshugs shing /rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhi sku ngo mas 'go khrid dang /skul slong gnang ba'i 'gyor med gral rim rig gnas gsar brje chen po mtha' 'khyol ba byed dgo sa pa dang /bsam slo rnying pa dang /rig gnas ning pa/goms gshis rnying pa/ yul srol rnying pa bcas gtor nas bsam slo gsar pa dang / rig gnas gsar pa/goms gshis gsar pa/༷/la sku(la gsar pa bzhi bcas btsugs dgos zer ba'i las 'gul bce na khang phyi nang gang sar spel 'bo tshugs skabs/ btson khang 'go khriḍi las byed pas nga chod bce na mi khag

84 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/cig la bsam tshul dris te deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi dus bab la sngo sa 'dzin dang / rig gnas gsar brje chen po byas par lta stangs bsam tshul ji yod drang bden shod dgos/ gal te bsam tshul sdug pa yod kyang kha gsal bshad na gu yangs red/ zer ba sogs 'dri zhib byed skabs phran nas nye sngon tshags par zhig nang teng tho dang / wu han gyis nga tsho'i dpyid gsar dus chen la zhim shos ni chu 'khol ma red ces brjod/ de ni nga tsho'i btson pa'i 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba byed skabs dngos 'brel bden pa red bsams pa dran byung zhes bshad pa yin/ de ltar thad kar shod pa'i dmigs yul ni nga chod btson pa'i 'tsho ba phran bu legs bcos yong ba'i re ba yin/de rjes btson pa yongs rdzogs tshogs chen bsgo ngas te tshogs chen thog nga'i ming bton nas blo yon gyis tang nang gi ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa chodas/ nga tsho'i 'byor med gral rim gyi 'tsho bar dma' 'bebs tshig mtshon btab par/ yid ches byed kyi yod lugs bshad nas zhe 'khon sdang zug sngar las che ru btang / nga tsho bcug pa'i btson khang de 'phan po rgyal lha khang zer ba de yin zhing /lha khang de ni gna' rabs kyi lha khang rnying gras shig yin pa dang / de'i nang rtsa che'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po sku da pa ma zad/ mchod rdzas 84

rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab rtsod/ 85gos chen dang / rgya gser rnying pa/ mkha' 'gro'i bkras btags dang /hor stag zhun/ rgyan bzhi sogs ches brjid nyams che ba'i dngo sa rdzas rnams 1966 'orware rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul nang gtor bshig dang / 'jim sku rnams zhing kha'i lud dang mnyam du g.yugs stabs lha sku stodar ba zhing kha'i nang dbu rdog ger bzhugs 'dug pa dang / rin chen gser dngul las bris pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams yos rngo byed kyi me shing dang mnyam bsres kyis me la 'bud skabs/ shog bu rnams mes tshigs kyang gser dngul yig 'bru rnams nyams med khra lham mer gsal/skabs re rang gi bsams par sngar bod kyi gtam dper mi tshe ring na lha shi ba'i ro mthong zer ba de rang dngos su byung ngo snyam/ rgya dmar bce na pa'i 'go khrid tshos nga che ra rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi dus bab bzang po'i rjes zin thub pa byed dgos/ a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / hin rdu rgya skyed ring lugs/ tā la'i log spyod ru hrūgs la rgyab bcol nas spyi tshogs rnying pa bskyar gso yong ba'i re ba byed pa ni/ nyin mo'i gnyid lam zhig yin pas nam yang 'grub thabs med pa'i re stong zhig red/ rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ma'o kru'u zhis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam ༷/gas des mthar gtugs ma rtsa'i ring 'u/gas lam 'u gas kyi tshab byed rgyu de ni/ mi rnams kyi rang nyid kyis 'dod blo ltar bsgyur mi thub 85

8snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/pa'i phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid cig red/log spyodad phyogs khag gis 'e rgyus kyi 'khor lo mdun bskyodad bya rgyu de bkag 'gog byed thabs gang 'dra zhig byas kyang rung / gsar brje ni dus tshod snga phyir ma gtogs langs nges yin pa ma zad/ rgyal kha'ang thob nges yin zhes bka' slob gnang sku da/ de bzhin chos zer ba de ni dug rtsa zhig dang / bshu gzhog gral rim gyis ngal ce la mi mang la gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog byedo pa'i lag cha zhig red ma galta gas dzadas byos nas sangs rgyas pa dang / chas ma byas par dmyal bar lhung ba su byung yad pa ra sprod gcig kyang byed rgyu med/ de las re stong rmongs dad kyi bsam tshul dor nas nag nyes ngos 'dzin dang / khrims la brtsi srung zhus te sgyur bkod byas nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bo sna gas ldan pa'i mi gsar pa zhig byed dgos/ de 'dra byed rgyur re stong dang / rmongs dad kyi bsam slo ni 'gog rkyen che shos shig red/ der brten re stong dor nas 'thab rtsod kyi gra sgrig byed dgos pa ni khyod tsho'i bsam bro'i thog gi spyi tshogs rnying par zhen chags dang bskyar gso yong ba'i re stong dang / rmongs dad kyi bsam blor 'thab rtsod byed dgos/ de'ang khyod tsho mi gsar byed pa'i ngan dor bzang blang gi cha rkyen gsum la brtson len byed dgos pa ni/dang po/ nag nyes la ngos 'dzin dang /86

rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab lcangad/ 87gnyios pa/ tang dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs la brtsi srung byed dgas/gsum pa/ ngal ce la gyi lta ba btsugs pa dang bo mas gshis 'jags pa byed dgos pa bcas red/ ngan dor bzang blang gis cha rkyen gsum dang mthun pa'i sgyur bkod byas sku da med rang gis rang la zhib bsher byas te/ mgyodags myur mi gsar pa yong ba'i bce na len byed dgos zhes rtag tu dril bsgrags btsan bskul byed kyi yodad pa ma zad/ de ltar mi byed thabs med btsan bcun gyis lha nas bzos yod//phran 1962 lo nas 19snyo7 bar sku lnga hril po 'phan snga zhing ra'i sgyur bkod btson khang du sdod ring ngal rtsol skul 'ded dang /stodas grod pa mi rgyag pa dang / gos kyi lus ngo mi drod pa'i khar rtag tu btson pa phan tshun skyon brjod dang / 'thab rtsod byed res byed du bcug gi yod/ dper na/ mi zhig la 'thab rtsodad byed 'char yod skabs sngon la btson pa mang cho gas tshogs chen bskongs nas de'i thog btson pa'i 'bo khrid las byed pas gtam bshad byas te/ ma'o kru'u zhis/ dgra bo rang shugs su rtsa med 'gro srid kyi ma red/ krung go'i log spyod pa yin na'ang 'dra/ krung gor yodad pa'i a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul 87

88 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/stobs shugs yin na'ang 'dra/ tshang ma rang shugs su lo rgyus kyi gar stegs thog nas bab srid kyi ma red/ de'ang gad brgyab pa ltar phyags ma ma brgyab na gad snyigs rang bzhin du mi 'gro ba lta bu red ces slob sde na gnang yod/khong tshos ma'o kru'u zhi'i 'brel yod gsung rtsom slob spyong byas te tang dang spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol dang / nag nyes la ngos 'dzin med par sgyur bkod la 'gog lha la gyis spyi tshogs rnying pa ro langs brgyag rgyu'i re stong dang / rmongs dad kyi chos byed mkhan mi ngan las ngan la 'thab rtsod byas nas dri ngan kha ba zhig bzo dgos/ zhes snying la zug rngu rgyag dgos pa'i gdug rtsub che ba'i tshig ngan byed spyod byed kyi yod/btson grogs blo mthun tshe brtan rdo rje lags btson khang nas bros dre la byed rtsis sku da lugs kyi zhwa mo g.yog nas nyin mang por/ chodags chen thog 'othab rtsod kyis gang byungo rdung rdzog byas te kho dang sna khug nas khrag mang pa than pa dang lus pa yangs rdzags nad gcang bzas pa ma zad/ da dung khang chung mun nag cig nang lag lcags brgyab nas yun ring btson 'jug byas thog nyin re lto chas rtsam pa srang gsum re las med stabs/zungs zad 'chi la nye ba'i gnas stangs skyo po byung ba dang/ de bzhin rwa sgreng sku zhabs slo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan po ba blo bzang chodas 'byor/88

rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab rtsod/ 89rgyal rtse dmag zhal ngo stodabs/ ngagre bshes thub bstan dbang phyug sogs kyi btson khang nang re ltong dang rmongs dad rgyun 'khyongs byed kyi yod 'u/gas bsnyad 'dogs byas te/ bce na pa tshogs chen bskong tshogs kyis mi spyod las 'das pa'i 'thab rtsod bkyigs rdung drag po zhin mang prio bstud mar byas stabs/ rwa sgreng sku zhabs blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan po ba rnam rgyal bkra shis zer ba'i rgas po zhig sku da pa des sgyur bkod la ngo ltog rgyab mdun byed kyi yod lugs brjod de/ rnam rgyal bkra shis nyin mtshan mang po tshogs chen dang tshos/sa chung nang 'thab rtsod byed bcug skabs mthod bo'i lcang lo khang pa'i thog gi lcam shing la btags nas/ rkang pa sa la ma reg tsam bzhag thodag g.yas gasku/na nas rdung rdeg btang stabs rang dbang med par skad ngan shor ba dang / de dang de 'dra ba'i 'thab rtsod tshogs chung so so'i nang dza drag gis byed kyi yod pas/ a ra u ru'i ngu 'bod smre sngags kyi sgra chad rgyu med/ de skabs spyi tshogs thog la'ang bla ma dge babes dang / shes yon can/ rgyal gces lhag bsam can gyi mi sna 'byor ldan mi sna lhag lus rnams la lha 'dre gange na bgegs dang /log spyod kyi shes yon can/ mgo bde glags tshong byed mkhan zhes pa la sogs pa'i nyes ming sna tshogs btags nas 'thab rtsod las 'gul sa gnas gang sar byed bzhin yod/89

9༷ nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/btson khang phyi nang gnyis kar ya nga med pa'i 'thab rtsod dang / snying rje med pa'i mnar gcod kyi 'jigs dngangs ma bzod par btson bo gas thub bstan dpal ldan sems 'ace ma zin par/ nyin mtshan med par kha nas tang srid la yid ches sku da/ tang srid la yid ches yod ces grangs med 'bod pa dang / yang 'phan lnga ba bkra shis tshe dbang la kho sa re stong slongs dad kyi bsam slo rtag tu mkhregs bzung byed pa ma zad/btso na pa gzhan dang phan tshun dkrog gtam shod res byed kyi yod lugs bshad nas bcesan pa klad chung rgyug khyi nyung shas de tshor/ hur balca na can zer ba'i ming btags nas de tsho bed spyod kyis 'thab rtsod bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byed skabs bkra shis tshe dbang 'jigs dngangs ma bzod par/ btson pa rnams stod chas za ba'i go skabs bsnyun nas khrodan pa'i nang mchodangs pa btson srung dmag gis mthong ste las byed par snyan seng zhus rjes/ khrodan pa nas blta na te mgo mjug slog nas phran tsam bzhag skabs/ kha dang sna khung nas chu mang po thon nas ma 'chi tsam byung yang / btso na pa hur brtson can tsho'i lta rtog 'og nyin shas nad gso byed bcug ste phran bu'i drag skyes byung rjes 'thab rtsod nyin shas byas so//lhag par du lo ltar dgun dus slob spyong ni btson pa so sor 'o/ 'khor gcig nang gi ngal bsam sgyur bgo da kyi dge skyon ji byung dpyad 90

rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab rtsod/ 91bsdur byed dgos/ 'dri rtsad tsha nan thog bzod par dka' ba'i 'thab rtsod dang / rdung rdeg phan tshun dbar 'tshang rdol dang / skyon brjod byed bcug pa sogs 'jigs skrag che ba'i las 'gul spel ba de'i nang / 'o/ ltar phran dang phran gyi mdza' mthun 'thab grogs khag gcig sku/da pa rnams rtag tu 'khon thogs yong gi yod/ bce na gro gas chod mthun stag lung ba gazlo na nus gsungs don/ 1960 lor lho kha bsam yas bce na khang nang nga tsho btson pa mi grangs 300 tsam zhig ngal rtsol sgyur bkod du btang ba rnams la nyin re rtsam pa srang gsum bzhi tsam las med pa dang /nyin mo ngal rtsol skul 'ded dang / mtshan mo btson khang nang phan tshun skyon brdzod 'thab rtsod kyi las 'gul ngan skul byas stabs/ btson pa tshang mar dka' sdug 'jigs dngangs kyi lus sems gnyis mnar tshang ma'i lus po'i gnas stangs nyin bzhin je sdug tu song nas nyin re btson pa gnyis gsum lde gas shi thebs/btson pa tshos rang nyid lha gas shi thebs rgyu las gson thabs ched ko ba'i lham dang ko ba'i sked rag bsam yas gtsug lag khang gtor bshig btang nas g.yugs pa'i ma ṇi'i phyi lpags kod ba tsho na rtsi can dang /dar chen gyi rgyun/ dbugs rkyal se gas za dbo sa pa shin tu ya nga ba'i gnas tshul cadag dang thodag btson pa mi grangs 200 nas 'e gcig nang 91

92 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/btson pa brgya dang bdun cu tsam 'u gas shir song / 'phros btson pa ྅/ma cu tsam lhag pa rnams kyang rkang pa sa la drud nas 'gro mkhan sang 'chi gnangs 'chi'i gnas la gyar ba sha stag red ces gsungs byung /nyin zhig nga tsho 'phan po zhing rar yod pa'i btson pa rnams kong po khul gtong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul zhig go thos byung / de sngon kong po'i btson khang nang phebs myong ba'i bce na grogs blo mthun rig bsam dang / 'phrin las tshe dbang gnyis kyis ga3rshangs don/ 1962 lor kong po khe nang du nga tsho ngal rtsol sgyur bkod la btang skabs nga chod btson pa tshor 'di las 'tsho ba skyo ba yod pa ni/ mi rer rtsam pa srang bzhi tsam dang / dgong dro skabs re thug pa tsha med chu mdog 'o/ga tsam zhig las mi ster ba/ lcags skud gze ma ru mgos lcag sa ri bskor ba'i btson khang nang sdod gur re re'i nang btson mi 15 tsam yod pa/ so so'i nyal sa'i mdun du thag pa re btang yod pas yar langs skabs de nas 'jus te langs thub tsam zhig las med/da dung zhogs pa chu tshod lnga dang phyed ka tsam la bslangs te 'jor dang sbyag mar brten nas sa rgod phru ga bcug gi yod cing / byed stangs cadad stangs phran tsam kho pa tshul) 'dod par ma babs na dgong dro tshogs chen dang yang na chodags chung nang 'thab rtsod nyes rdung gto/nga ba sogs/92

rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab rtsod/ 93sems lus gnyis kar mnar gcod kyi dka' sdug ma bzod pa sprad stabs/mi kha shas las kar 'gro bzhin lam khar shi ba dang / mi kha shas las ka byed yul du ltogs shi thebs pa/ mi kha shas sdod gur nang shi ba sogs re zung gson bsdad tsho nyal rogs g.yas g.yon gnyis shi ba'i mi ro'i dkyil nas langs dgos pa'i shin tu yid skyo ba'i sdug mnar dang / da dung las kar 'gro ba'i lam khar spyi chogs ring lugs bzang zhes pa sogs kyi gsar brje'i glu gzhas ma 'dod bzhin du btsan shed kyi gtong bcug gi yod/nyin zhig lam kha'i zur cig tu rta ro khyis za 'phro zhig bzhag sku da pa btson pa tshos mthong ma thag btson srung dmag gi bka' la ma 'dzems par/ btson pa khag cig rta ro'i sgang mchongs stabs btson srung dmag gis rdog rgyag dang me mda'i mjug shing gzhus te btson pa mang che ba rnga ro dang kha bral thub kyang / sde drug bla brang gi lde 'chang ye shes bstan 'dzin gyis dmag mis rdung rdzog ci tsam byas kyang / snang med lta bur bzhag nas rta ror dam por 'tham nas rta sha kham gang re bkog ste rgyab gdan khug ma'i nang blugs nas yun ring shos bsdad cing / de rjes yar langs skabs kha dang / sna/ gdong pa yongs rdzogs khrag ral gyis hrūs yod kyang zhe 'tsher tsam yang med pa ni bkres ltogs kyi 'chi rgyu las 93

9ji nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gson thabs byas pa zhig red/de bzhin shing nags gseb tu skabs re dodam gyi skyag pa yod pa mthodang na hab sprodab brgyag gi yod/ gang yin zhe na/ sdadam skyag nang kham bu'i tshi gu gnyis gsum yod pa rnams bton nas chu dang mnyam du bkol skabs snum tshi phran bu thon rgyu yod pa des kyang / gzugs por rlung gsos lta bu yong gi 'dug btson pa 'das grongs gyur pa'i sku phung rnams ri shur zhig tu sa sbas btang thog dang po shing byang re btsugs kyis yod cing / zla shas so/nga rjes bce na pa'i gzugs po'i gnas stangs nyin bzhin je sdug song nas nyin re mi lnga tsam chad med shi bas/ phung po'i thog shing byang btsugs chodad med pa lta bu chags shing / gzhi rgya gang tsam sku da pa'i ri shur de nang btson pa'i phung pos khengs shing phung po gsar pa sbas skabs sbyag ma ga par btsugs kyang / phung sngo sbas yod pa sha stag 'khel nas phung po sbas sa med pa chags pa'i 'o/ rgyus gsungs pa thos skabs/dmyal khams 'di nas dmyal khams de bas sdug bsngal che ba'i bo nga wa ra slebs nyen 'dug bsam pe'i sems khral byung / de rjes nga sa slo mthun drug sku da pa'i nang nas slo mthun rgan cadas blo bzang tshe brtan lags nas gal te nga tsho kong lnga ra btang nas gnas stangs de las sdug pa zhig chags te sdug shi thebs nyen 'dug na/ skadang lnga nas rgya gar la thag nye bas sems 94

rig ga/sar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab rtsod/ 95thag bcad de bros byol thar thabs byed dgo sa zhes bo sa 'go bton par nga zuorgos mos mji na byas/1966 lor blo mthun rig bsam lags dang / 'phrin las tshe dbang lags gnyis lo tshad tshang nas las mi'i kho ngas su btang zhing / las mi'i nang du'ang btson pa dang ha lam 'dra ba'i slob spyong byed dgos/ nga tsho drug khongs nas skal bzang rab rgyas rgya mi'i kha gsal gu yangs dang /sbas skum drag gnon/ rang skyon ngos len dang gzhan skyon ther 'don/byas rjes bzhag nas 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam thob pa'i don gnyer byed dgos/ log spyodad kyi lta ba dang langs phyogs dang kha bral dgos zer ba'i 'jigs skul basmu brid 'og tshud de/ nga tsho mi drug po bros byol du 'gro rgyu'i sgrig 'dzugs yod lugs ngos len byas/nga dza mi lnga por khyod tshor gnas tshul yod/ kha gsal gu yangs dang / sbas bskum drag gnon gyi tang gi srid jus la 'gyur ba med/ nges par ngos len zhu dgos zer/ nga tsho lnga po phan tshun 'brel ba byed ma bcug par lta rtog bya mi btsugs pa dang / tshogs chung so so'i nang dri ba bkod nas 'thab rtsodad byed 'go tshugs shing / las mi'i nang yod pa'i blo mthun gnyis la'ang de ltar mthar bkag btang ba ma zad/ blo mthun rig bsam yang bskyar btson khang gi khang chung zhig nang zur du bcug pa dang / de 95

9snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/nas nyin gcig zur du bcug pa'i khong gi skya 'brel khang pa zhig nang stes dbang stabs legs kyi nga cho 'bru 'don par btang nas/ de nyin lha mthun rig bsam gyis nga la yi ge zhig sprad pa'i nang skal bzang rab rgyas nas nga tsho bros byol gyi sgrig 'dzugs yod lugs ngos len zhus zin 'dug de lugs lnga sa len zhu stangs byed dgos/ de min gnas tshul gsar pa gang yang med slo bde po gyis/ zhes 'khod/nga'i ngos nas gnas tshul gang yang med/ nga la sems khral mi dgos zhes phan tshun skad cha cadad pa'i go skabs shig dbo na mche ga gis gnang byung / de rjes 'brel yod slo mthun rig bsam dang 'brel ba byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams gsang ba'i lha nas chod mthun rgan cadas slo tshe la rgodad thub/ blo tshe ngos gnyis nas tshadags chung so so'i nang nga tsho mi drug nas gal te kong por btang ba yin na rgya gar thag nyer song / bros gyol 'gro thabs byed rgyu'i bo sa sdur byas pa yin zhes lnga sa len byas shing / lo 'di'i dgun slob spyir btang tshar nas btson pa mang che ba ngal rtsol sgyur bkod la sngar rgyun bzhin btang /da dung gnas tshul thag ma dzadadaripa nga tsho mi bdun tsam yod pa rnams btson khang nang gyang la kha lta ru bcugo nas bsam blo'i bo skabs yin zhes bzhag byung / de nang wang ka'ang se zer ba'i rgya mi las byed 96

rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab ce da/ 97cig yod pa de spyir btang btson pa spyir gdug rtsub che gras shig yin kyang / phran la nam rgyun khyod rang lo chung ngu red/ log spyod kyi langs phyogs dang kha bral nas sgyur bkod yag po byas na 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun larme sku/da/nga tsho'i zhing ra de rgya skyed byed 'char yod pa dang / de skabs nga tsho'i zhing rar thon skyed kyi 'phrul chas dang rlangs 'khor sogs mang po yong gi red/ de dus khyod rang gi 'dod pa yod pa zhig slob sbyong byed du bcug gi yin/ de nas yag po byung na rgyal khab kyi bzo pa ngo mar bsgyur thub pa'i re ba yod ces slob gasdud btang / phran la dmigs bsal do snang gis lta stangs yag po sku/da/de nyin wang ka'ang ses nga tsho bsam blo'i go skabs do dam 'og bzhag pa'i mi re ngo rer bltas te/ nga mthong rjes nga tsho'i tud krang bod rigs tshe bsam zer ba rgya zhen che ba/ kho ga gnag cig yod pa de dang bgro smeng phran tsam byas te/ ༷/da tsam zhig nas tshe bsam gyis khyedad rang mar nge na shog ces brjod nas sde bas lags zer ba'i bce na bo gas nyam chung tshul ldan zhig yod pa der/ 'thab rtsod byed pa'i mogs chung de'i zur nyan lta bur nyin shas bzhag byung / de rjes phran bu zhe ltod du gyur nas nyes thodag nyes rtseg gi nag nyes ji yod bsam blo'i rtsa ba dang bcas 97

98 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ngos len zhu yig dang / slad 'e/ga spyod langs phyogs dang kha bral nas sngar 'gyod phyi sdom gyis mi gsar pa byed pa'i ngan dor bzang blang gi cha rkyen gsum la/ brtsodan len byed 'char gyi zhu yig bris bcug rjes btson rogs byings dang mnyam du/ sngar rgyun bzhin ngal rtsol byed par btang nas lo 'di'i dgun dus slob sbyong gi 'gag sgo las thar tsam byung /'thab grogs blo tshe dang / rig bsam/ 'phrin las tshe dbang bcas chod mthun gsum po grwa bzhi btson khang nas 19snyo4 'o/ra 'phan po zhing rar nga cho btson khang gi zhing ra'i btsas ma brnga rogs su btang ba zhig yin/ btsas ma brngas rjes grwa bzhi'i btson pa spyi byings phyir log btang yang / khong tsho nam rgyun grwa bzhi'i btson khang gi las byed pas sdang zug byed sa'i mi khag gcig nga tsho'i btson khang du bzhag pa'i gras shig yin zhing / nga tsho phan tshun lta ba dang / langs phyogs gcig gyur yin par brten phan tshun pha sprun ltar gyi brtse ba dang / yid ches dga' zhen rang bzhin chags shing / slo mthun rig bsam nas grwa bzhi btson khang nas bsnams phebs pa'i mabo na sngo klu sgrub kyis brtsams pa'i bshes springs bris ma zhig dang / sa skya legs bshad bris ma zhig 'dug pa de phran nas g.yar te bce na khang nang bar seng dus chodad nam byung la gsang thabs kyi blo 'dzin byas te cha tshang slo 'dzin thub pa dang / de'i 'grel pa dge bshes 98

rig gsar dang / 'jigs snang dngangs skrag skye ba'i 'thab rtsod/ 99thub bstan dbang phyug lags dang / rwa sgreng sku zhabs blo bzang rgyal mtshan gnyis su zhar zhor mngon chung ngang gnang rogs zhus te nyams len gang thub byas/ de bzhin nga tsho 'thab grogs phan tshun rtsa don yod pa'i mthun sgril rgyun 'khyongs yong ched phan tshun sems 'khur dang / phan tshun rogs ram/ phan tshun gces skyong / phan tshun skul lcag byed thabs ni nyin zhig ngas shog bu zhig gi thog 7mgon skyabs chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor dad gus dang / las 'bras la yid ches dang brtsi srung byed pa'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i gegs byung btson grogs rnams rang nyid kyi pha spun gyi 'du shes dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i la rgya dam bzung gis khong phor g.yol thabs med par 'phrad srid pa'i rang nyid kyi dka' nyen la ma 'dzems par/ gang thub gdong len gyis der phan bde yong ba bya rgyu yin/zhes bris pa blo mthun rgan shos blo tshes gzigs par/ khong gis yi/ tshugs kyis yi ge de nga'i lag nas bzhes te gzigs zhib gnang rjes nga la phyag bris shig gnang ba'i nang /gzhon nu rgas po'i slo gros can khyed la// de lta'i snying stobs chod sems ldan pa der// kho bos kha tsam min pa'i dga' bsu dang //ya rabs dam pa'i gshis der mig dpe blta// zhes 'khod pa des nga la skul ma chen po thebs byung //99

dgu pa/ngas nam yang mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i rtsa don dang sduḍas phyogs/gsham gsal/ rtsa nge na langs phyogs kyi rang nyid kyi bsam blo dang bya spyod gtam brjod gsum nang yin min chen po dbye 'byed byed pa'i tshad gzhir brtsis te/ rtsa don de dang 'gal med lag len don 'khyol yong ched/ rtag tu rang gis rang la re ba dang blang bya nan po yang yang blta na pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan la brten nas rang gis rgyal khab dang /bstan srid mi rigs kyi don du gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod yongs rdzogs blos gtong byed pa'i thodag ma'i mna' tshig bzhin/dam bca' brtan por gnas rgyur ngas gzhi 'dzin rtsa don bzhi dang nang gses bcu zer ba nyin mtshan du mar bsam slo btang nas ༷nga nyid kyi nyin thor bkod pa yin/

ngas nam yang mtha' 'khyedangs byed pa'i rtsa don dang langs phyogs/ 101de bzhin nga'i lta ba dang langs phyogs te/ nga ni sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyun 'dzin dang / srung skyob/ dar spel mdzad mkhan gyi tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor dad gus dang lhag bsam rnam dag byed mkhan nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin/ der brten lta 'o/ga pa rgya dmar btsan 'dzul pa'i ches kla slo dang / ches mun nag ches gdug rtsub/ ches log spyod kyi dmar po'i dbang sgyur 'og nas nga la drang bden kyi khe phan dang mdun lam zhig thob thub pa'i re ba gtan nas byed kyi med/ 'on kyang ngas sdug rus byed pa dang / kho sems mnan nas nyin gcig yin na'ang 'dza gang thub byed pa ni rgya che ba'i mi mang gi khe phan dang / rang nyid slos gtong gis 'asku ba sems can thams cad kyi don gnang mkhan 7bo nga sa mdzadag gi dargongs gzhi bsgrub pa'i ched du'ang yin/rang nyid 'chi rgyu de'ang gong gsal rtsa don rnams kyi ched du sems thag chod po'i ngang 'chi thub pa zhig byed pa las/ rang sger ram/yang na nang tshang spun nye chorware gnas skabs kyi khe nyen la bltas nas khong gi dgongs pa dang 'gal nas 'byung 'gyur 'gyod gnong skye dgos pa'i bya ba zhig gtan nas byed kyi min la/ ma mthar yang ngas cadad mi rigs kyi zhabs 'dren gtan nas mi sdokyi/ 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs pas nga gso skyong gnang ba dang khong gi thugs re bce la gnang ba de ngas nam yang 101

102 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/chud bzos su mi gdodang ba'i chod sems btsugs pa yin/ ngas dus dang rnam pa kun tu btsugs pa'i dzadad sems de sngar bas sra brtan dang dodan 'khyol yong ched rtag tu 'bad brtson byed bzhin pa yin/ngas snga phyi bar gsum la lag len mtha' 'khyedangs byed pa'i lam phyogs dang / nga'i lhag bsam rnam dag gi bsam slo der phyi nang gi dgra bo nyung shas shig gi snying khong rus pa'i gting nas 'kho na 'dzin bcangs kyi yod la/ dwogs zon yang chen po byed pa ma gtogs de min gtso che bla ma yi dam/ chos dge 'dun/ dpa' phra mkha' 'gro chodas skyong srung ma rnams kyis 'gyur med stobs ldan gyi lha nas nga la bden skyabs gnang gi yod pa dang / yang sgos nga'i tshe 'dir bskos pa'i pha ma spun mched 'das gson tsho dang / de bzhin nga la sha tsha 'brel yod kyi mdza' brtse'i 'thab grogs chodas mtsho na pa'i drang bden gtso bzung byed mkhan ser skya spun zla tshang mas gdung sems mnyam skyed dang / thabs shes sna tsho gas kyi rogs ram byas dang byed bzhin sku da pa ni the chodam mi dgo sa pa zhig yin stabs/ nga 'gran zla bral ba'i stodabs shugs sku da mkhan zhig tu gyur bar brten/ dgra bo'i stobs shugs gang zhig gis nga las sla wa ra gto/ra pham gtong mi thub pa'i gnas babs su bsdad yod pa'i tsho ra snang dang spobs pa skye bzhin 'dug102

ngas nam yang mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i rtsa don dang langs phyogs/ 103ngas gang gi dus su'ang mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i langs phyogs te da lta sdug bsngal myong bzhin pa'i bod kyi ser skya spun zla spyi dang / lhag par 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos dbus pa'i de 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams dang / bzang po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ shes brtse ldan pa'i 'thab ༷ gas tsho'i drang bden gyi langs phyogs su char drag rlung 'tshub gang zhig dang 'phrad kyang / g.yo med brtan por langs te kho nga rnams la snying nas yid ches dang / mtha' gcig tu bsten pa/ khong rnams 'di phyi'i mgon skyabs dang / bzang po'i 'thab sku gas shig tu brtsis te bsam blo'i thog nas dad pa dang lus kyi thodag nas gus zhabs/ dngo sa po'i thog nas bkur bsti zhu ba dang / mdor na khong rnams dang skyid sdug mnyam myong dang 'chi gasku na mnyam gnas kyi 'tsho ba zhig nges par skyel thub pa bya sde/ 6sgen/rgyun gtan 'chod ba'i skyel rim nang bsam blo zhig btang na'ang 'dra/ skad cha zhig bshad na'ang 'dra/ bya ba gang zhig byas kyang mi ches mang che ba der lus sems gnyis kar phan bde yong ba zhig bya rgyu de yin/de ni ngas nam yang mtha' 'khyedangs byed pa'i rtsa dodan dang langs lhu gas yin/langs phyogs de ni dka' nyen dang gtum drag che ba'i dgra bo gang zhig las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i rin bral sna ra bu mthu ldan zhig yin pa'i 103

104 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/yid ches dang myong tshor gting zab byung / gong gsal lta ba dang langs phyogs de dag gis rang nyid kyi bsam slo dang bya spyod la slob ston byas stabs/ dgra gnyen bar gsum dbye mtshams gsal 'byed thub pa dang /dgra gnyen bar gsum la spyod tshul 'dzin snyangs shes nas rnyog 'dzings che ba'i char drag rlung 'tshub kyi 'thab rtsod las 'gul rim pa'i nang /mod bgom dang spyong brdar thebs nas kha phyogs ma nor bar rang tshugs brtan par gnas thub pa byung /skabs der stag lung brag yongs 'dzin rin po ches ljags ce mas gnang ba red zer ba'i myur byon zhabs brtan gsol 'debs shig lag son byung ba ste/ na mo gu ru tsa/ ya lo ki shā ra ya/rigs gsum gcig bsdus 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs//thugs kyi bzhed don ma lus mthar phyin te//bod ljongs mun nag thug pos ma sgrib gong //'phags pa'i yul nas myur du byon par shog/sngon tshe thugs rgyud bzang pos rgyal ba'i drung //'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma skam de srid du//gangs can 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dam bcas shing //104

ngas nam/ yang mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i rtsa don dang langs phyogs/ 105bzhed don 'grub nas myur du byon par shog/mtha' bzhi sems ngan sprin nag dbyings su zhi//gangs can nyi ma bstan 'dzin rgya mchorware mgon//mtha' dbus kun tu gsal bar myur 'char zhing //sku tshe mdzad pa mtha' ru phyin par shog/de dag bdag gis smon lam btab pa yis//spyan ras gzigs kyi sgyu na pa'i 'bras bu bzhin//dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis//gegs med myur du 'gyub par byin gyis rlobs/zhes pa de nga tsho 'thab grogs phan tshun rgya gang cher 'grems spel byas nas nyin re'i kha 'don mnyam du chag med 'don kyi yod/105

bcu pa/dngangs skrag slong ba'i sdog bsher dang /spo bo gsum 'dzoms su btang ba/967———969bce na khang gis bce na khrims don tshan bcu gsham gsal/btson khang nang khab skud tsam nyar mi chog cing /las byed pas btson pa'i nyal gos dang lus bsher yang yang byed pa dang lhag par lo gsar dang /zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcigalnga gcig se na/sa dus chen khag la zhib bsher nan po byed pa dang / chodags chung gi chodags mi phan tshun phar dkrug tshur dkrug yang yang byed pa des lus sems la dka' bsun snon ma zhig yong gi yod/ nyin zhig glo bur du zhib bsher zhig byed skabs nga'i sa skya legs bshad kyi deX 6de dang bshes springs dpe deb sbas

dngangs skrag slong ba'i sngog bsher dang / spo bo gsum 'dzoms su btang ba/ 107skung byed pa'i go skabs ma byung stabs/ de ring rnyog dra zhig bslangs so snyam nas sems pa'i nang 'jigs snang sems 'tshab ci che'i 'og mthar bya thabs bral nas gsang spyod du bskyod pa'i lam du g.yugs thub tsam byung yang / rjes su dpe cha de las byed pa'i lag tu thebs nas log spyod gral rim gyi bshu gzhog byed pa'i lag cha rmongs dad kyi dpe cha de su'i yin zhes rtsad gcod nan po byed rgyur the hrūm med pas/ 'jigs dngangs ci che byung mur btson pa re re bzhin nyal gos dang / lus bsher zhib tshags byas te phran re 'kho ra 'khel nas zhib bsher byas kyang nyen kha yod pa'i gnas tshul gang yang ma thon/ brtag dpyad tshar rjes las byed sku ngas rdzogs phyir log ma thag gsang spyod du gcin pa gtong bar 'gro khul gyi bskyod skabs bshes springs dang sa skya legs bshad dpe deb gnyis rlung pos zing zing gi g.yo 'gul byas nas mngon gsal dodad po ra bzhugs 'dugathog steng srung dmag yod kyang ma mthodang bar ya mtshan ngo mtshar che ba zhig byung / de nas srung dmag la (spa ka'o )snyan seng zhus te/ snang med kyis bskyod de dpe cha de blangs thub pa'i stes dbang stabs legs de 'dra zhig byung ba ni/ lha srung rnams kyis srung skyob rogs mgon gnang ba zhig yin pa nges rnyed byung /107

108 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/1967 lo'i lo mjug tu nga tsho btson pa brgya dang bdun cu tsam yod pa rnams rlangs 'khor re nang mi sum cu re glug ste spo bo gsum 'dzoms su bskyal zhing / spo bo gsum 'dzoms su dgon pa che chung gnyis 'dug pas/ dgon pa gcig phyi nang tshang ma stodar bshig byas te gyang ror btang 'dug dgon pa gcig gi nang rten gser dngul rin po che las grub pa'i sku gsung thugs rten rnams jag bcodam byas pa dang / dgon pa'i 'du khang 'byu khang bzos shing / 'jim sku rnams rtsa bshig btang 'dug nga chod 'du khang nang yod pa'i 'byu rigs rnams bto/na bcug ste 'du khang mun nag de'i nang btso na pa mi grangs 170 tsam yod tshang ma sdeb glug byas tsang ha cang gu dog pa'i ngang sdod dgos byung /nyin mo dre gas gcig nas sa slog rgyag tu bcug pa dang / phyogs gcig nas ber dod zer ba'i shing rtsa bskadag bcug ste de'i steng bce na khang gsar pa rgyag rgyu'i gra sgrig byas shing / sa gnas der sa stong gsar sbol byed rgyu sogs ngal rtsol tsha ded dang tsho gas chung phan tshun 'gran bsdur byed du bcug nas bce na mi rnams ltogs shi thebs su 'jug rgyu dang /sdug gsod gtong rgyu'i ched du dka' sdug che cher myong du bcuganyin zhig nga tsho btso na pa lnga bcu tsam spo bo gsum 'alnga mas glo ga khang rgyag sar mi glar btang nas sgru ga khang las grwa de'i las ༷/la dka' 108

dngangs skrag slong ba'i sngog bsher dang / spo bo gsum 'dzoms su btang ba/ 109ngal che sa dang / nyen kha che sa gang yin la nga che bce na pa chod gasnyadang gi 'dug dbo nga mo zhig sku zhabs ri rgya zhu ba'i bla ma mkhyen can zhig yod pas khong gis nyal gur nas gsang gcod du chab gcin galta nga bar phebs skabs/ srung dmag la spru ka'o zhes zhu rgyu brjed par yang / gdug rtsub che ba'i rgya dmag btso na srung bas khong dmar hreng mar ha lam mtshan gang bslangs/ de yang dgun dus gnam gshis grang ngar che sgang yin tsang /khong rus zug rgyag pa'i grang ngar ma bzod par a chu chu zhes rang dbang med par sdug skad yang yang shor yang snying rje spu tsam byed mkhan med pa ni/ mi yul du dngos su dmyal ba grang dmyal rang myong dgos byung ba des rkyen yun ring ma song bar dgongs pa rdzogs/yang nyin zhig btso na grol the ba nas las sgyur byas pa'i ngo shes thub bstan blo bzang zer ba zhig yod des lag mthil la yi ge zhig bris pa'i nang / nga tsho mgyogs po kong po nying khrir spo shug bya rgyu gtan 'khel 'dug ces bris te phran la mig bstan byung / phran nas slo mthun che ra gsang ba'i sgo nas zhus pa yin/ de rjes nyin zhig chodags chen bskongs chosags byas te nga chod sa gnas gzhan zhig tu gnas lha bya rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas shing / 1967 zla 12 par spyod bo gsum 'dzoms nas kong po nying khrir gnas spo byed du bcug byung / rlangs 'khor rer nga tsho mi sum 109

110 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/cu re bcug cing / btson hrogs mang che ba nying khrir 'gro rgyu yin pa ma shes tsang rlangs 'kho ra kha shar phyogs su bsgyur yong bsam pa'i sems khral chen po byed/ gang yin zer na/ rlangs 'khor kha shar phyogs su bskyod na btson grogs mang che ba'i pha yul dang rgyang thag ring du 'gro yi yod/ de nas rlangs 'kho ra kha po gas nub tu bsgyur ma thag tshang ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ kong po nying khrir slebs skabs de gar btson pa brgya cadag gnyis tsam yod 'dug pas kho tsho skul 'ded byas te nga tsho sdod sa'i btson khang gi ra ba/ lcags skud gzer ma ra mgos balha ra ba'i nang smyug ma las baX sa pa'i bce na khang khang mig kha shas gra sgrig byas 'dug sa gnas der spo bo gsum 'dzoms las sdod babs yag pa dang /rtsam pa'i tshad gzhi yang gang mtshams mang ba 'dug rgyun ldan las ka gtso bo shing gcod dang / de nas zhing las dang / tshal las kyang bskul 'ded byed kyi 'dug slob sbyong dang 'thab rtsodad ni sngar bzhin lam ngan chags pa de rang red/skadang po nying khri bsgu na khang de'i nang 19snyo8 lo nas 1969lor lo gcig dzadad ring btson hrogs mal gro ba rba yi tshang thub bstan dzadas 'byedar zer ba lo na 60 tsam son pa zhig yod pas/ khong la rgyun gtan las kar hur brtson med pa dang sgyur bkod rnam 'gyur sdug 110

dngangs skrag slong ba'i sngog baber dang / spo wa gsum 'alnga mas su btang ba/ 111tu phyin lugs mo gas/ snyad 'dodags byas te nyin ma kha shas bsnyud mar chodags chung nang 'thab rtsod rdung rdzog byas stabs phran bu sems 'tsho ma zin pa dang / lus ngo yang shin tu skyo ngo chags te rang 'cho ma zin pa'i nyam thag zhig chags yod kyang / da dung mu mthud ngal rtsol tsha 'ded dang 'thab ce da byas stabs lus kyi zungs zad nas rang sar 'gyel yang / g.yo rdzun byas pa red ces bshad de rkang lag nas 'ju 'then dang rdung rdzog ya nga med pa byas rkyen/ sdug gsod so/ga dus min 'das grongs su gyur/ de ni dpe mcho na tsam las/ de lta bu'i ya nga ba'i gnas tshul ni rgyun gtan gyi rang bzhin zhig red/ kho pa chodas rtag du nga tshad gung khran tang la chodas med kyang gsar brje'i mi chos ring lugs yod zer ba ni rdzun ma yin pa dang / hā shi si'i rtsab spyod ring lags kyi tha shal gyi byed stangs ni ra ra lnga ma yin/ 111
