bcu gcigalo tshad thim nas las shir sgyur ba/96932———97 0969zla 3tshes 2 nyin nga rang khrims chad lo dus lo bcu gtsang nas las mir thon khar lo mang 'thab rtsod kyi drag char rlung 'tshub kyi sbyong brdar dang / hrūd bgam thegs pa'i mdza' brtse'i 'thab grogs slo mthun gtsang rong dga' bde ba slo bzang tshe brtan lags nas phran la gsang ba'i thog nas zhen bskul ka bshad 'di 'dra zhig bris rtsom gnang don du/ka ye hrogs mchog dam pa tshur gson dang // kha zhe med pa'i 'gro kha'i snying gtam ste// sa ler phebs shig lang tshor 'phrod bsten mdzod// nga yang mi 'gyangs myur du bcar ba yin//

sku/ tshad thim nas las mir ra ba 113ca co snyan snyan tshig gi baX/ brid dang // cha ༷shigs mdzes mdzes kun la thugs ma galta da//ja chang la sogs sku la gang 'phrod bsten// nya nyob med pa'i rig gnas spyong la brtson//ta ler rang khyim phyogs su bskyod rgyu dang // tha na re zhig khul der bsdokyigs rgyu sogs//da gakhrodad bo nga rim bka' bzhin sgrub pa las// na tshod phra ba'i rang shed ma mdzod cigapa ru'i khebs ltar sgrig pa'i bslab bya zhig pha ma bzang po'i sa nas thodab pa ltar//ba ber snang tshul bya ba gang 'phrad kyang // ma lus rtsa don 'di dang 'gal med mdzod//rtsa ba dgra gnyen bar ma legs brtag nas// tsha 'jam gang la de 'tshams dgos nges dang //dza drag zhi 'jam gang gi dus su 'ang // wa ltar sdar ma'i mi la dogs zon masprodad//zha zhor bar seng dus tshod nam byung la// za zing sngon chad bya bar chu gas bsdoms kyis//113

114 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang bce sbyang byung ba/'a cag phyin chad mdun lam 'cho la lho gas thad// ya yud min pa'i blang dor shes par mdzod//ra ba lcags kyi balha ra ba'i gnas yul nas// la 'ur sgo gas khyed phebs pa'i shul de ru//sha tsha 'brel yod slo mthun mang po zhig/ sa der re zhig yud lnga ra mi 'gyur ram//ha ha de'ang byis pa'i bsam tshul dang // a re mtshungs pa min pa ci zhig go/ha cang mdza' ba'i grogs nyid bde gyur na// a co rang nyid bde dang khyad par ci// zhes se gas 'kho da 'dug skabs der 'thab bo gas kho rang 'o/ dus gtsang rgyu zla 9 tsam las med pa red/ de bzhin mdza' brtse'i 'thab grogs 'phan po skyid lung ba 'gyur med skal bzang lags kho nga ni rang gi rgyal khab dang / mi rigs la lhag bsam gces zhen che ba/ chodas srid kyi go rtewags ldan pa/ rnam kun nyam chung dma' sa bzung nas bzhugs mkhan zhig dang / lhag par 7bo nga sa skyabs mgo na chen lnga ra bce sa min lhag bsam dang dad gus chen ngotho ldan pa zhig yod/skabs 'gar srid jus phran bu rmig pa'i skabs nga tsho sa 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam skor phan tshun gsang ba'i sgo nas gleng res byed 114

'e1 zurgad thim nas las mir ra ba 115pa'i go skabs byung dus/ rang dbang med par mig chu phrum phrum gtong ba gnang mkhan zhig red/ kho nga yang khrims chad lo dus gtsang rgyu 'o/ gcig lhag tsam las med cing / khong gis kyang phran batheton bo la las mir thon khar/ nga la brtse sems ches cher mngon pa'i zhen bskul yi ge zhig gnang ba'i nang don du/blo bzang skudan tan rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// rab dad mkhas btsun skal bzang bu khyed la// bso/da dman bdag nas re skul tshig gcig zhu//gser btso'i rang rtags nam yang 'gyur med du// brtan gnas thub pa'i 'bad brtsodan gnang rogs mdzod// ces 'khod 'dugade bzhin btso na khang nang lo mang yun ring thun mo nga gi dmigs yul ched du dka' sdug mnyam myong gi spun mched las lhag pa'i brtse gdung dang / sha tsha'i 'brel ba chags pa'i blo mthun mang po zhig dang phan tshun bral mi phod pa'i skyo snang byung ste rang nyid gcig pur ngo gdong mchi mas gang bzhin pa'i ngang / gdung shugs drag wa sa mun nag dang gdug rtsub che ba'i btson rwa 'di las spun zla btson grogs tsho myur du thar nas mgon skyabs chen wa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i chodas srid gnyis kyi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og nga cho rang dbang bde skyid kyi dpal la mnyam du longs su spyod thub pa'i bcos min smon lam rtse gcig tu btab/115

11snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang bcad sbyang byung ba/phyi lo 19snyo9 zla 3 tshes 21 nyin btso na khang 'go khrid las byed pas khyod rang de ring nas btson 'jug lo dus gtsang ba red/nyal gos rnams 'khyer shog brjod de/ las mi'i nang 'byedar skabs btson khang nang ldod gnas mnyam gshib gral rogs yun ring byed myong ba'i se ra'i grwa blo bzang dbang phyug lo gcig gi nga'i sngo na la btson ༷ la las sgyur byung ba zhig yin stabs/ khong gis nga la rtsam pa rgya ma 15 tsam dang /bo zhib rgya ma 15 ras khug gsar pa rang 'grig dang / mar rgya ma gnyis dang mar snod rang 'grigs/ ha yang che chung gnyis/ cha// bye ma ka ra sogs 'dza ba'i dbo sa mkho cha tshang gra sgrig gnang stabs dmigs bsal dka' ngal che ba ma byung /blo bzang dbang phyug ni sems rgyud dul ba'i chodas pa zhig yin/de sngon spo bo'i gsum 'dzoms btson khang du nga cho mnyam du shing gcod byed skabs shing sdong 'og shor nas rmas skyon chen po byung ste/ shi gson dbye 'byed dka' ba'i nyam thag pa'i gnas tshul byung skabs em chi dbang rgyal nas thugs brtse chen lnga sa sman gnang ba dang / phran nas kyang ༷/na zla'i brtse gdung dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i la rgya dam bzung gis snga dgong med par lhag bsam rnam dag gis mo gas ram byas te/ rim bzhin drag skyed byung nas da lta'ang lha sar rnam dkar chos la longs su spyod pa gnang 116

lo zurgad thim nas las mir ra ba 117bzhin yod/phran phyi lo 1969 lor las sgyur byung rjes las mi'i nang du'ang gza' 'khor rer nyin gcig slob sbyong byed dgos pa ltar/ slob sbyong gi nyin mo zhig la rang lo bdun nas kha bral ba'i nga'i gcung mo chung ba bsod nams sgrol mas lha sa nas kong por nga thug 'phrad du slebs kyang /mi lo bcu lhag ngo thug ma byung bar brten phan tshun ngo ma shes par nga la rgan lags 'di gar slo yon zer ba zhig yod dam/ zhes lha sa'i skad gdangs kyis dri skabs/ ngas gdong dbyibs nas nga'i gcung mo bsod naca/sa sgrol ca/ 6pen naca/ snyam nas khyed rang bsod nams sgro'akhri ma yin nam/zhes dris par/ yin zhes brdzod stabs nga blo yon yin zhes brjod de/ngos gcen gcung gnyis dga' skyo zung gis yud tsam 'tham 'khyud byas nas sdod skabs g.yas gasku na du yod pa'i las rogs dang / btson srung dmag mi choda'ang nga gnyis kyi ngang tshul la ya nga ba'i mig chu 'khor ba'i gnas tshul byung /kong po nying khrir nga tshad btson pa las mi bsdoms ru khag drug yod cing / ru khag rer mi brgya tsam yod/ nga tsho'i gtso bo'i las 'gan lci las shing gce da bya rgyu yin/ zla rer mi ser gla phogs mtho lha sa la sgor 30 tsam yod/ nga chod khag gcig la zla rer gla 'o/gas rgya sgor sdi17

118 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/23 re sprod kyi yod pa de'i khongs nas zla re'i za 'byu dang / ja mar/tsha sogs kyi rin 'bab rnams gcog 'then byed skabs zla re sgor lnga nas drug tsam las lhag gi med pas/ de nas mgo bo'i zhwa sna nas rkang pa'i lham bar sku sos lta dgo sa stabs dngul ha cang dgo na pa'i dka' ngal cadag mi tshe skyel dgo sa kyi sku da/ nga tsho las mi khag gcig dud 'bo dang dalnga sa chas lta bu bkodal spyodad byas te/ skabs 'gar gcan gzan ri dwags ma gtogs mthong rgyu med pa'i ha cang dka' nyen che ba'i ri khug gi nags tshal stug po'i khrod du shing gcod par btang ba dang / zla re gla phogs ni rgya dre/ra 23 las med par/ spyi 'o/ 19snyo9 nas 1974 bar lo lnga tsam bsdad/ las sgyur byas pa'i btson khang nas las mir thon snga rting dang / lhag par sgyur bskathod kyi rnam 'gyur legs nyes la bltas nas pha yul so sor 'khor zhag gtong gi sku da cing / sgrur bgo da kyi rnam 'gyur legs nyes zhes pa 'di ni batho na mi mang tsho gas mabo bstodar gto/nga ba dang /btso na mi rnams kyi bsam blo 'ching pa'i g.yo thabs ngan pa zhig red/118

skebacu gnyas/lha sar 'khor zhag tu btang me/477 —la —glo 7thun 97 lor nga mo ru khag drug pa'i khongs nas las mi lnga 'khor zhag btang ba'i khongs phran yang 'khor zhag tu btang yang / las rogs gzhan bzhi po 'a〈snar zhag dus gro da zla gcig sprad kyang phran la 'kho ra zhag dus cho da nyin bcu las ma sprad/rnam kun nas srid dang 'brel ba'i gtam bshad sogs rgya mi'i lta ba dang / chab srid kyi dgos mkhor mi bstun mkhan nga chos bsguran grogs khag gcig la dmigs bsal hotegs ga1—na dang /sdang zug las yul dka' nyen che sar gtong ba dang / gla phogs thog cadar gcig yin na'ang sdug gyong gto/nga gang thub byed pa sogs kyi thabs ngan la rten/ las mi rnams kyi khrod nga tsho'i gnya' gcog gang thub byed rgyu ni kho tsho'i srid jus shig red/9

120 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/mi lo 12 tsam kha bral ba'i dga' gces cadas pa'i pha ༷༅la lha sar slebs kyang / khyim tshang ni rgya dmar btsan 'dzul pas btsan 'asngo ga gzhung bzhes dang / lhag lus spun mched chod gral rim dgra bo'i kho ngas su bzhag ste mtshams tshigs med pa'i ngal rtsol dang / cadags mtha' med pa'i 'dri gtser/ bzod dka' ba'i 'thab 'dzings/ rdung rdeg gtong ba dang gzhon nu chod ni 'o/ga spyodad pa'i nang mi'i gras su bzhag ste gral rim bu phrug zer ba sogs kyi ming sna ce gas btags te/ mi mang spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i lta stangs kyi gla med ngal rtsol skul 'ded dang / mthong chung snyad bcos rdung rdeg myong dgos kyi 'dug skabs der nga'i gcung mo rig pad lags stod lung bde chen du gral rim bu phrug zer ba khag gcig ngal rtsol byed par btang ba'i khongs 'ahro dgos byung ste khyim du bsdad med cing / der brten nyin gnyis tsam ring nga'i gcen po 'das po'i sku zla blo bzang dzadas sgron sar bsdad/blo bzang dzadas sgron lags kyang skabs der 'e ga spyodad kyi zhwa mo gasku gas nas mi mang gi lta ce ga cadag gnas/ de nas gcung smad rig pad lags yong ste kho mo'i khyim du 'gro skabs sdod khang ni mun nag gsang gcod dang skya 'brel zhig nang bzhag sku da tsang khyim tshang nang bapu ga gcin gyi dri ngan bro zhing / gcin pa'i gzha' tshan che ba de nang sne len gyis 120

lha sar 'khe ra zhag tu btang ba/ 131'khos dpag gang sku nga gzab gzab byas byung / gcung mo'i sar rkang bsdad nas de nas spun mched gzhan mo dang / dga' nye slo dkar tshos nyin gnyis sne len dang sems 'khur rogs ram 'o/ga dgongs pa dus tshod nyin bcu rdzogs/da dung dus zod de'i ring spun mched lhag lus tsho dang / ngo gtug gis byams brtse bkrin mtshungs med pa lags dang / gcen po/gcen mo 'das po tsho'i ya nga ba'i lo rgyus dang / so so'i yid skyo ba'i dka' sdug gnas stangs cadang ba rnams phan tshun thodad res kyis sems sdug gi mig chu dang kha ma bral bar sdod dgos byung / de nas lha sa'i nye 'dabs skar dgon du bzhugs pa'i gcen mo rgan lha sa dbyangs can lags kyis 'bras ༄4ngas dgon du mche da mjal zhig tu khrid gnang /skabs der 'bras sgungs dgo na pa ni se 'bras dga' gsum nas gto/ra bshig spradag chung cadas shig yin yang / dgo na pa'i mdun ngo sa su khra sil sil sku da pa tsam las rgyab tu galta ra bshig mang po btang 'dug de nyin 'bras spungs dbo na du bzhugs pa'i rgan lam rim rin khrod che mjal 'ange da yod pa ltar gcen mos rgyus yodad gnang ste 'khrid byung /rgan rin po che'i gzim shag tu bcar skabs phyi sgo sgo lcags skyon 'dug kyang / sge'u khung nang rgan rin po ches gcen mo ngos gnyis 121

122 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gzigs ma thag lde mig gnang byung bas/ nang du bcar skabs rgan gyi gzim shag nang sku gsung thugs rten sngar bzhin mjal rgyu sku da pa ma zad/lhag par ha las ya mtshan che ba zhig la 7lha nga sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen wa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku brnyan zhal thang gser bris shig mjal skabs/bstan dgra rgya dmar gyis trī la'i ru chodags la ngo sga la dang dgag pa rgyag dbo sa zer ba'i las 'gul gang sar spel nas 7rgyal ba'i sku dpar tsam yang / mjal rgyu med pa'i btsan gce na dam drag cadag nga tsho 'o/ mang yun ring sdod dgos byung tsang / de nyin 'jig rten gzhan zhig tu slebs pa lta bu'i dga' skyo zad mi shes pa byung ste lus po yongs rdzogs dga' snang gi slog 'khyud pa ltar sbir zhing / rang dbang med par mig chu phrum phrum shor bzhin par rgyal ba'i sku dpar mthong grol rin po cher sku phyag gsum phul te/ 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku tshe khri 'o/ra brtan pa dang / thugs bzhed lhun gyis 'grub nas bod ljo ngas mun nag thug sprodas ma sgrib go nga / 'phags pa'i yul nas myur du zhabs se ra 'kho da de bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen du zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gdung shugs drag sngo sa smon lam gsol 'debs zhus/rgan lam rim ni 19snyo0 lor phreng ring btson khang sgo ang gnyis pa'i nang bzhugs skabs rgan rin po ches rde'u bcud len gnang 122

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 133gi yod pa'i mdzad pa phran tsam go thos yod pas/ skabs 'gar nga tshog sgo ang dang po'i btson pa dang / gcin pa gtong bar mnyam du khel skabs sngon las lta bus rgan rin po che mjal ma thag rang bzhin gyi dga' gus dad gsum 'phel te/ nga la kha stob byi ril gnyis gsum zhig yodad pa de za ma nus par rgan lam rim la gsang thabs kyis phul bas rgan dgyes mnyes byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams/ snyan seng zhus par rgan nas thugs dran gsos te ā tsi de skabs khyed rang phru gu rang yin/ da gzhon pa chags 'dug snying rje gsungs ste rgan nas rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs sku nyen la ma 'dzems par sa dge bka' rnying gi 7rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po sung skyob gnang ba rnams mjal kha gnang ba ma zad/ 1955 lor bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang zer ba btsugs skabs 7bo nga sa mche ga gis gnang ba'i bka' slob gsung bshad dpe thung zhig mjal kha gnang nas de skru ga dang zhes gsungs byung bas/ phran nas klog skabs gsung bshad dpe thung de'i nang rgya mi ni bod la rogs ram byed par yong ba las/ dpon po byed par yong ba ma red/gal te kha chad ltar 〈sna tshos wa da la las ka yag the ma byas na/ nga tshos kho tsho phyir 'bud byed pa'i dbang cha yod ces dang / yang gsungs bshad dum bu zhig nang nga tshos spyi don thog lhag bsam rnam dag byas pa 123

124 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/yin na/ ri khrod du bsdad nas chos shig byed ma thub kyang 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka'i don chen de thog nas sgrub thub pa yong gi red/ ces pa sogs bka' slob gnang yod pa shes rtogs byung / de nas rgan rin po ches khyodad gnyis kyis nang tshags byas nas ja dang / kha lag gang za 'alnga da kyang bakhrodas te khyim tshang ltar byas te sdod ces gsungs pa bzhin de ltar zhus/ 'ahro khar yang rjes su 'brel ba yang yang byed dgos/ kong po nying khri shing gapu da las grwa'i las mi'i kho ngas nga'i dge phrug ye shes dzadas grags yod pas khyed tsho phan tshun ngo shes bzos te/ 'brel ba byed dgos zhes bka' slob gnang byung ba ltar ye shes dzadas grags lags dang 'brel lam zhu thub pa byung /nyin gcig 19snyo0 lor phreng ring btson khang nang mnyam du sdod myong ba'i a mdo ye shes kyi nga lha sar 'khor zhag slebs pa shes te kho pa'i bza' zla bu phrug bcas mnyam du ja dang / kha stodab sogs 'khyer te nga gnyis ngo thug byung ma thag phan tshun gnyis shi gson 'phrad pa lta bu'i dga' skyo tshad med kyis yud tsam 'tham 'khyud byas te sgyu da skabs ye shes kyi bza' zla dang / nga'i gcung mo tshos nga gnyis la ya nga yid skyo nas tshang mas ngus nas bsdad cing / ye shes kyis nga btson khang nang mi yul gyi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong skabs khyed rang gis de nyin la ma 'dzems 124

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 125par/ nga la sems 'khur zodags ram ha cang chen wa gnang ba ni ngas nam yang brjed thabs med/ ngas khyed rang rtsad gcod mang po byas kyang rtsad chod ma byung / de ring ngos gnyis ngo thug byung ba shin tu dga' po byung/khyed rang la dbo sa mkho gang sku da kyang nga la cadad mo gas ngas kha zhe gnyis med dang / rang med gzhan 'chodal gyi rogs ram byed kyi yin bshad/gnangs nyin ye shes kyi khyim du mthodan 'bod byas pa ltar bskyodad skabs kho nga gi bza' zla kha tsha ra yin pas/ khyim tshang nang cha sgam mchod gshom sku gsung thugs rten sngar bod rang btsan yod skabs kyi gnas stangs 'dra ba mjal skabs/ kho chodar yid spyodan skye bzhin du mdzadad gcadam mdun so/nga nas rang cag ngo da mi rnams la'ang 'di dang 'dra ba'i khe dbang myur du thob pa sna ga ces/ gdung shugs drag po sa smon lam btab/ngas ye shes kyi bza' zla dbang mo lags su khyed snu kha tsha ra rnams phyi mir rtsis te de sngon spyi tshogs rnying pa dang 'dra ba'i rang dbang 'dug ces brdzod par/ dbang mo lags nas da lta'i krung go'i mi ser dang rang dbang bsdur na gang cir nga tsho rang dbang che ba yod kyang / sngon spyi tshogs rnying pa dang bsdur na rang dbang med/ dper na/ nga tsho kha tsha ra lha sa'i skyid chu'i zam chen brgal nas 'gro ba'i rang dbang med pa dang / nga ra'i bza' zla sku ga spyod kyi zhwa mo yod pa/ de bzhin wa da mi mang che ba dang /125

1nasnyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/lhag par bla ma dge bshes dang shes sku na can/ de min mi sna bsam sku da can rnams la rang dbang med par mi tsho'i slo yul du 'char dka' ba'i mnar gcodad dang / dka' sdug 'thab rtsodad byed pa so/gas lus sems skad cig tsam yang bde ba med par nyin mtshan 'khyodal dka' ba'i mi yul gyi dmyal ba dalnga sa cadang gis bkra mi shis pa'i gnas tshul rtag tu mthodang rgyu dang go rgyu yod tsang / ga dus yin na'ang 'jigs dngangs kho na'i nang sngo da dgo sa kyi 'dug ces dang / khyedad kyis ye shes lags su mo gas ram chen dze gnang 'dug par ye shes lags nas khyed kyi lha ra yang yang gsungs kyi 'dug da res khyed gnyis mjal bar nga chod pha ma bu phrug tshang ma dga' po byung / khyed la sku ngal gang 'dug gsung rogs gnang / nga chodas dga' po'i ngang khyed la rogs ram zhu yi yin zhes brjod pa ltar khong tsho sa nga la gang yong byas byung /lha sar zla ba gnyis dang phyed tsam sdod ring sprun nye zos gdung sems mnyam skyed kyi sems 'khur zo gas ram cadag dga' skyod gnyis kyi mor ba zad mi shes pa byung / skabs der nga'i bsam blo'i nang rang gi sprun mched lhag lus rgan garsha na cho dang / de bzhin sha tsha 'brel yod kyi spun zla tsho sa nga la yid ches dga' zhen dang rogs ram re ba byed so/sa shig tu brtsi ba ni/ rang ngo sa nas 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bka' 126

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 127bzhin bya ba bzang snga cung zad cig byed thub pa'i 'bras bzang smin pa zhig yin pa las/ rang sger gyi nus pa ni rgya mtsho'i chu thigs tsam zhig yin/las 'bras bslu med zer ba ni de 'dra zhig yin pa 'dra snyam pa'i yid ches dang go rtogs gting zab tu 'gro thub pa byung ste/ sngar bas rtsa don mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i lhag bsam la skul ma ches cher thebs/nyin zhig sprun mched lhag lus khag gcig ngo 'dzoms sar gcen mo dbyangs can lags nas gsungs dodan/spyi lo 1959 lo'i lo mjug tu phra da dmag khul khang gis btson khang nas pa lags khong rnam pa'i gras khag gcig dbye 'byed kyis nor bu gling khar btang 'dug khong tsho nor bu gling khar phebs rjes btson khang 'go khrid chosas khyodad cho rgya nag la ngal lca la sgyur bkod la 'gro dgos pa red ces/ khyab bsgrags byas nas nyin lnga tsam zhig nor gling du bzhag ring / btson khang gzhung sgo'i sge'u khung nas chu tshod skar ma bco lnga nang mi thug 'phrad kyi go skabs sprad pa ltar/ nga dang gcen mo chos mchod lags ngos gnyis la pa lags mjal phrad kyi go skabs thob skabs/ ngos gnyis nas khong mjal ma thag sems skyo nas mig chu rang dbang med par shodar te khyed rang rgya nag tu gtong gi yod pa 'dra gang drag gam/ zhes zhus par/ khong gis khyodad dza sems sdug ma byed/ rgya nag tu 'gro mkhan 127

128 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/nga gcig pu ma red/ khyod gnyis ltos dang / zhes gsungs nas btson khang nang lta skabs rgyal gces btso na pa mang po phar tshur phebs pa rgyang nas mthong gi 'dug pas/ khong sa tshang mar nga rang tso dang 'dra ba'i pha ma sprun mched dang bza' zla bu phrug ye da pa sha stag red/ sems khral byas te phan the gas med/ de bas khyodad phru gu snu phan tshun 'cham mthun dang gcig phan gcig mo gas byed dgo sa pa dang / phru gu chung ba tshadar byams skyong byed rogs/ da lta spen sgrol dang / bu slo yon gnyis btson khang du yod pas khong gnyis la khyod tshos lta skyong byed rogs/ snying rje zhes dang / gce nge pa phas bslab bya nan lnga bya rgyu zhig la phrug gu rgan gazlo na tshang mas rtag tu sems la yag khrod bzhag mo gas/ ngas khyedad snu yang bskyar thug pa'i 'bad brtson dang spyodan lam rtag tu brgyag gi yin/ khyod tsos lta ba ma 'e/ga pa gyis shig ces gsungs/ngos gnyis nas sems sdug gi mig chu rang dbang med par shor bzhin par kho nga la dbu gtugs zhus te sku gzugs la thugs lcag dang /nga sa mgyogs po mjal ba'i dgongs bzhes dang thugs smon gnang rogs/nga tshos khyed kyi bka' slob rnams rtag tu snying bcangs zhu yi yin/ nga snu phru gu cho gcig phan gcig mo gas byed bzhin sku/da pas thugs khral mi dgo sa/ zhes zhus rjes de nas btson srung las byed pas thug phrad dus sdi28

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 129chod rdzogs so/ zhes bshad de/ nga mo pha bu yid skyo'i ngang kha bral ba'i nyin mo de nas bzung pa lags yang bskyar mjal ba'i go skabs ma byung /de nyin nam mkhar sprin nag zang zing rab tu 'khrug cing / kha ba dang rlung 'tshub kyi sa gzhi chen po mun nag lta bur gyur pa des nga tsho nang mi thug mkhan mang po slebs yod pa tshor skyo sems dang / sdug bsngal snon ma zhig byung / nga chodas rang gi pha ma dang / bza' zla bu phrug nang mi spun mched dzad btso na bcug byas pa'i gnas yul de nas kha bral mi 'o/da par tshang mas ngus nas 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bzhugs gnas sgyu brang la kha gtad de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bskyar du dar ba dang /nga tsho bod 'bangs rnams mun nag bzod dka'i sdug bsngal las myur du thar ba'i spyodan lam zhu rgyu las/ de min bya thabs med par gyur nas sems stong lha nger phyir log yong ba yin zhes gsungs/yang de rjes gcen mo dbyangs can lags dang / gcen mo chodas 'jo mas lags thun mong nas gsungs dodan/spun mched mang po 'das grongs song ba'i nang nas spen sgron lags gshegs skabs sems sdug dang blo pham che shos byung / kho nga ni lo na chung ba dang lhag par chos srid rig gnas kyi shes sku na gang legs sku da pa ma zad/ bstan srid mi rigs la gces zhen lhag bsam ldan zhing /129

1zha0 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rang gi pha ma gnyis la gus brtse dang spun mched sar sems 'khur brtse sems che ba/ gzhan la gang nus phan sems dang / stabs bsnyun mkhas pa bcas la brten phyi nang gi mi tshang mas yid ches dang dga' sngo byed yul zhig tu gyur yod/khong ni phyi 'o/ 1959 lo'i zla 3 tshes 12 nyin bod kyi bud med chodags pa dza drag gi gsar 'dzugs byed mkhan 'go khrid gras su yod khar/ tshogs pa'i drung che'i las 'gan blangs te las 'gan sgrub pa de rgya dmar nas ngo log zing 'khrug snyadang mkhan zer ba'i nyes ming btags nas spyi 'o/ 1959 zla 3 nang 'dzin bzung gis mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes btsan 'phrog dang / kho nga la dus bkag btso na 'jug 'o/ brgyad kyi nyes chad 'o/ga cing / skabs der sku zla chodas 'phel byams pa lags (bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs yin/) nor bu gling khar yod pas gar song cha med du gyur/rang lo drug la son pa'i bu dbang chen dge legs dang / rang lo bzhi la son pa'i bu mo ngag dbang sgrol dkar gnyis da phrug lta bur gyur stabs/ bu dbang chen dge legs gcen mo dbyangs can lags nas bdag skyong gnang dgos byung ba dang / bu mo ngag dbang sgrol dkar chodas 'phel byams pa lags kyi a ma bgres mo sa bdag skyodang gnang dbo sa byung /130

lha sar 'khe ra zhag tu btang ba/ 131spen sgron lags phreng ring btson khang dang grwa bzhi btson khang la bzhugs rgyun ring nga cho sa rang gis cha rkyen la dpag pa'i btson khang nang thug 'phrad gtong ba'i dus tshod la thug phrad du phyin nas lta skyong gang yong zhus yod/ de rjes 1961 lo'i lo mjug tu grwa bzhi btson khang du yod pa'i spen sgron lags khong tsho'i gras bud med btson pa nad pa khag gcig lha sa mi dmangs sman khang du brtag dpyad sman bcos su btang 'dug em chis khong zor brtag dpyad byas rjes spen sgron lags nad gzhi lci po sku da gnas kyis sman khang du gnas skabs sman bce sa su bzhag dgos bshad pa ltar/ mi dmangs sman khang du nyar ba dang / de min bud med nad pa tsho phyir 'o/ga btang / mi dmangs sman khang du bzhugs ring spyir btang mi dmangs spyi mtshungs ltar sman bcos byed pa las dmigs gsal lta srung byed mkhan med stabs/ spen sgron lags nas lnga shes shig brgyud chos 'dzoms lags sngo sa gnyis la lan zhig bskur te/ nga na nas mi dmangs sman khang du sman bcos la btang byung bas/ gcen mo gnyis po thug 'phrad zhig tu phebs rogs gnang / zhes pa'i lan brda 'byor ma thag bod ja ja dam gang dang / kha stob bcas 'khyer te thug 'phrad du 'gro skabs sman khang nang lta srung byed mkhan med stabs/ phan tshun sning gtam lhug ngo ra shod pa'i go skabs sprodab ste pa lags kyi gnas stangs dang /31

132 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang brtsa sbyang byung ba/nga'i gnas stangs skor/ de bzhin sku lnga chodas 'phel byams pa lags (spen sgron lags kyi sku zla gaslo na pa/) zing 'khrug skabs rmas skyodan byung yang / rgya gar du btsan byedal la phebs thub pa byung ste rgya gar nas bal po phran bu ngo shes shig mdun sku ngo'i sku dpar dang / dngul phran bu/ phyag bris bcas ches gsang ba'i thog nas 'phrod 'gyor byung /phyag bris nang snu sa mdzad lags (gcen mo/ dbyangs can lags )khyed nas nga'i phru gu bdag skyong gnang bar thugs rje che/ da dung byams skyong gang legs yong ba dang / rjes su mjal skabs bka' drin gsol dzadag pa zhes 'khod pa dang / sku dpar spen sgrol lags su sprad par/ khong gi sku ngo'i sku dpa/ra der yun tsam gzigs te mig zhag 'kho ra bzhin par sku jo rgya gar du phebs thub pa ni zhe drag yag po byung / gal te 'dzin bzung du tshud sku da na nga tsho mnyam du sdug po cadang rgyu las gzhan yong rgyu med/ de'i thog nga blo bde po byung / a cag lags sku ngo'i sku dpar dang phyag bris de med pa bajo sa gnang na ma gtogs rgya mis shes na nag nyes chen snga ra rtsis nges yin pas rjes su don med sku ngal bzos yodang zhes gsungs/mi dmangs sman khang du zla gcig lhag bzhugs ring gse la chas gang 'dod ltar 'bul rgyu byung ba dang / spun mched mo thug 'phrad lhod lhod byed pa'i go skabs stes dbang stabs legs shig byung / nyin zhig 132

lha sar 'khor zhag tu btang ba/ 1sku spen khrodan lags nas cad shes shig brgyud a cag lags gnyis yud tsam sman khang du phebs mo gas gnang zhes lan zhig 'byedar 'phral/ sman khang du bskyod skabs slo bur snyun gzhi je sdug song 'dug pas de nyin zhal ras sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ldog byung nas dmar nag chags te nyal khri'i steng gzims 'dug kho nga gnyis webs pa gzigs ma thag glu tsi a cag lags gnyis phebs byung / zhes gsungs nas gus brtse che ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan te nyal khri'i steng nas sdug rus kyis stod langs bskyon rtsis byas kyang bskyon dka' ba zhig tu gyur/khong gnyis nas spen sgron lags snyun gzhi gang 'dra 'dug zhus par/ a cag lags nga na tsha phran bu sdug tu song 'dug nye lam nga'i rmi lam dang da lta'i nad gzhi'i babs la bltas na nga mi yong ba mi 'dugangs rtag tu re ba dang smon lam la nga rang ma 'chi gong 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mcho thengs gcig mjal ba'i re ba chen po yod kyang / re ba de bsgrub khag po chags/ nga rang mi yul du yud tsam sdod ring mi dge ba'i las ngan shes bzhin byas pa med/ lhag par skabs bab wa da kyi bstan srid mi rigs kyi don du rang nus gang yod lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhabs 'debs zhus yodad bsams pa'i gdeng tsod yod pa des 'chi yang 'gyod pa med/133

134 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/'on kyang sman khang 'di'i nang 'chi mi dgos pa a cag khyed gnyis kyis thabs shes mo gas ram gnang mo gas zhes gsungs/ kho nga gnyis nas de 'dra yin na su la 'brel ba byed dbo sa kyi red ces bcadad skabs/ spen sgron lags nas nga chorware btson khang 'bo khrid la nad dbo ngas zhu dgos gsungs pa ltar/ khong gnyis grwa bzhi'i btson khang du bskyod nas 'brel yod bsgu na khang 'go khrid las byed lnga thug gis ngo sa gnyis spen sgrol gyi spun mched yin/ kho nga nad mnar gyis mi dmangs sman khang du sman bce sa su slebs kyang phan nus ma thodan par nad gzhi nyin bzhin je sdug tu song nas gson pa'i re thag chod stabs/ khong gi phru gu dang nga tsho spun mched tsho'i re ba la khong nad dgongs yong ba'i re ba zhu bar yong ba yin zhes brjod par/ bod pa las byed des de'i skor gong rim la snyan seng zhu dgo sa/ khyodad gnyis to/ga tsam sgug dgo sa brjodad pa ltar chu che da gcig lhag tsam sgug rjes de nas bod rigs las byed cig slebs/gong rim zer ba de red/ mi de ni de sngon gcen mo khong gi sku zla rgan pa ye shes dar rgyas lags kyi gzim shag dben dbo na gyi gasku ga wa wa sa dre la du mo nga nas rgya nag tu slob sbyodang la bskyod pa zhig yin pa dang / khos nga mo ngo shes kyang ma shes tshul gyis ngo gdong nag po'i 134

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 135rnam 'gyur bstan stabs/ ngos gnyis snying mgo rting log pa lta bur gyur nas da ni nge na dag bsgrub ma song bsam nas sems 'tshab 'jigs snang gi sdod skabs/ 'go khrid las byed des ngos gnyis kyi mgo nas mjug bar zhib mor bltas te khyod gnyis spel sgron gyi spun mched yin pas zhes dris par/ lnga sa gnyis spen sgron gyi spun mched pha gcig ma gcig yin/ nye lam kho nga rang nad mnar gyi 'di nas mi dmangs sman khang du sman bcos ྅༅ btang gnang yang / phan nus ma thon par nad gzhi nyin bzhin ji sdug song nas da mtshams mi yong ba'i re ba mi 'dugakhong la phru gu dang nga tsho spun mched kha shas yod pas nga tsho'i thun mong gi re ba la khong shi gso/na dbye ba ma chodad bar nad dgongs shig tu gastodang gnang skyabs 'jug thugs rje gzigs zhu bar yong ba yin/ gal te rjes su drag skyed byung mtshams srid gzhung la rtsis 'bul zhus chodag pa dang / nad dgongs su sdod ring gnas tshul gang yang mi lhag pa'i ngos gnyis nas khag theg su btsugs dbo sa kyang btsugs kyi yin la/ kho nga 'chi gson dbye ba ma chodad bar sngo sa gnyis nas gcig mi tshab bce na khang nang sdod dgos kyang sdod kyi yin zhes ngu 'bod byed bzhin par las byed de'i rkang par phyag 'tshal skabs las byed des de 'dra su'i lugs srol red/ de ni spyi chogs rnying pa'i lugs srol byed stangs shig red/ spen 135

13snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang bce sbyang byung ba/sgron gyi nad gzhi'i stodar mi dmangs sman khang nas nga chodar snyan seng slebs byung / nad gzhi lci po yod pa dngos yod red/ 'on kyang khong gnyis kyi zhu dodan ltar ngas lam seng thag gce da mi thub pas go nga rim la snyan seng zhus te dgongs zhu chodag mchan thob min lan brda byas sku nga / khyod gnyis tog tsam skug dgos zhes bshad de phyi tshul ngo gdong nag po bstan pa tsam las/ don du nga gnyis la snying rje'i rnam 'gyur mngon gyi 'dugachu tsho da gnyis lhag tsam ring bsam don grub pa'i spyodan lam 'debs shing sgug pa ltar/ las byed de yong nas khyod tsho'i zhu don ltar nad dgongs chodag mchan bka' 'kho la thob song / nad dgongs su sdod ring gnas tshul mi lhag pa'i 'gan khyodad tsho sa 'khyer dbo sa pa ma zad/ nad gzhi drag skyed byung na mi dmangs srid gzhung la rtsis sprodad zhu dgo sa zhes bshad nas dbo ngas 'kho la yig cha dmar tham 'kho da pa sna ga lhe gcig sprad/ngos gnyis shin tu dga' ba'i ngang gtam bzang de spen sgrol lags su ma bshad gong thad kar khyim tshang du bskyod de ja srub ma ja dam gang 'khyer nas mi dmangs sman khang du bskyodad skabs spen sgro na lags nyal khri'i steng gzims 'dug pas/ ngos gnyis slebs pa gzigs skabs 65 byurdo thug cag lags gnyis phebs byung zhes ga3༅ngas te nyal khri nas 3kyig rus kyi ltod langs bskyon skabs ngos gnyis nas khyod rang ltod por gzims 136

lha sar 'khor zhag tu btang ba/ 137bzhugs/ yar bzhengs mi dbo sa zhus kyang lnga sa gnyis la gus zhabs gnang ste stod langs bskyon/ngos gnyis kyis spen sgron lags khyed rang nad dgongs bka' 'khrol thob song zhes zhus par/ a tsi dngos gnas red dam/ mgyogs po de 'dra dgongs pa 'khrol e yong zhes gsungs te yid mi ches pa lta bu gnang bar/ lnga sa gnyis nas rgya yig thog bris pa'i nad dgo ngas yig cha de nad khang nang mnyam yod bod rigs las byed bud med nad pa zhig yod pa der klog rogs zhus pas/ khong gis klog pa 'di ltar/ nyes can spen sgro la nad gzhi tshabs che bas gsar brje'i mi chodas rings lugs kyi srid jus gzhir bzung kho mo'i spun mched bu phrug tsho'i re 'dun ltar/nad gzhi drag skyes ma byung bar nad dgongs so/nga bas sa gnas kyi 'asga khrid slo mthun mos kho mor mthun 'gyur rogs ram yong ba zhu/ zhes nang don legs lnga 'khod par spen sgrol lags ha cang dga' ngo byung nas mig zhag 'khor bzhin par ngo sa gnyis kyis lag nas 'jus te/ dbu gtugs gnang nas da res a cag khyed gnyis kyi nga la mo gas ram chen po gnang bar ngas khyed gnyis la bka' drin gsol re bral yang / khyed gnyis sprod wa sku nga ba'i smon lam zhu yi yin/ zhes gsungs nas spyan chab gnang / ngos gnyis ni khong gi ngang tshul gnas stangs dang /137

138 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gsungs stangs la snying rje skye zhing / spun mched kyi brtse ba sngar bas zab tu song /ngos gnyis nas da ni dgongs pa thob zin pas/ khyed rang skar dgon (gcen mo dbyangs can lags kyi khyim tshang ) dang / lha sgrig cho nga khang (gcen mo/ chodas 'dzoms lags kyi khyim tshang ) gang du bzhugs min thugs 'dodad ltar bzhugs sa gra sgrig byed kyi yin zhus par/ spen sgron lags kyis de gnyis kar gra sgrig gnang mi dbo sa par/ a ṇi'i mtshams khung dgon du sdod khang chung ngu zhig thob thabs gnang rogs gsungs pa ltar/ skabs der chos dad rang mos yin zhes bshad de mtshams dbosnan du btsun ma rgan pa khag gcig bzhugs yod pa dang / tshes bzang dus bzang so sor dgon pa'i 'du khang nang tshogs 'tshogs pa'i rang dbang phran bu yod pa red/ dgon pa'i 'gan 'dzin sku zhabs dbu mdzad lags su spen lha la lags btson khang nas nad gzhi drag skyes ma byung bar nad dgongs btang bas/ khong gi re ba ltar mtshams dgon du sdod shag chung ngu zhig gnas skabs g.yar rnge gnang ro/gas zhus par/ sku zhabs dbu mdzad lags kyis khas len gang legs gnang ba dang / btsun ma bgres gaslo na tshang mas gdung sems mnyam skyed kyis zodags ram mdzad de zla gnyis tsam mtshams dgon du btsun ma dang mnyam du gsol chodags 138

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 139su bzhugs pa dang / sman bcadas rim gro gang yong zhus par brten/ snyun gzhi phran bu drag skyed byung nas zhal 'don dge sbyor la rtse gcig 'bad 'bungs gnang ba'i go skabs thodab/'on kyang nyin zhig glo bur snyun gzhi je sdug song bas spun mched bu phrug rnams 'dzoms nas nyin gang mnyam du bzhugs pa dang /dgong dro'i chu tshod drug pa'i mtshams bu dbang chen dge legs kyi mgo bo byil byil gnang nas da bu rang log na ma gto/gas skar dgon bar sa thag ring po sku da/ sru mo lags khong tsho'i zhal la 'un po lcos/ a mas khyed tsho spro po sku nga ba'i smon lam brgyag yong zhes brtse dung chen pos zhal chems lta bu bzhag gnang rjes bu dbang chen dge legs phyir slog gnang /de nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod bcu pa'i mtshams la snyun gzhi de bas je sdug tu song bas/ kho nga gis a cag lags khyed rnam pas nga la rogs ram ha cang chen lnga gnang bar/ ngas khyed rnam par bka' drin gsol ma thub pa blo 'gyod che yang byed thabs dben/ ngas khyed rnam spro po yong ba'i smon lam zhu yi yin/ da ni a cag lags gnyis dang spun mched chos nga'i mdun ma bzhugs phro gas gnang / zhes gsungs mdangs ha cang nyam pa'i sgo nas gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni spun mched tshang ma sems sdug gis dbang med ngu ngag 'chor na khong bsam gtan du gnas rgyur gnod dogs red/139

14༷ nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/de nas 7rgyal ba rin po ches rigs lnga bzhes pa'i sku dpar zhig gnang rogs gsungs pa ltar/ 'phral du thabs 'asnu la gyis phul thub pa byung rjes nga chod spun mched tshang ma khong gi nye 'gram la ma bsdad par bzhugs khang phyi rol du thon/yud tsam nas sku zhabs dbu mdzad lags phyir phebs te dbo ngas pa rdzogs so/nga zhes gsungs ma thag nang du 'aspyod skabs ljags dbugs chad zin yang / 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku dpar de phyag nang dam por 'jus gnang stabs phyag mdzub re re byas te kha dbye nas sku dpar tshur blang dgos byung ba ni/ nam rgyun khong rang rnal 'byedar ma'i nyams len gnang gi sku da pas dgo ngas pa cadags khar yang rtse gcig nyams len la gzhe la thub pa min nam snyam/ nga tsho sa kho nga gis thugs re ltar mo gas phan zhu thub par phan 'bras chen po thob / spen sgron lags ni dngos 'brel bu mo las sru wa zhig ma red/ kho nga gi gshis spyodad des nga cho ra sems 'gul zebs pa dang / bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag byung zhes gsungs sku /yang de rjes gcen mo chodas 'dzoms lags kyi sku zla ye shes bso/da nams lags ni/ 1959 lo'i zing 'khrug skabs 'dzin bzung tshud de rnga chen slog khang las mi'i khongs ngal rtsol gnang nas bzhugs dgo sa byung zhing / khong gis gsungs don/ 19snyo0 lo ra jo lags 140

lha sar 'alta ra zhag tu btang ba/ 141bkra shis snyedabs rgyal lags (phran gyi gcen ngo /) snyun gzhi sdug po yod pa'i gnas tshul snga rjes go thos byung yang / las ka'i da7/'a ngal gyi rkyen pas lta rtogs byed par 'ahro ma thub/ de rjes nyin zhig snyun gsos phran bu 'khyer te phyin/ de nyin jo lags gzim khri'i steng ltod langs kyis phyag bris shig bris gnang nas bzhugs 'dug ngas bkra shis stobs rgyal lags snyun gzhi gang 'dra 'dug gam/ bar skabs nga las ka'i dka' ngal gyi rkyen pas mjal bar yodang ma thub pas/ thugs pham med pa gnang rogs zhus par/ jo lags nas nye lam nga'i nad gzhi cung drag tu song yang / gzhi rtsa'i nad gzhi lci po 'dug ces gsungs/ de nas ngos gnyis pā lags rgya nag btson khang nang sku khams bde thang yin min dang gnas stangs cadar bka' mo la byung bas/ jo lags nas nye lam pā lags kyi phyag bris shig phebs pa'i nang nga 'di gar skyid po yod pas phru gu zo sems khral mi dgos zhes 'khod kyang / phyag bris gnang sa'i shog bu 'dir bltas na sgo po yod bzo 'dug gam/ zhes gsungs te phyag bris nga la bstan/shodag bu hral hrul zhig gi thog phyag bris gnang ba'i nang don la/nga 'di gar bde po'i ngang gnas yodad pas phru gu sa sems khral mi dgos/khyod zos dngul bskur ba rnams yi ge nang gsal grangs tshang lag son byung ba dang / phan thogs ha cang chen po byung / ngas khyod tsho gang mgyogs 141

142 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/thug pa'i smon lam rtag tu byed bzhin yod ces 'khod/jo lags nas da res kyi phyag bris der bka' lan dang dngul 'bul bskur zhus na phran bu thugs phan gsos kyi yod pa 'dra/ der brten nga cho sprun mched sas che 'bul chung 'bul gyis dngul bsdus pa rnams 'bul bskur zhu rtsis yod gsungs/ ngas kyang zhal 'debs phran bu 'bul thub byung / jo lags nas phyag bris gnang zin rjes yig stodag nang bcug ste phyag bris de phyag gnyis kyi dbu'i rtser bsnam nas spyan chab phrum phrum bsil bzhin par thugs smon yun ring gnang ring / nga rang yang sems skyo nas mig chu dbang med du shor/ de rjes jo lags yun ring ma bzhugs par dgongs pa rdzogs so zhes gsungs/nyin bcu'i 'khor zhag de zla ba gnyis lhag 'gor bas 'jigs 'tsher ngang kong po nying khri smre mo shing gcod las grwa'i khongs rang gi ru khag drug par 'byedar ma thag las mo gas chodas/ khyed rang mnyam du btang ba'i las mo gas gzhan bzhi sngo slebs nas dus dza da yun ring phyin/ byams pa 'phrin las ni zla gcig 'khor zhag dus dza da ma zin bo nga phyir 'o/ga ste ru khag gi chodagasta chen thog bstod bsngags kyang byas/ khyedad rang 'kho ra zhag dus chodad nyin bcu las med kyang / da dung phyir log yong gi med pa ni khrims la brtsi srung byed mi dgos pa'i kho par gdeng tshod nges can 142

lha sar 'khe ra zhag tu btang ba/ 143zhig yod pa red/ tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas mi dzadas ring lugs kyi srid jus lag len byas te/ kho pa'i sgyur bkod rnam 'gyur la 'gyur ba sku nga re byas nas 'khor zhag btang bar bkrin bsam shes med par ngan mkhregs byas nas da dung ma sku nga / nga cho sa kho par rtsis brgyag gi yin zhes tud krang tshos thengs mang bshad song bas/ khyed rang bkar rgyu nyag cig red 'dug na/ de rtsis bsam blo'i gra sgrig byed dgo sa zhes bshad de blo mthun kha shas sems khral byed kyi 'dugade nas ru khag tud krang mazo mo'i (bod rigs rbud las byed kong po ba red/)sar rnam 'gyur yag po'i ngang bskyod de 'gyor brda zhu skabs tud krang nas khyed rang btson khang nang sdod ring dang / las mi'i nang thon rjes kyang bsam blo'i sgyur bkod dang / ngal rtsol sgyur bkod rjes lus shig yin na'ang / macad kru'u zhis rjes lus rnams la nye wa dang go bache na yid sgug gi nus pa thon pa'i slob gso brgyab ste yar rgyas yong ba byed dgos/ zhes bka' slob gnang ba ltar/ nga tshos khyodad rang lo na chung ba dang sngar 'gyod phyi sdom gyi mi gsar pa zhig bya rgyu'i re ba byas te/ khyodad rang gis zhu wa na bzhin pha yul du 'khor zhag gnyen 'phrad du btang bar bkrin bsam shes med par/ 'kho ra zhag dus tshod nyin bcu las med kyang zla gnyis lhag tsam 'khreb btsong nas sdod phod pa'i gdeng 143

144 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/tshod ji yod dang / yang na bsam slo gang 'dra zhig gi bskul 'ded cadag bsdad pa yin/ bsam slo dang zung sbrel byas te lnga sa len zhu yig cig 'khyer nog ces brdzod pa ltar/ zhu yig bris pa'i nang tang dang mi mang srid gzhung nas ma'o kru'u zhis nyes can par 'dzin pa'i srid jus gzhir bzung / gsar brje'i mi chos ring lugs lag len gnang ste gus pa 'kho ra zhag nyin bcu gnang yang / dus thog log ma thub pa ni gcig nas rang nyid na nas sman khang du bskyod pa'i sman pa'i nad gso'i lag 'khyer yod pa dang / gnyis nas skadang wa ra bskyod mkhan mo ṭa ma rag par dus chosad gang 'tshams dus 'gyangs byung ba las/ tang dang mi dmangs srid gzhung la ltos med sgal ral byas pa gtan nas min/ slad kyang 'kho ra zhag gi go skabs thodab srid pas de skabs dus dza da sngon la yong ma thub kyang / dus thog sgrig 'gal med par yong chodag pa'i khas len zhu yig tu phul/ zhes bris te tsu'u krang (bcu dpon lta nghru/) brgyud phul bar tud krang rma tsho mos/ zhu yig 'di'i nang phyi rkyen kho na bshad pa las nang rkyen bshad mi 'dug ces zhu yig phyir slogayang bskyar gong mtshungs shig bris te sprad par bo nga bzhin thengs gsum tsam phyir slog ste/ da dung dgongs pa ma dwangs par tsu'u krang dang / hūr brtson can tsho zur du 'bod nas kho pa mor nga la dri ba bskul 144

lha sar 'khor zhag tu btang ba/ 145nas 'khor zhag dus tshod ring po de 'dra 'gyang nas sdod phod pa'i gdeng tshod ji yod dang / yang na bsam blo gang 'dra zhig gi skul 'deng 'og bsdad pa bcas/ bsam blo'i rtsa ba gting zab bsngog dgos pa'i ngan bslabs byas pa ltar/ nyin mo ngal rtsol skul 'ded byed pa dang / mtshan mo ru khag nang dri btsir 'thab rtsodad dbo nga mo gsum tsam byas par/ phran nas tang dang mi mang srid gzhung nas mi chos ring lugs phyag bzhes gnang ste gus rang 'khor zhag btang yang / dus thog phyir 'o/ga ma thub pa ni gong du zhu yig phul ba ltar gcig nas rang nyid na ba dang / gnyis nas mo ṭa ma rag par dus 'gyangs sku nga ba las/ mi mang srid gzhung la ltos med zhus pa gtan nas min/ 'on kyang dus tshod 'gyangs pa sgrig 'gal zhig yin pas sngar 'gyod phyi sdom zhu chodag pa zhes yang yang bshad kyang thag ma bcad stabs/ phran 'u thug ste dgong mo zhig 'thab ra'i nang ngas gong du zhu yig rab dang rim pa mang po phul ba ma zad/ tshogs 'du'i thog kyang dgong mo gcig min gnyis min 'gram pa sa phab kyi lnga sa len 'gyod bshags zhus kyang da dud 'grigs kyi med na/ tang dang mi mang srid gzhung nas nga la nyes chad gtong ba gnang rtsis yod pa red/ byas tsang nyes chad gang gnang yang gnang rogs/ tha na srog thog btang na'ang 'gyod pa med ces skad shugs rgyun gtan dang mi 'dra ba'i shugs che'i thog nas 145

146 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/bshad pa'i gnas tshul rnams/ do dam las byed la tsu'u krang tsho sa snyan seng zhus par/ zod dpag byas na nga 'u thug pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig thon gyi 'dug bsam nas de rjes slad phyin khas len zhu yig cig 'khyer cadag ces brjod pa ltar/ zhu yig sprad rjes de nas thag gcod byas pas nga la sha tsha 'brel yod slo mthun mo'ang dga' po byung song /nga tsho'i shing gcod las khungs ni shin tu dka' ngal che la srog nyen chen po yod pa zhig red/ dbyar dus char zhod skabs mi dang 'dam bag ngo mi shes pa lta bu'i ngang las ka byed dgos pa dang / dgun dus kha ba shugs che babs te grang ngar gyi lag pa 'khyag nas mdzub mo rkyang brkum mi shes par na zug drag lnga btang yang me galta nga wa da thabs sku gas byas mi chog pa dang / nyi ma yod sar 'gro ba'i rang dbang med par grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal myong dgos pa ma zad/ shing gdung ma'i so/ga las rogs kha shas shi rmas byung ba dang / las rogs slo bzang lags zer ba'i mi ya rabs nyam chung zhig sku da pa de ri nas gdung ma ril nas tshabs che'i rmas skyon byung rjes/ sman khang nas rkang pa ya gcig gcodad dgos byung stabs de'i rkyen gyis sems sdug lta bus rang lo 31 la dus min tshe las 'das/de lta bu'i rmas skyon shor ba'i gnas tshul rgyun gtan gyi rang 146

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 147bzhin zhig yin pa dang / dbang po yan lag shor ba'i mi mang po yod/snga dro las kar thon skabs dmag sar sgon pa lta bu'i 'jigs 'tsher yong ba dang / dgong dro bde 'jags ngang log thub pa'i gdeng hrūd med par rtag tu 'jigs snang gi sems bag phebs med pa'i ngang las ka byas te sdod dgo sa/ nga rang de skabs shing sog le dum bu rgyag mkhan gras yin/nga'i las rogs pha yul byang nas yin pa'i don ldan zer ba'i mi chung kha bde zhig sku da pa/ kho pa rgyun gtan nga chod dang lta ba langs phyogs gcig glur gyi blo mthun gyi gras shig yin/ nyin zhig kha ba chen po babs te las yul ri'i gyen thur la bskyod dka' ba zhig byung ste mthar las yul du slebs kyang / ngos gnyis nas nyi ma yod sar bskyod de nyin gang las ka ma byas par bsdad cing / don ldan la'ang rgyun gtan las byed chod dang hur brtson can mos sdang zug byed yul zhig yin/lo re'i dgun dus slob sbyong dang gcig rdung gsum rgol zer ba'i las 'gul spel ba'i nang rnam kun bsam blo'i sgyur bkod dang / ngal rtsol sgyur bkod sgrig khrims brtsi srung sogs ngan dor bzang blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum dang mthun pa zhig byung yod med zhib bsher gyis/ rang skyon ngos len dang gzhan skyon ther 'aro/na byed pa'i las 'gul nang snumags chung khag bgos kyis las mi phan tshun skyon brjod dang / rang skyon rang 147

148 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/brjod byed du bcug pa'i nang las byed pas don ldan la rgyun gtan tang gi srid jus la yi rang med pa'i rnam pa bstan pa dang / sgyur bkodad yag po med mkhan gyi mi rnams la dga' 'en byed pa/ kho pa'i langs khyedags yag po med pa/ sdudags gnas tshul rnam grangs kha shas bto/na nas rang skyon ngos len dang gzhan skyon ther 'don byed dgos pa'i zur du dmigs bkar gyi gasna na shugs drag po sprad stabs/ kho pas 'thab rtsodad kyi chodad bgam ma theg pa lta bus blo sku na ngo sa gnyis nas nyin zhig kha ba chen po 'bab nyin nyin gang las ka ma byas par nyi ma bsros te bsdad pa yin zhes ngos len byas shing / de ma thag las byed pas nga chorware chodags chung nang yong nas blo yon khyodad la gnas tshul sku da/ khyodad ra'i 'brel yod mis tang gi kha gsal gu yangs dang / sbas skung drag galha na gyi srid jus la yid ches kyis skyon brdzod dang rang skyon rang brjod byas yod/ khyod rang bsam blo btang nas tang srid la yid ches kyis lnga sa len byed dbo sa/ zhes bshad de cho gas chung nang bkar mthar mang sngo btang yang / phran nas ngos len ma byas stabs mthar chodags chung nang yar bslangs nas sgur skur yun ring byed bcug pa dang / thag pas bsdams bkyig gis tsha dri byas te khyod rang don ldan dang phan tshun re stong rmongs dad kyi dkrog gtam shod res byas yod pa dang / de bzhin nga tsho sa gnas tshul zur gcig 148

lha sar 'kho ra zhag tu btang ba/ 149bshad na nyin zhig don ldan khyodad gnyis nas nyin gang las mtshams bzhag yod pa ma red dam/ zhes bshad kyang / nga'i bsam blo'i nang kho chodas tsho da dpag byas par ngo sa 'dzin gyis ngo sa len ma byas/ mthar don ldan nga tsho'i mogs chung nang 'khrid yong nas gnas tshul ra trod byed du bcug stabs ngos len ma byas thabs med byung /de nas don ldan la kho pa 'o/ga spyod kyi langs phyogs dang kha bral nas tang dang mi mang gi rjes su bskyod de mi gsar pa byed 'go tshugs pa red/ ces bstod bsngags dang / nga la nag nyes ngos 'dzin dang ngal rtsol sgyur bkod dang len med par las mtshams 'jog mkhan dang / 'o/ga spyod kyi langs phyogs mkhregs bzung byed mkhan red/ ces skyon brjod drag po dang ngos len zhu yig zer ba thengs kha shas bri ru bcug pa sogs dka' bsun tshad med bzos byung /1973 sku/ 'asku nas 'go tshugs te nga tsho las mi'i gnas stangs phran bu legs bcadas gtong rgyu'i srid jus shig bton nas nga chod nying khri ngal sgyur shing gcod bzo grwa'i khongs btson pa ru khag gnyis dang / las mi ru khag bzhi tsam yod/ ru khag rer cha snyoms mi brgya tsam sku da cing / nga tsho las mi ru khag so so'i nang las dodan ru khag slebs te 'o/ brgyad nas da bar las ka ji byas kyi lo rgyus dang / 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byed dgos 149

150 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/pa'i nag nyes ji bsags dang / nyes chad lo tshad ga chodad btang ba dang srid dbang lo ga tshod 'a'o/ga pa/ btson khang nang sgyur bkod yag po byas te bstod bsngags gzigs gasku/la ji lnga ba dang / nyes chad lo tshad bcag pa byung yod med sogs re re byas te dri rtsad tho bkod byas nas khyod rang mo ngan dor bzang blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum la brtsodan len gyis sgyur bkod yag lnga byas sku da pa'i mi rnams kyi log spyod pa'i zhwa mo dang / sngo 'o/ga zing 'khrug gi zhwa mo phud pa dang / gla lnga gas spar rgyu yin zhes dril bsgrags byas/150

mecu gas/ma/gral rogs bee chas nga 'chi lam du meblugazugi me/97zhwag 2 5———9742dispyi lo 973 zla 2 tshes 5nyin nga chos lha da khang so so'i nang gi chodags mi rnams do dam las byed pa'i babo da sgrig cadag tshogs mi sdod sa phan tshun brje bsgyur byed kyi yod pa ltar/ de nyin nyal chas dbor skabs stabs ma legs par/ phran nas ngan dor bzang blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum zer ba der dgag pa brgyab pa'i zin bris yi ge zhig sku da pa de bor 'dug de'i nang don gtso bo ni/ gung khran jag pas nga tshor rtag tu ngan dor bzang blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum la brtsodan len byed dgos zhes dril bsgrags dang btsan skul byed kyi yod cing / ngan dor bzang

152 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum zer ba'i nang gi/dang po/ nag nyes ngos 'dzin dang khrims la brtsi srung byed dgos/gnyis pa/ tang dang spyi chodags ring lugs kyi lam lugs la brtsi srung byed dgos/gsum pa/ ngal ce la gyi lta ba 'dzugs pa dang go mas gshis 'jags pa byed dgos/ zhes pa bcas red/'on kyang nga chodar kho pa tsho sa bshad pa ltar gyi nag nyes sku da pa'i ngos 'dzin gtan nas byed mi thub/ gang yin zer na/ nge da ni snga bar phyi gsum la rang btsan rgyal khab gcig yin pa 'dir gung jag gis btsan 'dzul byas par brten/ nga chodas rang srung gi langs phyogs bzung nas btsan 'dzul par rgodal lan sprod pa'i 'thab rtsodad byas pa de ni yongs su dgos nges shig dang / drang bden rang bzhin gyi bya ba zhig yin yang re zhig phyogs gnyis bar gyi mi shugs dang dngos po'i stodabs shugs che chung do mi mnyam pa'i dbang gis nga tsho'i drang bden 'thab rtsodad la/ khrag dri bro ba'i drag gnon phog ste gnas skabs yid skyo'i ngang pham nyes byung yod na'ang / gzhi rtsa'i bden pa nga dzad wa da mi mang bi/ lag tu yod/ 7go nga sa 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsha rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sku zil pa khrom mer bzhugs yod pa dang / khong don med du 152

gral mo gas bo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 153bzhugs med par nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi rang dbang slar gso dang / nga tsho bod mi mang rnams dgra bo'i bdud kyi sbar mo'i nang nas rang dbang dang bcings 'grol thodab nas masgordzon skyabs chen po 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i chos srid gnyis ldan gyi dbu khrid 'og 'di phyi gnyis yod kyi rang dbang bde skyid kyi dpal la longs spyod thub ched/ nyin mtshan kun tu sku ngal khri stodang lhar bzhes kyis 'bad 'thab gnang bzhin yod/ khong gis gnang ba'i 'thab rtsod ni drang bden zhig yin par brten rgyal khab khag gi gzhung drang sems bzang can gyi dbu khrid dang / mi mang rnams nas gdung sems mnyam skyed dang thabs lam sna tshogs kyi rogs ram zhu mkhan nyin bzhin je mang du 9regro bzhin yod la/ rgyal spyi'i thodag bod kyi gnad don gyi bden mtha' nyin bzhin je gsal du 'gro bzhin yodad pa de ni nga tsho'i 'thab rtsodad la mtha' ma'i rgyal kha thob pa'i rmang gzhi bzang po zhig yin/dper na/ rgyal spyi'i mnyam sbrel rgyal ce gas kyi gros rim nang bod kyi gnad don snga rjes su tshud yod cing / 'on kyang de skabs mnyam sbrel rgyal gas nang rgya nag gi 'thus mi'i dbang cha de rgya nag bo min tang gi lag tu yod stabs/ mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs nang nga chorware ce da gzhi de lag pa ya gcig gi tā ga pa lta bu gyur pa dang / de rjes skabs 26153

154 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/pa'i mnyam sbrel rgyal cho gas nang rgya nag gi 'thus mi'i dbang cha bo min tang gis lag nasro gung khran tang la byung sku/da/ mnyam sbrel rgyal ce gas nang rgya nag gi 'thus mi'i ngos nas lnga da de rgya nag gi cha shas kha bral du mi rung ba zhig yin zhes bajo da nas rgya nag gis mnga' khongs su gto/gas pa'i lo rgyus dang / dpang po gang yod bstan rgyu dang / nga tsho bod kyi sku tshab ngos nas bod de thog mtha' bar gsum la rang dbang rang btsan yin pa'i lo rgyus dang / dpang po gang yod chodags chen thodag bstan pa brgyud 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag gi sku tshab rnams nas rang gi gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan bsnams nas g.yas par spyan dang / g.yon par mig min pa'i thodag nas su bden pa yin dang / su rdzun ma yin dbye 'byed gsal ngo gnang ste bden pa bden thog la 'khyedal nas mthar rgyal kha thodab rgyu dang /rdzun ma'i rdzun rkub rdol nas mthar ngo tsha dgos pa'i pham nyes sku nga rgyu ni bden don gyi chos nyid yin/ de 'dra song tsang gung jag gis bshad pa ltar rbad de zhe 'o/ga pa'i tang dang spyi chodags ring lugs kyi lam lugs la brtsi srung zhu dgos zer ba'i ches mun nag dang / ches kla klo'i lam lugs der brtsi srung byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med par/ nga tsho'i mdun lam ni yangs shing rgya che la 'od zer stertseng ldan zhig yin pa dga' spro'i ngang nas masprodang thub pa ma zad/ nga chodas 'o/ mang yun ring bden dodan gyi ched 154

gral mostegs sgo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 155du dka' spyad 'thab rtsod byas pa der grub 'bras dang 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam yod pa/ de bas dga' spro'i ngang nas mthong thub/ nga sas da dung dka' khri khyad bsad kyis mtha' ma'i rgyal kha ma thob par 'thab rtsodad mtha' 'khyodal ba byed rgyu yin/zhes yig thodag bris pa de sa lnga ga nas gral mtshes stag 'u nga ba go cha zer ba zhig yodad pa de'i lag tu thebs te/ kho pas rang nyid la byas rjes dang mdun lam thob rgyur med du mi rung ba'i cha rkyen nor bu mthu ldan zhig rnyed song bsams nas ru khag gi 'bo khrid la ma sprad par/ rgyun gtan nga tshor dmigs bsal sdang zug byed mkhan bzo grwa'i do dam dang slob gso sde tshan la sprad stabs/ las byed thang ka'an si dang / tshe bsam/mamo mo kho zos yi ge de tang dang spyi mogs ring lugs la ngo rgol dang /sgrur bkod la 'gog rgol byed pa'i dug rtsa zhig tu brtsis te nga tsho'i ru khag gi 'go khrid chab srid slob ston pa bsod nams rdo rjer/ khyod tsho'i ru khag nang gi blo yon gyis log spyodad kyi rtsodam yig de 'dra zhig 'bri snangam byas 'dug kho par khyod tsho'i ru khag nas thag gcod gang 'dra byed rtsis yod ces bshad par brten/ bamo da nams lda rjes kho pa 'phral du 'dzin bzwang bya rgyu yin/ zhes bshad pa ltar nga 'dzin bzung bya rgyu kho tsho gros 'cham byung /155

156 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/phyi 'o/ 1973 zla 12 tshes 18 nyin phran mig ya gcig la thor ba zhig thon stabs sman khang du sman bcos byed par bskyod de/ em chis sman bce sa byas nas mig ras dkar wa zhig g.yogs pa dang / nyin gnyis ngal gso chodag pa'i lag 'khyer sprad pa bzhin/ ngal gso/ nyin gnyis pa'i dgong dro'i pe cing chu mod lnga pa tsam la sems nang 'tshab shur chen skra zhig langs pa ma zad/ mig g.yas pa shugs che 'phags nas sems mi bde ba zhig byung zhing / nam rgyun mig g.yas pa 'phags na bkra mi shes pa'i snga ltas 'ong gi yod pas/ 7go nga sa mchodag nas wa da nang gdan sa khag la gnang ba'i 'jigs byed ma he'i phyag tshwa phran bu gsang thabs kyi sbas nyar byas yod pa de nas phran bu bzas pa dang / rig gnas gsar brjer sku rten bshig gtor skabs gzungs bzhugs nas thodan pa'i 7rgyal ba lnga pa'i na bza' phran bu rag son byung ba/ de nas phran tsam me la bsregs nas sna la bdug kyang phan nus ma lnga na par lus mur/ phyi lo 1974 zla 1 tshes 20 nyin kyi dgong dro'i pe cing chu tshod drug dang phyed ka tsam la slebs dus las rogs snum las thag dzadad nas nang la snga rjes log yong ba mig gis mthodang ba dang / chabs cig rlangs 'kho ra gyi skad sgra zhig kyang rna bar thos/ de nas nga tsho'i brgya dpon phur bu tshe ring gis blo yon mar don shog zer byung bas sdod khang nas sgo ra'i nang thon skabs 156

gral mo gas bo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 157bzo grwa'i 'go khrid las byed mtsho mo dang / tshe bsam/ krang cwa hode//(bod rigs kong po ba/) nga tsho'i ru khag gi kre ta'o yon bsod nams rdo rje/ btson khang gi kre ta'o yon bskan 'dzin nor bu bcas slebs/kre ta'o yon bsod nams rdo rje dang / btson khang kre ta'o yodan bstan 'dzin nor bu gnyis nga'i mdun yong nas bsod nams shod rjes rang gis nag nyes gsar pa bsags yod pas/ da lta khyod rang 'dzin bzung byed kyi yin/zhes bshad de btson khang kre taso/ yon la lcags sgyu bas/ zhes bshad ma thag kho pas stod thung khug ma'i nang nas lag lcags wa da bzos nag po zhig bton te/ nga la lag pa mar rkye ngas zhes thengs gnyis brjod de lag lcags brgyab rjes me mda' thung mda' zhig bton nas mo ṭa'i nang bce na khang phyogs su kha gtad de 'khrid/rang nyid kyis gang yang shes rtog med stabs sems nang ā ya mtshan nga 'dzin bzung byed dgo sa pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/ da phal cher 'e ltar btson pa dang / las mi mnyam du tshogs chen bskongs te sdug thodag sdug rtseg gi drag gni na byed ched las mi'i nang nas mi kha shas snu gas chen thog bya glag gis lug phrug 'khyer ba ltar/ drag chas cha tshang spras pa'i dmag mis slo bur dza drag gi 'dzin bzung byed pa dang / la la srog thog gshegeng ba/ la lar bstod bsngags dang / gzigs bzos 157

158 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/sprod pa sogs drang phyogs dang / lto ga dre gas kyi mig dpe zer ba bstan srol yod pa ltar/ nga rang nam rgyun dod dam las byed 1rware mig lam du mi 'askra ba dang / bcesan khang dang las mi'i nang mig lto sa ngan pa baX mkhan zhig tu rtsi yi yod pas/ da res phal cher lo 'di'i sags chen thog ldog phyogs kyi mig dpe ston rgyu'i ched 'dzin bzung byas pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin byas pa yin/ de nas bsgu na khang gi sgo chen g.yas gasku na du bce na pa'i 'jor dang / sbyar ma/ thag pa/ zor ba/ slel po sogs 'jug sa'i skya 'brel khang stong zhig yod pa de nang lag lcags rgyag mur btso na 'jug byas te/ las mi'i nang rgyun gtan kho pa dzarware rgyugs khyi byed mkhan du brtsi ba'i bstan 'dzin ye shes dang / lha phrug gnyis res mos kyis srung char bzhag byung /sang nyin rlangs 'kho ra nang nga'i nyal chas rnams blugs pa'i steng stag lung ba go cha kho pa yod pa sge'u khung nas mthong byung / skabs der nga'i bsam par nga'i dngos po yongs rdzogs sngog bsher byas pa gtan 'khel red na/ nga'i nyin deb dang / 7rgyal ba lnga pa'i na bza'/ ma he phyag tsha dang / lhag par ngan dor bzang blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum gyi dgag yig sku gas dgra 1rware lag par thebs nges pas/ chag sgo chen 〈sna zhig sku nga rgyu red bsams nas sems 'tshab kyis sdod tshugs ma zin par gyur/158

gral zodags go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 159yang bskyar bsam blo zhig btang ste/ ngas rku brgyab pa dang / sger don du mi bsad rta 'gyel byas te btson la tshud pa zhig min la rang gi pha yang rgyal khab dang / bstan srid mi rigs kyi don du btson la tshud nas 'thab rtsod kyis mnar gcod sna mogs myong dgos byung mthar sku srog shor ba red/ rang nyid kyang gnas tshul gyi dbang gis dka' sdug de bas che ba zhig mu mthud myong dgos pa dang / tha na srog bcad kyang 'gyod pa med pa zhig red snyam pa'i bsam blo zhig 'khor thub pa des 'jigs dngangs dang 'tshab 'tshub med par sgam brling ngang gnas thub pa byung /nyin gsum song mtshams snga dam slob gso sde tshan gyi rgya mi las byed tha'ang ka'an si dang / skad sgrur phun tshogs rgyal po gnyis yong nas khyod rang 'dzin bzung byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan shes song ngam/ khyod kyis lo rgyus thog nag nyes sbas bskung byas yod la/ btson khang nang du'ang nyes pa bsags pa'i gnas tshul ngos len ma zhus pa ma zad/ lhag par las0mi'i nang thon rjes tshabs che'i nag nyes gsar pa bsags sku da cing / khyod rang bsam slo yag po btang nas tang gi kha gsal gu yangs dang / sbas bskung drag gnon gyi srid jus la yid ches kyis ngos len mthar phyir zhu dbo sa pa ma zad/ rang dang 'brel yod mi rnams kyi gnas tshul yang ther 'don byas te byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel thub pa /59

160 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/byed dbo sa/ deng skabs tang dang mi mang srid gzhung nas khyodad tsho'i mdun lam la thugs 'khur gnang rgyu'i srid jus gsar pa thodan sku da/ khyodad rang btson khang dang las mi'i nang lo na chung shos yin yang re stong rmongs dad kyi bsam lho gting zab cadas yod mkhan zhig red/cadan kyang nga chod mi mang srid gzhung nas khyodad la sdug pa byed sems med/ ngan dor bzang blangs kyi mi gsar pa zhig sku nga ba'i re ba dang 'bad brtson byed kyi yod na'ang / gtso bo khyod rang gis sngar 'gyod phyi sdom byed min la rag lus yod/ khyodad tsho ra drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi mig dpe mang po yod pa red// thub bstan gyi lam du mi 'gro ba'i re ba sku da ces bshad byung / thub bstan ni lo 'di'i nang mo ga lnga ga btang ba'i gras shig red/ de rtsis khyod rang nag nyes ngos len dang / gzhan skyon ther 'don byed rgyu'i bsam blo'i gra sgrig byed dgos/ tang gi srid jus ni rgyun gtan nas khyodad tshor dril bsgrags sdudab gasku byas pa ltar kha gsal gu yangs dang / sbas bskung drag gaho na gyi srid jus ni snga bar phyi gsum la 'gyur ba med/ tang srid la yid ches kyis 'o/ga khyodad kyi lam lho gas dang kha bral nas 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam la brtsodan len byed dgos zhes yang yang nan bshad byas/yud tsam nas nga tsho'i ru khag gi kre ta'o sku na bamo da nams rdo rje 160

gral ro/gas bo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 1snyo1yong ste blo sku na khyodad rang 'dzin bzung byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan shes song ngam/ zhes dris par/ ngas las mi'i sgrig khrims dang 'gal ba'i gnas tshul sne gcig med ces brjod dka' zhing / mi ni skyon gyi phung po zhig yin stabs nga la nor 'khrul phran bu sku da srid par mi 'ga' shas kyis rang nyid la byas rjes dang / mdun lam yong res nga'i skyon cha phran bu la sgro chen sngo/ zhig btags nas mi mang srid gzhung la snyan seng zhus pa yin gyi red snyam pa las/ nga 'dzin bzung tsam byed dgos pa'i nag nyes yod par ngo sa 'dzin thub kyi mi 'dug ces bcadad pa yin/ a las so/ na/ khyedad rang nga tshos nag nyes med par 'dzin bzung byas pa red ces zer gyi yod dam/ nga cho sa mi la ma nyes kha gasku/ga bkal nas 'dzin bzung byed kyi ma red/ tang gi srid jus ni khyod tshor rtag tu slob 'khrid byed kyi yod/ tang srid la yid ches kyi kha gsal sngo sa len zhu rgyu ni khyesgod kyi mdun lam yag shos de red/ da lta khyod rang bsam blo'i go skabs sprad de bzhag yod ces bshad de phyir log song / de rjes nyin re kre ta'o yon thengs re yong nas bsam blo 'kho ra sdudang ngam zhes nan dri byas par/ ngas bsam slo btang yang nga 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byed dgos pa'i nag nyes yod par ngo sa 'dzin thub kyi mi 'dug ces bshad de nyin mtshan med par nyal nas bsdad/161

16na nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/zla de'i tshes 27 nyin slar yang kre ta'o yon bsod nams rdo rje yong nas slo yon khyed rang skyes yul ga par red/ pha ma spun mched med dam zhes dris par/ nga skyes yul lha sa yin/ pha ma 'das grongs gyur tshar song / sbun mched rgan gazlo na mang po yod ces bshad par/khyod rang spun mched chod dran gyi mi 'dug gam/ zhes dris par/ dran gyi 'dug ces brjod pa yin/ kho pas nang mi sprun mched dran gyi yod na/ khyod kyis dngos 'brel nag nyes gsar pa bsags yod pas tang srid la yid ches kyis ngos len gsal zhu byas na gu yangs yong srid pa dang /klad rnying mkhregs bzung byas na gyong gun chen po phog gi red/ ngas khyod la 'jigs snang bskul ba min/ zhes rnam 'gyur drang mnge ga bstan nas bshad byung yang / de'i lan du sngar bzhin bsam blo btang yang ngos len zhu dgos pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra zhig yod snyam pa dran gyi mi 'dug ces bshad par kre ta'o yon khro ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas phyir log song /phyi zla 1 tshes 30 nyin snga dro'i chu tshod bcu pa tsam la kre ta'o yon bsod nams rdo rje yong ste khyod rang bsam blo btang ste ngos len zhu rgyu yod dam med dris byung bas/ phran nas bsam btang dran skyes kyi ngos len zhu rgyu med ces bshad/ kre ta'o yon khong khro langs te gdong dmar smug bstan bzhin du skad shugs chen pos yar longs/ khyodad rang 162

gral zodags go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 1snyo3btson khang nang yar 'gro dgos red ces bshad de/ nga la lta srung byed mkhan lha phrug la khorware nyal chas de sgril sgril bzos zhes bshad pa ltar/btson khang gi kre ta'o yon bstan 'dzin nor bur rtsis sprad/btson khang gi kre tacad sku/na nas btson pa tshems bzorib 'gyur med la kho'i nyal sa der bzos zhes bshad pa bzhin/ dang thog btson khang gi khang pa'i sbug gi rtsig khug der nyal khri brgyab tu bcug song bas der bsdad cing / de nas dgong dro'i chu zod lnga pa tsam la kre ta'o yon gyis btson khang gi sge'u khung nas bltas te bsam blo yud tsam btang rjes/tshems bzo ba 'gyur med 'bod de/ kho'i nyal sa de mar spo dgos zhes bshad de btson khang sgo dang / sge'u khung gi 'gram du bzhag byung / de nas bod kyi lo gsar dang / rgya mi'i dpyid gsar dus chen mnyam du 'khel nas lo gsar dang dus chen ma tshar bar zla ba gnyis tsam 'dri rtsad byed mkhan med par bzhag byung / nyin ltar snga dgong gsang spyodad la chab gcin thengs re gtong dgos shing / nyin mtshan med par sgo lcags brgyab nas btson 'jug byas pa dang / btson khang nang sku da pa'i btson pa mang che ba ngo shes yin pa ma zad/ phran dang sha tsha 'brel yod kyi bsgu na lha gas kyang kha shas sku da/ kho nga tshangs nga slar yang 'dzin bzung gis lag lcags brgyab pa mthong skabs blo pham gyi rnam 'gyur bstan gyi 'dug snga dbo nga /63

164 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gsang spyod nang chab gcin galta nga bar btang skabs/ btso na bo gas chosas nga la ya nga snying rje dang gdung sems kyi rnam 'gyur bstan pa las byed padma rig 'dzin gyis mthong stabs/ btso na sgo gas chodar rnam 'gyur drag pos gshe gshe btang nas slo yon kho dang khyed mo ngan 'brel ga re yodad/ ces skad shugs chen dze sa nan 'dri byas tsang bsu na bo gas cho 'jigs snang skyes te/ nga btson khang nas snga dgong gsang spyod la chab gcin gtong bar 'khrid skabs btson grogs tsho sa nga masprodang 'phral phar tshur nge sa kyi 'dugaskabs der bce na khang nang bce na pa grangs nyis brgya tsam yod/kho tsho nyin mo shing gcod du 'gro dgos pa dang / la la sa lho ga dang / la la zhing las dang tshal zhing 'debs las sesgogs kyi las rigs sna dza gas thog ngal rtsol sgyur bkod zer ba byed dgos/ de dus btson pa'i 'tsho ba phran tsam legs bcadas song nas ltogs shi thebs pa'i nyen kha cher med kyang / nyin mo ngal rtsol sgyur bkod zer bar skul 'ded dang / dgong mo rang skyon ngo sa len dang gzhan skyon ther 'dodan/ mi ngan las ngan la ngo sga la dang / byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel dgo sa zer ba so/gas kyi 'bod tshig sna tsho gas 'og phan tshun 'thab rtsodad byed bcug pa ste/btson pa la las sna ngas dad kyi dzadas byas pa red zer ba dang / la las trī la'i dang a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs/ hin rdu rgya skyed ring lugs/164

gral mosnags sgo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 1snyo5de bzhin mnyam sbrel rgyal cho gas la re ba bcadal nas srid snying bskyar 'o/ga yong rgyu'i re stong bcangs pa red zer ba/ la las tang srid la dma' 'bebs dang / dkrog gtam bshad pa red zer ba/ la las ngal rtsol sgyur bkod kyi rnam 'gyur yag po med pa zer ba dang / do dam las byed pa'i bka' dang / btson khrims la brtsi srung byed kyi med lugs zer ba sogs khag 'dodags sna chodags kyi byams snying rje dang / ngo tsha khrel gzhung /lha chos dang mi chos shes mkhan gyi rnam dpyod ldan pa'i skye bo rnams rnying zhen dang / rjes lus/ log spyod/ lha 'dre gdodan bgegs/ gsar brjer ngo rgol nag nyes ngos 'dzin med par sgrur bkod la 'gog rgol byed mkhan zhig tu brtsis te sdang zug chen po byed pa dang / byams snying rje med mkhan dang / ngo tsha khrel gzhung med par rang nyid la byas rjes dang / mdun lam zer ba yong ched gzhan gyi bde sdug mdun lam la mig btsugs tsam med par rdog brdzis dang / gzhan gyi las dbang la rtsed mo rtsed mkhan dang / mgo bde dran 'phrul/ ngo dga' sprel lad 'khrab mkhan/ rang nyid ma gtogs gzhan la bsam blo gtong mi shes pa'i mi ngan tha shal de tsho tang srid la yid ches dang spyi chodags ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro 'alnga da yod mkhan dang / byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel ste mi gsar pa byed 'dod yod mkhan/ mi ngan las ngan la cadas med mthun 165

1snyo6 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/thabs ma byas par 'thab ce da byed lnga da mkhan hūr brtsodan can/ zeratswab la sogs pa'i bstod bsngags dang mdzes rgyan sna tsharags spras nas tha shal gyi mi de tsho bde spyod kyis rgyal gces lhag bsam can dang / gang cir rnam dpyod ldan pa'i bsam yod mi rnams la nyes ming sna gas bkal nas ya nga med pa'i 'thab rtsod dang / snying rje med pa'i rdung rdeg byed pa dper na/ ngal rtsol sgyur bkod lo nyi shu dang / srid dbang lo bdun 'phrog pa'i btson grogs tshe ring dpal 'gyor de sngon nga tsho btson khang nang mnyam du gshib skabs/ kha gyong tsam sku da pa'i bce na grogs chod mthun gras shig yin/ skabs der kho rang nad mnar gyi gzugs dze shin tu skyo po chags kyang dgra bos ya nga snying rje med par/ tshogs chung nang shing gi rkub rtegs gsum tsam brtsegs te de'i thodag lag pa thag pas bsdams bkyigs kyis bzhag nas re dkrog slongs gsum ji byas ngos len zhu dgos zer ba/ sogs chodags mi tshang mas skad 'bod byed pa dang / de nas rkub stegs 'og ma 'then nas rkub stegs steng ma dang mnyam sa la lhung skabs/ da dung btson pa hur brtson can zer ba chodas nyes rdung btang ba dang skabs 'gar snumags chen skong ce gas byas te mi zhig yar bslangs nas kho pas chodags chung nang klad rnying mkhregs bzung byas te/ ngos len zhus med pas da res hrūgs chen thog kho par skyon brdzod 'thab rtsod dang 166

gral ro gas go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 1snyo7rogs ram byed dgos/ zer ba dang las byed pas bkod sgrig ngan skul byas 'og tang srid la yid ches kyis ngan dor bzang blang cha rkyen gsum la brtson len byas na/ 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam yod/kha gsal la gu yangs dang / sbas bskungs la drag gnon bya rgyu yin zer ba/ mdun la mi dang / rgyab la 'dre yin pa/ sgyur bkod la 'gog lha la byed pa'i mi ngan rnams ther 'don dang / 'thab rtsod byas nas dri ngan kha ba zhig bzo dgos/ 'gyor med gral rim srid dbang sger 'dzin khri lo brtan pa lha ga krung go gung khran tang khri lo brtan pa ho ga maso/ kru'u zhi khri lor brtan pa shog zer ba'i 'bod tshig gi sgra'i khrod du mi rlung gis bkyag nas phyu grabs byed/chodags chung so mo dang / yang na chodags chen thodag mi zhig la 'thab rtsod byed skabs do dam las byed pas btson pa rnams la lta zhib byas 'og mi ngan las ngan zer bar 'thab ce da byed skabs/ do dam las byed pas btson pa rnams la lta zhib byas cadag mi ngan las ngan la 'thab rtsod byed kyi yod mdodag gi rnam pa zhig ma thon na/ mi de zur bkag btang nas khyod rang mi ngan las ngan la 'thab rtsodad byed pa'i sems shugs mi 'dugade'i bsam blo'i rtsa ba gang yin/ mi ni bsam blo'i bkod gtong nges can zhig gi cakhrig gtam bshad dang 'gul bskyod byed mkhan zhig yin pas/167

168 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/khyod rang gis mi ngan las ngan la ngo rgol 'thab rtsodad mi byed pa'i bsam blo'i rtsa ba sngog dpo sa zer ba sogs/ bsnyad 'dodags 'jigs skul byed pa ni kho pa tsho'i ngan skul byed thabs shig red/ kho pa tsho'i btsan shed 'jigs skul so/ga sems shugs med kyang yod mawa ga byed dgos kyi sku da cing / dgong mo 'char can bce na pa rnams tshang bsher ming thod ma klog gong do dam las byed pas nyin re'i ngal rtsol sgyur bkod legs nyes skor dang / rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi dus bab bzang por ngo sa 'dzin yag po byed dgos pa dang / ma'okru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom slob sbyong byas te 'jig rten lta ba sgyur bkodad yag ngo ma byas na/ nyes dus gtsang nas sgru da bgro la btang yang dga' yas med/ mi kha shas btson khang nang rnyedad ring maso/ tse tung gi dgongs par rten nas 'o/ga spyodad kyi 'jig rten lta ba sgyur bkod yag po ma byas tsang / yang bskyar ri sngo nga tshang 'o/ga gis btson khang nang thengs gnyis pa slebs pa khyodad dzadas mthodang gi 'dug gam/ mi de chodar mthar thug 'bras bu gang 'dra zhig thob kyi yod med/ da lta rtsodad khag po red ces bshad nas nga la 'jigs skul dang rgyag gtam yang yang btang ba go rtogs sku/nga gi 'duganyin re btson khang ma byan gyis sge'u khung nas lto chas sprod len byed kyi yod/ ma byan 'bras spungs kyi grwa pa 'o/ na lnga bcu lhag tsam slebs 168

gral mo gas go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 1snyo9pa'i blo mthun phan bde lags zer ba zhig yod pa des/ nga la sge'u khung nas lto chas sprod skabs khuong gis deng sang spyi tshogs thodag gtam bzang ga re 'dug gam/ nga la dkrog gtam zhig gsungs dang zer brjod byung /ngas rgya gar nang 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen watware chodas srid mdzad 'phrin rgyas po yod pa dang / bden mtha' gsal ba'i re ba 'dug ces brjod par kho rang ha cang dga' po byung song / nyin gcig khong gis khyod rang skyes yul gang nas yin zer dris par/ nga skyes yul lha sa yin/ khyim ming spel gong yin brdzod par/ khong gis khyed rang gi pha ngas zhal tshor gyi yod/ deng sang khong gang du yod dris par/ skyed byed mchog 1959lor nga tsho mnyam du 'dzin bzung gis rgya nag ka'an su'u la ngal rtsol sgyur bskadad btang nas 19snyo2 lor sa gnas de gar dgongs pa rdzogs 'dug ces brjod par/ kho rang blo pham pa'i rnam 'gyur stodan bzhin dbo na mchog mkhyen/ nga chorware mi tshe 'dir mi mthong rgu mthodang mthong / gcig gis sbe'u khung nas yar lha chas sprad/ gcig gis lag par lcags yod bzhin sge'u khung nas lto chas mar gzed/ ya nga ba'i gnas tshul 'di lta bu zhig nga tshos myong dgos byung song / zhes sku zhabs bgres po des skyo snang ngang gsungs/nga rang yang sems skyo po byung rung gang yang gnang gi ma red/ spyi 169

)70 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/tshogs thog gnas tshul bzang the 'dug khyed rang thugs spro po byas nas bzhugs zhes kho nga la sems gso byas pa yin/ de nas ma byan kho nga gis nga la gdung sems mnyam skyed ngang / lha chas gzab gzab byas nas gang drag sems 'khur gyis gnang byung / lo de'i phyi zla gaskum pa'i nang nga brtsan khang lcags ri'i nang yod khang chung zhig nang 'khrid de dri ba len 'go tshugs shing / dri ba len mkhan ni do dam slob gso sde tshan gyi thang kan si zer ba'i rgya mi de red/ dang thog lo brgyad nas da bar gyi lo rgyus dang / pha ma sprun mched kyi 'o/ rgyus/ spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba ji yod/btson khang nang dang las mi'i nang lnga shes za 'thung gi 'brel ba su dang su la yod lugs skor zhib phra 'dri zhib kyis tho bkod byed kyi 'dugaphyogs mtshungs tang gis kha gsal gu yangs dang / sbas ྅/nga drag gnon/rang skyon snga sa len dang / gzhan skyon ther 'don/ byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel dgos pa se gas srid jus dril bsgrags slob gso zer ba byas nas nyin gsum 'gor/phyi zla gsum pa'i zla mjug tsam nas 'go btsugs te thang ka'an sis gtso nge byas pa'i yang kha'o krang dang (rgya mi ) btson khang las byed lha sa ba byams pa dang / grang nā ho'o (kong po ba )do dam slob gso sde tshan gyi khorā/ krang mtshad mo khong tshos res mo sa kyis dang thog khyod 170

gral mo gas go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 171kyi log spyod pa'i bsam blo'i rtsa ba sngog gi yin shes song ngam/ khyod rang rgyun gtan nas bsam blo'i sgyur bkod dang / ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byas med pa ma zad/ nyes thog nyes rtseg gi nag nyes gsar pa bsags pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo tang gis snyes can par 'gro lam sprod pa'i srid jus la yid ches med pa dang / tang dang mi mang srid gzhung la nyer rten ma byas par btsan bzo 'o/ga gsum dang / mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs/ twa la'i log spyod ru tshogs la re ba dang / chos la rmongs dad byed kyi yod pas de dag re re bzhin ngos len byed dgos bshad par/ nga de sngon btson khang nang sdod skabs dang las mi'i nang thon rjes re stong dang / rmongs dad byas pa'i gnas tshul lhag myong yang de rjes tang dang mi mang srid gzhung nas lo mang rgyun ring go skon slob gso gnang bar brten/ re stong ni re stong rang yin pa dang / rmongs dad kyi chos byas nas bde ba can la skyes pa dang /chos ma byas par dmyal bar lhang ba'i ra sprod sne gcig kyang rang gzhan su la'ang byed rgyu med par yid ches rnyed nas re dkrog rmongs gsum byas pa'i gnas tshul ngos len zhu rgyu med tshul/ci se gas mthar bkag btang zhing / skabs der nga'i bsam par ngas mkhreg bzung de ltar byas nas khungs 'khyol yas med pa shes bzhin du bkyigs rdung dang / gshe gshe ga hrūd btang yang khyad du bsad te u tshugs mthar skyel gyis re stong 17/

172 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rmongs dad kyi bsam slo med/ ces bshad nas dus phod phar 'bud byed gang thub byas pa yin/ de 'dra byed pa'i dmigs yul ni dza drag dus tshod mang che ba bsam blo'i rtsa ba ngos len byed rgyu'i thog song na/ 'brel yod blo mthun mo dang 'brel ba'i gnas tshul ji yod ces pa'i btsir gnon tsha 'dri byed pa'i dus mod thung ba lta bu yong gi yod pa lo mang 'thab rtsod kyi nyams myong yod cing / de nas nyin ltar nye rung gi thag pa mdzub mo'i sbom phra tsam zhig dang / rgyug pa thung thung zhig 'khyer yong nas nga tshos khyedad la 'jam bshad blo 'gugs kyi slob gasdu/ ga cho da byas kyang bsam shes med pa dang / tang srid la yid ches med par 'o/ga spyodad kyi lta ba dang bsam slo mkhregs bzung byas na/ nga tshor yang khyod kyi bsam blo'i rtsa ba sngog pa dang khyod rang 'gul bskyod ji byas mi su dang su la 'brel ba yod pa bcas/ mthar phyin pa'i ther 'dodan byas nas dri ngan kha ba zhig bakhrod rgyu'i thabs shes yod/ ces bcadad nas lag lcags bamo la ba dang / stod thung phyi bo sa phud bcug nas nang 'jam srab lngaste zhig las ma bzhag par thag pas nus shugs gang yod bsdams bkyigs byas kyang / da dung blo yid ma tshims par rgyug pa thung thung de thag pa'i dbar dbrag la bcug nas gcus ril byed bzhin/ ngas bris pa'i ngan dor bzang blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum la dgag yig bris pa de mig mdun du bstan nas de sus bris pa red 172

gral mo gas lha 76sa nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 173ces bshad de/ ra sprod byas stabs gzhi nas ngas bris pa yin zhes ngo sa len ma byed mthu med byung /de nas kho cho de bas khong khro chen po langs te mi de ha las pa'i rdzab chen zhig red/ ces btson khang gi sdi mig thag pa gzhu ba dang /pus mo/ sa la btsugs bcug ste g.yas g.yon nas rdog bkyag grangs med dang / 'gram lcag rdeg pa/ mgo bor rdog brdzis gtong ba sogs byas shing / de nas btson pa rnams las thag bcad de btson khang du 'o/ga mtshams de nyin zhu mtshams bcad de/ thag pa bskadal nas lag lcags brgyab ste khyod rang mu mthud bsam blo btang nas sang nyin lnga sa len gsar pa zhu rgyu yod pa byed dgos/ zhes bshad de btson srung bas 'khrid de btson khang du bcug skabs lus po yongs rdzogs nad pa bzos/sang nyin btson pa rnams phyi ru ngal rtsol byed par btang ba dang /chabs cig phran tsha 'dri byed yul khang chung der 'khrid de than kan sis mdang nub khyod rang bsam blo'i go skabs sprad par/ bsam slo btang nas ngos len gsar pa gang zhu rgyu yod dam/ zhes dri ba byas par ngas sngon du ngo sa len zhus pa ltar las de min ngos len gsar pa zhu rgyu mi dran/zhes bshad par/ kho pa chodas rang rtogs kyis ngos len zhus pa dang / nga tshos khyod la gnas tshul ra sprod byas pa gnyis kyi thodag mtha' ma'i thag 173

174 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gcod byed dus lci yang khyad par yod/ rang gis ngos len zhus na thag gcod yang ba yong gi red/ ces nam rgyun dril bsgrags byed pa'i srid jus de dag bskyar du byas/ phran nas mdang nub bsam chod btang yang ngos len gsar pa zhu yas med bcadad par/ slar yang kho chod khong khro langs te sngar bzhin lcags bkrol ba dang / stod thung phyi go sa phud de thag pas bkyigs rdung byed mur nga'i nyin deb de mig gi mdun du bstan nas 'di su'i red/ ces dris byung bar/ nga'i red ces ngos len byas shing / de'i nang 'khod pa'i gzhi 'dzin rtsa don bzhi dang / nang gses bcu/ rgya mtsho'i bka' phru ba zer ba gang dang gang yin/ lhag par rgya mtsho zer ba su yin/des khyodad la slob ston ji byas ngos len gsal zhu bya dgos/ de ni khyod tsho'i log spyod kyi rtsa 'dzin zhig yin pas mthar phyin pa'i ngos len gsal po zhu dgos zer gal che nan 'dri byas/ngas rgya mchod zer ba ni twa la'i bla mar zer gyi yod/ ces bshad par kho pa che sa twa la'i bla mar rgya mtsho zer gyi yod pa red dam/ zhes dris byung bar/ phran nas khong gi mtshan lnga mar bstan 'dzin rgya mace zhes zer gyi yod/ khong gi mtshan cha tshang ma bris pa ni mi mang srid gzhung nas mkhyen na/ khyod kyis twa la'i bla mar yid ches blo gtad bcol ba dang tā la'i bla mar rmongs dad byed kyi yod pa sogs/ skyon brjod 'thab rtsod sdi74
