gral rogs sgo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 175phog rgyur skrag nas gsang ba byas pa zhig yin brjod par/ 〈ge pa dza phran bu yid ches pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa dang / de nas gzhi 'dzin rtsa don ba'i dang / nang gses bcu gang yin gsal zhu byed dgos zhes nan 'dri byed pa/ phran nas gzhi 'dzin rtsa don bzhi zer ba'i nang gi/dang po ni/ bdag gi tshe 'dir bskos pa'i byams brtse'i pha ma spun mched tsho dang / sha tsha ldan pa'i mdza' brtse'i 'thab grogs tshos gtsos rgya che'i ser skya spun zla pho mo rgan gzhon tshos phran la re bcol mdzad pa bzhin/ dus dang gnas skabs kun tu 'chi sdu/ga la thug kyang / blo brtan 'gyur med kyis dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs bcol zhing /7gong sa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bdag dang pha ma gnyis dang khyim mis mtshon/ gangs ljongs skye 'gro kun la bskyangs pa'i thugs brtse che ba'i bka' drin rnams shes shing bla srog steng du tshor ba byas te 7gong sa mchodag la dad zhen tshad med dang / yid ches tshad med/ lhag bsam rnam dag tshad med bcas byed pa'i rang bzhin la rgyun chad med par shugs snon brgyag rgyu dang / de bzhin rgyu 'bras mi bslu zhing / bden par snying nas yid rton te dge ba'i las lam lha chos dge ba bcu po 'gal med brtsi srung byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor dad gus dang / las 'bras la yid ches dang brtsi srung byed pa'i gegs byung gi btson grogs 175

17snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang gyung ba/rnams rang gi pha spun gyi 'du shes/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i la rgya dam bzung gis khong tshor 'phrad srid pa'i dka' nyen rnams rang nyid kyi dka' nyen la ma 'dzems par gang thub ci thub dang / thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas sel rogs byas te der lus sems gnyis kyi thog la phan bde sku nga thabs dang /mig snga'i thun mong gi 'atso ba bag phebs don ldan ngang bskyal thub pa ma zad/ phyis 'byung yin yang thun mo nga gi dmigs yul du bde blag ngang nas slebs thub pa'i 'gan srung bya rgyu yin/gnyis pa/ lta 'e ga pa gung jag gis nyes rdung drag lnga gasnodang ba dang / khrims gcod drag wa byed pa'ang / yang na mkhas snyan dang / rgyu nor la brten nas slu 'brid byed pa'i gnas tshul gyi mdun du rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa rnams la yod dgo sa pa'i phul byung gi ngo nge dang / ya rabs gshis bzang nam yang mi 'gyur ba byed pa'i snying stobs la g.yo 'gul spu tsam mi byed pa/gsum pa/ gnas skabs kyi bar chad dang 'phrad dus gzhan la khag 'dogs mi byed pa dang / lha ra rdung la mi skrag pa/ lha gas med gcig pur lus rgyur mi skrag pa ma zad/ gang la'ang mi skrag pa'i lha nas bden 176

gral mo gas sku chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 177dodan la yid ches dang / bslab byar phyogs balha mas/ mi mang che bar mthun sgril dang / slob gso/ rtsa 'dzugs bya rgyur do snang gis skabs 'a༅la mgo bde dran 'khrul pa dang / dgra bo'i tshur rgol la gang la de 'tshams kyi 'thab rtsod byas te hrogs med gcig pur 'jog thabs dang /'thab rtsod byas nas dgra lnga las rnam par rgyal ba zhig byed dbo sa pa de shusgon/bzhi pa/ dus gang dang yul gang du'ang gong gsal rtsa don yang dag pa rnams rgyun 'khyodangs byas te bsam blo dang bya spyod yang dag min pa thams cad la 'thab rtsod lhe da med byas te/ mgo na skyabs chen snga 7bstan 'dzin rgya mchodas bstan pa gnang ba'i yang dag pa'i lam phyo gas the ga dpa' ngar zhum med kyi mdun bskyod bya rgyu yin/ de bzhin nang gses bcu zer ba de srog gcod dang / ma byin pa/ mi gtsang spyod pa/ rdzun smra ba/tshig rtsub/ phra ma/ ngag 'chal/ bsnab sems/ gce da sems/ 'e1ga lta bcas spangs dasgo sa pa de dag yin/ces brjod par kho cho las byed phan tshun phar lta tshur lta byas te de 'dra yin na mi mang bcings barsha la dmag gi sgrig khrims chen lnga gsum dang / do snang byed dgos pa brgyad 'dra po 'dug da lta bshad pa de dag 177

178 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ma red/ don tshan bcu zer ba khyod tsho'i 'o/ga spyod kyi rtsa 'dzin zhig yod ces bcadad byung / phran nas dngo sa gnas de rang yin zhes basprodad par yid ches lta bu byas te/ da khyodad kyis spyir btang 'o/ga spyod kyi bsam blo'i rtsa ba phyir bton zin pa red/ da res zhu ba len mtshams de tsam la bzhag gi yin btson khang nang phar sku nga ste nam rgyun spyi dzartags thog dang / btson khang nang / las mi'i nang bza' 'thung gi 'brel ba su dang byed kyi yod pa dang / khyod mos 'gul bskyod gang byed kyi yod med nga tsho mi mang srid gzhung nas gsal sngo/ shes kyi yod la/ khyedad dang 'brel yod mi khag gcig gis khyod ra'i gnas tshul mang lnga sber 'dodan byas yod/ mi khag gcig ru khag so so'i nang nga phos 'dri rtsad byas te ngos len zhu bzhin pa'i sgang red/ der brten gzhan gyis ther 'don ma byas go nga tang srid la yid ches kyis rjes lus ma thebs par sngo sa len sngon la zhu thub na thag gcod yang ba sku nga gi red la/ da res khyodad kyis byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel ba dang / sngar 'gyod phyi sdom gyis tang dang mi mang srid gzhung la nye brten gyi mi gsar pa zhig byed mi byed dang / 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam gyi phyogs su skyod dang / mun nag 'thibs pa'i gshin rje'i drung du bskyod gnyis kyi mthar thug dbye mtshams 'byed pa'i 'gag rtsa'i dus skabs shig yin pas/ bsam chod nan po btang nas rang skyodan lnga sa len 178

gral phra gas bo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 179dang / gzhan skyon ther 'don byed dgos zhes bshad de dgong dro chu tshod lnga pa'i mtshams la zhu thag bcad de thag pa glod nas sngar bzhin las/ lcags brgyab ste btson khang du bcus/ byung / lag ngar skrang nas lto chas kyang za dka' ba zhig dang / lus ngo yongs rdzogs rdung rdzogs kyis gathodangs can bzos/ skabs der nga'i bsam blo'i nang da ni rgyun gtan dam bca' bzhag pa'i rtsa dodan rnams lag len mtha' 'khyongs thub min gyi 'gag rtsa'i dus la slebs 'dug dgra bos dam drag chen po'i sbed nas btson khang nang rang nyid grogs med gcig pur bcug stabs/ pha ma spun mched dang sha tsha 'brel yod kyi blo mthun su gcig la'ang gros dri sa med par/shi dmyal ba'i 'phrang du rang nyid gcig pur 'gro dgos zer ba'i shod tshul ni 'di lta bu zhig min nam snyam pa dran nas ha cang sems skyo ngo byung /'on kyang ngas rig pa bsgrims nas skyod snang de stobs shugs su 'gyur ba byed dgos/ pha bzang gi bu/ zhes rang gis rang la sems gso dang snying lha bas la skul lcag btang ba ste/ ngas 1959 lo nas da phan mi lo bcu bzhi tsam ring rang sger gyi khe nyen la ma ltos par gyong gun gang zhig 21ga kyang / khyad bsad kyis rgyal gces lhag bsam gyi snying ltobs dang / gzhi 'dzin rtsa don bzhi po de rang nyid kyi yod tshad las lhag pa zhig tu brtsis te/ rtag tu sems la brtan snga ra bzhag nas dka' 179

180 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/nyen la ma 'dzems par/ lag len gang 'tshams byas pa'i nyer len la rten nas bce na khang nang gi btso na sgo gas cho dang / las mi'i nang gi rgyal gces lhag bsam can tsho/ de min bsam sku da skye bo pho mo rgan gzhe na tshang mas slo yon lags zer ba mi lo chung chung zhig la gang ci'i tshadad bgam theg thub pa'i btso ma'i gser lta bu zhig tu ngos 'dzin gyis tshang mas nga la yid ches dang dga' zhen re ba byed yul zhig tu brtsi yi yodad pas/ da res kyi btso na khang de kho nga tsho sa rgyun gtan nga la yid ches gdeng 'jog byas pa ltar/ rang nyid btso ma'i gser ngo ma zhig yin dang / yang na gser la rdzus pa'i rag rgan zhig yin gnyis brdar sha gcadad pa'i bzhu thab chen po zhig dang / ngas da phyin yangs shing rgya che ba'i 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam gyi phyogs su mdun bskyod byed dang / gu dog mun nag gi rgyogs su phyir bshol byed gnyis kyi mthar gtugs dbye mtshams 'byed sa zhig yin pas/ da res kyi tsho da bgam de nges par theg thub pa zhig byed pa'i 'gag rtsar thug sa ni/ nga la dka' nyen dang / sdug thog sdug rtseg gi dka' sdug de bas che ba zhig da dung mu mthud myong dbo sa pa dang / tha na dgra wa sa mo ga thodag gi nyes pa bcad kyang spyi tsho gas kyi btson rwa'i nang gnas pa'i nga'i lhag lus brtse ba'i sprun mched tso dang /de bzhin nga la sha tsha 'brel sku da kyi mdza' brtse'i 'thab grogs cho gasku sgyu 180

gral ro/gas go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 181dang / gdug rtsub che ba'i dgra bo gshed ma'i lag tu gcig kyang rtsis sgrod byed kyi min/ ngas sems thag gtsang bcad dang / rang srog blos gtong bar mi skrag pa/ dka' ngal khri lha nga khyad bsad kyis rtsa don mtha' 'khyongs byas te mun nag lo ga lam dang kha bral nas 'di phyi gnyis yod kyi 'od zer ldan pa'i mdun lam thog nam yang mdun bskyod bya rgyu yin/zhes gdung shugs drag lnga sa mgon skyabs chen ngo bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos dbus bla ma yid dam chodas dge 'dun/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dzadas skyong srung ma rnams dang / de bzhin nga'i tshe 'dir bskos pa'i byams brtse'i pha ma spun mched 'das gse na chod dang / nga la sha tsha 'brel yod kyi mdza' brtse'i 'thab bo gas chodas mchodan pa'i rgya khyab ser skya spun zla chod mig lam du bsgom nas khong rnam pa'i mdun dam bca' bzhag pa yin/ gnad don la ngos 'dzin dang thag gcod kyi chod sems btsugs rjes lus kyi dka' ngal sel zhing / sems nang dga' spro dang spobs pa skye ba zhig sku nga mur gnyid khug 'dugasang nyin sngar bzhin snga dro'i chu tshod brgyad pa tsam la do dam las byed yong nas mar don shog brjod de/ khang chung de'i nang 'khrid byung /de nas kho pa tshos nam rgyun bkyig rdung byed pa'i thag pa dang / rgyug pa de nga'i mdun du g.yugs nas mdang nub bsam slo btang ste/ gnas 181

182 nga'i mi tshe dmyalame'i nangabatsosbyangabyung ba/tshul gsal zhu bya rgyu gang yod ces dris byung / ngas spon du ngos len zhus pa'i gnas tshul de dag rang nyid kyis bsags pa'i nag nyes shig yin/ der gzhigs pa'i khrims gcod nyes chad gang gnang yang 'gyodad pa med/ de min dmigs bsal gnas tshul gang yang zhu rgyu med/ ces bshad par thang ka'an sis/ (rgya dalnga na ) lha sa'i nye 'dabs skar ma dbo na gsar la khyod kyis lnga shes pa med dam/ zhes bshad nas yi ge cadag lhe zhig rgyang nas bstan tsam byas te khyedad rang gi 'brel yod mi chodas ngos len dang ther 'don byed kyi yod/ khyod rang rjes lus thebs yong /lha sa'i nye 'dabs skar dgon du gnas bzhugs nga'i gcen mo dbyangs can lags kyi ming 'ango da nas khyod kyi gcen mo dang chab srid lnga ga 'brel ba gang yod ces nan 'dri byed kyi 'dug de bzhin 'brel sku da slo mthun khag gcig gi ming bton nas kho ce dang nam rgyun kha bral mi lnga da pa'i 'brel ba ga re yod/ kho cho ru khag so so'i nang khyod ra'i gnas tshul ther 'dodan byed bzhin yod/ khyod rang lnga sa len zhu yi min nam/ zhes nan 'dri byas par/ phran nas kho tsho dang za 'thung 'brel ba tsam las de min re stong rmongs dad kyi 'brel ba gang yang med ces shod skabs/ lhag don slo bzang tshe brtan dang khyod gnyis btson khang du sdod skabs dang /las mi'i nang du mig ltos bag chags ngan pa bajo ba dang / khyod tsho ni 182

gral zodabs lha chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 183btson pa dang las mi tsho'i sgyur bkod kyi bkag rdo chen po zhig red/ de snga khyod tsho'i dbar re dkrog rmongs gsum gyi gnas tshul rim pa lhag nas ngos len rim pa zhu cadang ba ma zad/ slad nas khyod tsho 'brel ba byed kyi min zhes khas len zhu yig gi snag tsha ma skam gong sngar bzhin 'brel ba byed par rgyu mtshan nges can yod pa red/ma'o kru'o zhis 'jig rten na rgyu dang rkyen med pa'i byams brtse med la/ rgyu dang rkyen med pa'i sdang sems yang med ces slob ston gnang yod/ khyod tsho de snga ngo shes kyi 'brel ba med la/ pha ma sprun mched ni ma red/ btson khang dang las mi'i nang slebs rjes khyod tsho phan tshun kha bral mi phod pa'i 'brel ba byed pa dang / sna khung gcig gi nang nas dbugs mnyam gtong byed pa ni gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi sgrig 'dzugs sam/ yang na tang gis nyes can la 'dzin pa'i sgyur bkod srid jus la rtsur rgol rtsis log brgyag pa'i ngan gshom byed kyi yod pa red/ tang gi srid jus ni nag nyes che chung la mi lta bar/ ngos len gyi rnam 'gyur dang sngar 'gyod phyis sdom byed 'dod yod med la lta yi yod/ tang srid la yid ches lnga sa len mthar phyin zhu dbo sa/ zhes nan 'dri byas kyang phran nas slo bzang tshe brtan dang nga chod pha yul gcig pa'i 'du shes bzung nas za 'thung gi 'brel ba tsam las/ de min tang gi chab srid dang 'gal ba'i 183

184 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ngo sa len zhu rgyu med ces mthar bkag btang / de rjes bstan pa lhan grub la khyod kyis tshags par lha ra gang bshad yodad dam/ bstan pa lhan grub nas tang srid la yid ches kyis rang skyodan lnga sa len dang / gzhan skyon ther 'don byed bzhin yod/ khyod rang yid ma ches na bstan lhan gyis ther 'dodan byas pa'i zhu yig de red/ ces cadag lhe zhig rgyang nas bstan tsam byas byung /nga'i bsam par rang gis chodad sems dam bca' bzhag pa bzhin/gal te 'brel sku da slo mthun tshadas rang gi sna khug la mdzub mo btsugs te gnas tshul ther 'dodan byas na/ skabs mtshams lnga sa len byed dbo sa min bsam slo gtong rgyu las de min dgra bo'i 'dra po dang / sgrig po'i g.yo codag tu nam yang mi tshud pa byed snyam pa dran nas bstan lhan dang tang gi chab srid dang 'gal ba'i dkrog gtam bshad pa med bajo da rjes sngar bzhin bkyigs rdung drag ngo byed bzhin mur/ las byed byams pas wa da ljongs nyin re'i tshags dpar zhig nang twa la'i skor thon pa'i gnas tshul zhig bstan pa snyun grub la bshad med dam/ da dung khyod rang klad rnying mkhregs bzung byed kyi yin nam/ phran nas 1972 lo'i nang nge da ljongs nyin re'i tshags dpar zhig gi par ngos bzhi pa'i nang 'khod don du/ tā las hin rdur yodad pa'i rgyal spyi'i slob grwa chen mo'i nang gtam 184

gral sna gas0go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 185bshad byas te bod de thog mtha' bar gsum la rang dbang rang btsan yin/rgya nag gis bod btsan bzung byas pa de drang zhing cadas pa zhig yin min rgyal spyi'i 'os cadag grangs mang nyung lag len bstar ba'i 'gro lugs de yang bskyar lag len byed rgyur/ nga tsos yid mthun byed kyi sku da/ ces gsungs 'dug ces bstan pa lhan grub la phal cher bshad pa zhig dran gyi 'dug ces bshad pa yin/ kho pa tshos tshags dpar de'i 'e khams dang zla tshes gang yin/ tshags dpar de mthong nas khyod la 'char snang gang byung / mi gzhan su dang su la bshad yodad/ gzhan la bshad dgos pa'i dmigs ༷/la gang yin/ mi gzhan nas der lan 'debs gang byas pa ngas ngos len zhu dgos kyi tsha 'dri bsnyud mar snga rjes nyin bdun tsam byas pa'i nyin drug pa de'i sang nyin de'i dgong dro chu tshod bdun pa tsam la kre ta'o yon bsod nams rdo rjes btson khang gi sge'u khung nas slo yon/ khyod rang bsam slo gang btang gi yod dam/ ngos len gsar pa zhus zin pa rnams la gzhigs na nag nyes chen lnga bsags sku/da par lnga sa 'dzin gyis tang dang mi mang srid gzhung nas khrims gcod gang byas kyang 'gyod pa med ces bshad/ de nas kre ta'o yodan nas rnam 'gyur drang po'i tshul gyis ngas bltas na khyedad rang gi sprun mched yin na'ang 'dra/ grogs po yin na'ang 'dra/ kho sar sha tsha brtse dung dngos 'brel chin po yod pa'i rnam pa zhig 185

186 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ mthong gi 'dug gal te kho zor sha tsha brtse dung dngos 'brel yod na/khyod kyis lnga sa len de yag wa byas te zhu dgo sa/ mi mang srid gzhung gi lag tu thebs zin pa'i gnas tshul rnams tshur ther 'don ma byas gong /rang gis ༷ na la ngos len zhu thub pa byed dgos pa dang / mi gzhan gyis ther 'aro/na ma byas gong rang gis sngon la bo ma pa mdun la spos nas ngos len zhu thub pa byed dgos/ tang gis kha gsal gu yangs dang / sbas skung la drag gnon gyi zhib phra'i srid jus la do snang byed dgos/lhag par ngos len zhu rim nang rnam 'gyur nyam chung bton dgos pa ni gal chen po red/ de ltar ma byas na gyong gun chen po phog gi red/ngas gong du bshad pa rnams sems la bzhag na/sa de ltar byas na ga'i byed kyi ma red/ khyod rang nga la yid ches byed zer bshad byung zhing kre ta'o yon bse da nams shod rje ni nam rgyun nga chod nyes can zer ba'i mi rnams la mthong chung med par 'chod bar sems 'khur dang / bde sdug mdun lam la bsam slo phran bu gtong mkhan zhig red/ kho ni ma le ring lugs dang /ma'o tse tung gis rtsom deb tu/ nyes pa shor ba'i mi gang 'dra zhig yin rung / kho tshor bo bskon yid skug gi nus pa thon pa'i slob ga—so brgyab nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi go rtewags ldan pa'i ngal rtsol ba zhig tu sgyur thub pa byed dbo sa/ zer ba dang / rgyugs pa gzhu thengs gcig la mi 186

gral ro/gas sgotho chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 187gsod pa'i thabs shes lag len byed rgyu med/ ces pa sogs kyi gzhung lugs srid jus lag len gang thub byed mkhan zhig yin pa ma zad/ gzhi rtsa'i kho pa ni bce na khang 'go khrid nang nas bsam shes can zhig dang ya nga sīng rje/ ngo tsha khrel gzhung phran bu yod pa'i mi gcig yin stabs las mi tshang mas yid ches dga' zhen dang / brtsi 'jog byed yul zhig tu brtsis kyi yod par brten/ kho pas slob gso brgyab pa rnams slob gsor rtsis nas yid ches do snang byas pa yin/sang nyin lo gas pa'i chu tshod brgyad pa tsam la krang ca'o hoXng (kong po ba/)drag rtsub che mdog gis btson khang lde mig gi sgra sing ling sing ling zhes dkrogs shing sku/nga nas sgo la rdog rgyag gzhus te/ dza drag chen pos sgo lcags phye nas rdzig nyams ngang khro gnyer bsdus shing / mig khro tshugs ngang 'jigs skul sngar dang mi 'dra ba zhig byas te/ kas/ rdzab chen mar thon shodag ces gtum drag chen pos brjod de lam du rdog rgyag gzhu bzhin mur 'khrid skabs/ nga'i bsam blo'i nang slo mthun gzhan ce sa ko thag sgru da pa yin nam snyam nas 'jigs snang sems 'tshab chen po byung / mthong ba tsam gyi zhe log pa'i zhu ba len sa'i khang chung der slebs skabs/ de snga nga 'dzin bzung byed mkhan las byed tshang ma 'dzoms thos rgya mi las byed yang kha'o krang yang rdzig nyams dang bcas te slebs//87

188 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ya nga snying rje med pa'i gshed ma de tsho rgyas 'dzoms byas pa'i mdun/ thang kan sis khyod rang mdang nub bsam gro'i go skabs sprad par bsam slo btang nas ngo sa len gsar pa zhu rgyu gang sku da ces dris par/ phran nas ngos len gong du zhus pa ltar las gsar pa zhu rgyu med brjod ma thag yang kha'o krang dang thang kan si gnyis nas khro gtum che ba'i rnam 'gyur bton bzhin du bsdams bkyigs byedas/ zhes skad shugs chen sprod bsgyu da par rgyug khyi nag po krang cwa horā dang / byams pa gnyis nas sngar bas nus shugs gang sku/da kyis bsdams bkyigs byas khar/ da dung dbyug pa thag pa'i dbar la bcug ste balha ra ba brgyabs stabs na zug gis skad ngan shor zhing / thod pa nas rngul chu 'dzad med thon ste sa cha'ang rlon pa chags sa/kha rgyun du dpral mabo skam po'i steng nas chu cadan pa thodan pa zhig bakhrod dgos 'dug gam/ zer sredal yod pa bzhin mi'i dpral mgo nas chu mang po de 'dra thon rgyu yod pa dngos nas red 'dug snyam/ de nyin gshed ma de tsos smyo ba ltar gyi bkyigs rdung tshad med byas tsang phran na zug gis ma bakhrodad par nga nag nyes chen lnga yin/ da lta me mda' brgyab nas srog thog gtong rogs/ brdzod skabs/ bud med las byed mas mos ngo gdong dmar skug/ ston bzhin du 'chi yang 'gyod bshags mi byed mkhan 188

gral sna gas go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 189gyi gsar brjer ngo rgol ba zer ba ni khyod 'dra ba'i mi de tso red/ khyod ra'i gnas tshul yongs rdzogs rtsis sgrod ma byas bar nga chos thag gcod byed kyi min/ khyod kyis log spyod kyi bsam slo de dur sar 'khyer dgos bsam gyi 'dug gam/ de 'dra stabs bde po yod pa ma red/ ces gshe gshe galta nga ba dang / thang kan sis nga'i mabo bo'i skra nas 'then khar las byed krang cwa hokheng dang byams pa gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas the ga rgyag dang / 'gram lcag thengs mang gzhu ba so/gas mi dzadas las 'das pa'i ya nga med pa'i 'thab rtsod dang / snying rje med pa'i rdung rdeg snga dro'i chu sad brgyad pa tsam nas dgong dro'i chu mod lnga dang phyed ka tsam bar byas shing /de nas bsu na khang dang / las mi/ spyi tshangags thodag nas gnas tshul gsar pa gang yang ra sprod bya rgyu ma rnyed stabs kho pa tsho ci bya gtol bral du gyur nas da dung bsam sgyu galtasgong dasgo sa/ gal te gzhan nas gnas tshul gsar pa tshig gcig ther 'don byas na/ dngos 'brel las sla por 'jog gi min/ zhes bshad de sngar rgyun ltar kra cwa ho'o nas thag pa slod rtsis byed skabs/ yang khacad krang nas thag pa sgru da ma bcug par stod thung rgyab la g.yog zer bshad de phyi mis mthong dwogs kyang byed/ de nas btson khang nang thag pas bsdams bkyigs byed mur bzhag stabs na zug ma bakhrodad par rtsig par mgo brdabs pa dang / de nyin me mda' brgyab nas bsad 189

190 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/kyang 'gyod pa med pa dang bsam rgyu dran rgyu med pa chags/chu tshod bdun dang phyed ka tsam la btson pa rnams kyi dgong dro'i kha lag gi ting ting brdungs rjes las byed byams pas bce na khang tshems bzo ba 'gyur med 'khrid yong ste/ kho'i thag pa de bkrol zer bshad pa ltar/ bce na ro/gas 'gyur med nas thag pa lag par dkris pa re re bzhin bshig nas phur phur gtong rtsis byed skabs/ byams pas 'gyur med la gshe gshe gshe/nga gin mgyodags sngo/ thag pa bkrol zhes bshad stabs 'gyur med zhed de/ lags so/ zhes bshad cing nga'i lag pa phur phur gtong mi nus par thag pa bkrol ma thag dngos 'brel phu slod pa lta bu'i bde ba byung / de nas ma byan gyi de nyin gyi zas thug pa skyel skabs pho ra pa gang bzed nas 'thung rtsis byas kyang / lag pa bkyag ma thub par dgun dus grang ngar che ba'i chu nas thon te 'khyag brdar nor ba ltar lag pa 'dar/byams pas khyedad rang 'khyag gi 'dug gam/ zhes dris byung bas/ 'khyag gi mi 'dug zhes bshad/ yang las byed byams pas thug pa mkhyedags snga 'thung dgos la do dgong nas khyod ra'i lag lcags rgyab tu rgyob/ brdzod kyi 'dug ces bshad de phyir log song / nyin gang thag pas bsdams bkyigs byas pa'i na zug btang ba'i shul gyis lags lcags rgyab tu brgyab kyang dka' ngal che ba yong sa ma red snyam byung /190

gral rogs go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 191da ni rang gis dam bca' bzhag pa'i rtsa don rnams mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i dus la slebs 'dug snyam nas chod sems dam bca' bzhag pa'i 'bru don rnams dran gso nan po byed pa dang / rang gis rang la skul lcag btang ste sdug thog sdug rtseg gi dka' sdug de bas tshabs che ba zhig mu mthud myong dgos pa'i thog lo mang yun ring btson khang nang yang bskyar sdod dgos pa'i khrims gcod lo tshad btang ba dang / tha na srog hphog gi nyes chad btang yang / nga'i tshe 'dir bskos pa'i brtse ba'i spun mched lhag lus tsho dang / de bzhin nga la sha tsha 'brel yod kyi mdza' brtse ldan pa'i 'thab grogs gcig kyang / g.yo sgyu dang gdug rtsub che ba'i dgra bo'i khrag gi 'tshos pa'i bdud lag tu rtsis sprod mi byed pa'i chod sems dam bca' nges par brtan srung bya rgyu yin/ ngas gcig nas dka' sdug la mi skrag pa dang / gnyis nas 'chi rgyur mi skrag pa'i snying stobs la brten nas chod sems dam bca' brtan srung dang / bden don mtha' 'khyongs byed thub na/ dgra bos nga ni 'chi yang 'gyod bshags mi byed mkhan gyi gsar brje ngo rgol par brtsis te/ nyin grangs mang po bstud mar rdung rdzog byas kyang / da dung kho pa tsho slo yid ma tshim par lag lcags rgyab twa brgyab ste btson khang nang grogs med gcig pur bzhag yod na'ang / don dngos thog nga ni grogs med khe rkyang lus pa zhig gtan nas 191

192 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ma yin par/ gce che mabo na skyabs chen lnga bstan 'dzin rgya malnga sa dbus/bla ma yid dam/ chodas/ dge 'dun/ dpa' wa mkha' 'aspro chodas skyong srung ma rnams nga'i phyogs sku yodad pa dang / khong rnam pas 'gyur med stobs dang ldan pa'i lha nas nga'i rgyab rtsa gnang gi yod pa dang / yang sgos nga'i tshe 'dir bsgos pa'i pha ma spun mched 'das gson zo dang0/ de bzhin nga la sha tsha 'brel sku da kyi mdza' brtse'i 'thab gro gas snums mdza na pa'i las 'bras brtsi srung byed mkhan rgya khyab ser skya sprun zla pho mo rgan gzhe na tshang mas/ nga la gdung sems mnyam skyed dang / byed stangs 'dra min sna tshadags kyi0mo gas ram byed dang byed bzhin yod pa ni yid ches brtan po byas chodag pa zhig red/ der brten nga la 'gran zla med pa'i stodabs shugs sku/da mkhan zhig tu gyur stabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi dgra wa sa khe pa0tsho'i khrims 'gal khe dbang srung ched/ phan tshun ngan 'brel gyis da yod dbang cha bed spyod kyi nga la 'jigs skul basbu 'brid byed pa dang /yang na/ nam yang zad mtha' med pa'i mnar gce da byed thabs sku da tshad la rten don du ngas bden don0mtha' 'khyongs byed mi thub pa zhig bzos te/ rang nyid dmangs 'khon gnyen bral gyi mi tshang mas mthong chung dang /do snang byed rin med pa/ mthar bod rgya su zhig la'ang phan med gnod 'tshe'i rang bzhin du rtsis yul gyi mi'i rigs kyi gral star nang mi tshud 192

gral mosnags bo chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 193pa'i khyi skyag phung po zhig tu gyur thub pa byung na rab dang / de min nga zos rgya dmar gyi btsan 'dzul dang / log spyod dbang sgyur la 'gog rgol byed pa'i gsang ba'i gnas tshul gang mang zhig cha bsdu byas nas de dag rdo ga the ga gang che che zhig bakhrodas te/ 'chi yang 'khyodad bshags mi byed mkhan gyi gsar brjer ngo rgol ba tang gis nyes can par 'dzin pa'i sgyur bkod srid jus la mtha' cig tu 'bo ga sga la byed mkhan/ nyes can sgyur bgo da pa'i khrodad du mig snodas ngan pa dang bag chags ngan pa 'aX ga mkhan/ sgrur bkodad pa spyi'i bkag the / zer ba se gas kyi nyes ming chen po zhig bkal nas srodag the ga gto/nga ba'am/ yang na 'o/ mang yun ring btso na khang nang yang bskyar sde da dgos pa zhig dang / yang na btson khang nang sdug shi thebs pa zhig bzo rgyu'i re ngan bcangs sku da na'ang / kho pa tsho'i re ngan de dag lag len byed skabs phyi mo la yul gyi dka' ngal ha cang mang ngo zhig 'phrad de/ dka' ngal de dag sel ma thub pa'i dbang gis nga'i gnad don de gang mgyogs rlung 'jam char sim ngang ma 'dod bzhin du/ thag gcod byas te nga sgyu da 'gro la gte nga dbo sa pa zhig dang / chab srid the ga nga la nyes ming sna chodags bkal ba rnams rtsis med gtong dgo sa pa zhig dang /dpal 'byedar thodag sdug khyodang ster ba rnams ma 'dod bzhin gun gsab byed dgos pa'i nyin mo zhig 'char nges yin pa'i ngotheshaṃ 'dzin byas pa yin/193

194 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ngas bo nga du kha tshon bcad pa rnams yongs su yang dag pa zhig yin pa'i ra sprod rim bzhin sku nga rgyur yid ches brtan po byas nas bsdad cing / de nas mtshan mo'i chu tsho da 11 mtshams su slebs dus/ gnyid khug sku nga skabs nyin mo ya nga med pa'i btson las gshed ma de tshos/ kwas shod/ kwas shod/ zer ba'i bag chags kyi sgra rna lam nas ma phyin pa dang /kha dang mig la gzhu bar sku nga ba'i snang ba shugs che 'khor te gnyid hob sad yang yang byed kyi 'duga'on kyang nyon mo ngas kyi gnyid ni dbang shugs che bas gang ltar gnyid khug 'dug de nas nam phyed yol mtshams su slebs dus gcin pa dro byung bar/ gcin pa gtong shes e yong snyam nas tshod lta zhig byas par gcin pa thebs chag gtong shes bajo 'dug yar langs skabs khog smad tshang mar na zug gis langs mi thub kyang / sdug rus byas te rtsig par 'khyud de yar langs skabs sge'u khung nang zla 'od phog 'dug zla 'od kyi mdun lha ba ste nga rang gi grib gzugs mthong skabs 'jigs skrag skyes byung / nga'i mgo bo'i skra ni srin po'i mgo ltar zing zing 'jigs su rung ba zhig bzos 'dug de nas gcin pa btang thub tsam byung rjes gnyid sib sib cig khug pa'i mur/ kong po mi ser tsho'i khyim byas bya skad brgyab pa thos byung bas/ de nub nam mgyogs sngo langs pa'i tshor snang 194

gral zodags go chas nga 'chi lam du bskyal ba/ 195byung / sang nyin las byed byams pa yong nas lcags bkrol nas kha lag mgyogs po za dgos zer bshad/ lag ngar yongs rdzogs skrang nas na zug gis kha lag kyang za khag tsam byung / de snga btson khang nang btson pa khag gcig lag pa bsdams bkyigs byas te lag pa 'phro brlags the ra ba kha shas byung ba ltar/ lag pa 'phro brlags phyin mi yong ngam snyam pa byung /rgyab lcags brgyab nas nyin bzhi tsam 'das dus na zug ha cang chen po byung pa dang / lto chas za ring rgyab lcags bkrol nas yang bskyar lcags brgyab skabs sems skyo ba dang 'tsher snang che yang bya thabs dben/skabs der btson khang gi sge'u khung nas mgon skyabs chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bzhugs pa'i phyogs su kha gtad de/ ngo gdong mchi mas gang bzhin par nga dang 'dra ba'i mnar gcod myong bzhin pa'i skye bo rnams dka' sdug 'di nas myur du thar ba'i thugs rjes rgyang nas gzigs rogs gnang / zhes gdung shugs drag pos gsol smon btab pa'i nus mthu lta bus/ nyin mtshan drug phyin pa'i dus hrūd der zhu ba len sa'i khang chung der 'khrid de rgya mi las byed tang kan sis khyod rang nyin mtshan kha shas bsam ḍā btang nas sngags len gsar pa zhu rgyu dran song ngam/ zhes dris par/ ngas ngos len gsar pa zhu rgyu med brdzod pa yin/ gal te mi gzhan gyis gnas tshul ther 'don byas pa byung na/ khyod rang las sla 195

19snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/por 'jog gi min/ zhes bshad de rgyab lcags sngar bzhin mdun du sgos nas mu mthud bsam slo gtong dgos/ khyod kyis bsam blo'i rtsa ba ngos len zhu rgyu nas 'bo btsugs te bya spyodad sngo ga nag nyes gsar pa ji bsags pa dang / gzhan dang 'brel ba gang sku da rnams yig the ga zhu yig 'bul dgos zhes bshad de phyir 'e ga btang /skabs der nga'i bsam blo'i nang phyi nas slo mthun mos ko thag ma glod na/ phal cher zhu thag chodad pa yin sa red/ gnas tshul gsar pa ma thon pa'i spyodan lam brgyab ste bsdad/ de rjes bsam pa bzang ba'i ma byan bgres song des lto skyel bar phebs nas a tsi khyodad rang sdug ngo zhe drags mthe nga song / gang drag zhes gsungs nas gdung sems mnyam skyed shugs che gnang / ngas sku zhabs gang yang byed kyi ma red/ de 'dra sku nga srid/ da skabs phal cher zhu thag chodad pa 'dra zhes bshad pa yin/ de rjes las byed pas shodag bu dang / smyu gu zhig sprad de ngo sa len zhu yig bris dgos bshad pa ltar/ sngon du thon pa'i gnas tshul ma lus pa zhu yig thodag bris te thogeg grangs 37 tsam byung ba las byed par sprad/ de nas zla ba gsum nyin mtshan med par bsu na 'jug byas pa las zhu ba len mkhan ma byung /196

bcu mezhi/bzhi pa'i hai thu'i skyo gnas/1974 4 2༷phyi lo 1974 zla 4 tshes 20 nyin tho rengs chu tsho da gsum dang phyed ka tsam la phyi chu gas nas me lha gas kyi sgra las skad shugs che ba'i 'ur sgra zhig bstud mar grags pa'i sbrir shugs kyis btso na khang thodag bshus brgyab ste/ nam mkha'i skar ma khra thing nger mthe nga ba dang /sge'u khung gi shel lha yodangs cadags chag ste nyal chas steng zags pa ma0zad/btson khang gi sgo yang phye 'dug rdzas mdel ha cang rnying pa chags na rang bzhin 'bar gas byed kyi ye da pa'i gnas tshul thos myong0bas/ skabs der nga'i bsam blo'i thog nga tsho btson pa srung mkhan dmag mi brgya cadag gcig yod pa de'i mtshadan cha 'jug sa'i go mdzod nang 'bar gas byas 197

198 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/pa :skun naca/ /lha34/phran nyin dang por btson 'jug gis nyal khri rgyag sa'i sa cha der thog steng bkab pa'i pang leb dang / rdo bcas phung gsog thebs 'dug pas/ gzhi nas nga bsam blo zhig 'khor te gal te skabs der nga dang lnga ga bzhag sa'i sa cha der bzhag yod na da gzod/ pang leb phung gsog 'og shor nas sdug shi thebs yod pa gdodan mi za ba red/ 'on kyang skabs der btson khang kre ta'o yon bstan 'dzin nor bus yud tsam bsam blo zhig btang ste/ rgyu rkyen med par nga sgo dang sge'u khung mdun nyal sa lpo ru bcug pa ni/ chos skyong srung mas nga sdudag skyob gnang ba zhig yin pa'i tshudang tshor byung ba dang / chabs cig chos srung rnams kyi bden skyabs yod nges red bsams pa'i yid ches brtan du song / de nas ryā tshod phyed tsam song rjes nam mkhar me lce rab tu 'phyur zhing / mi mang pos ngu sgra dang skad cor shugs che rgyag pa thos/nam langs rjes tud krang padma dgon pa 'ud hrang zer ba des sge'u khung nas lta tsam byas te gang byas ma song ngam/ zhes brjod byung bas/ ngas gang yang byas ma song / zhes brjod rjes kho pa brel 'tshub ngang phyir song /btson khang gi sgo ni 'bar gas byas pa'i shugs rkyen gyis rang bzhin phye stabs nga'i bsam par de sngon srid gzhung rnying pa'i skabs nyes pa med 198

bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i skyo gnas/ 199pa'i mir ma nyes kha gasku/ga 'khel nas rkub la rta lcag gzhu skabs/ rta lcag rang bzhin chad pa'i gnas tshul yong gi yod pa go thos byung ba bzhin/da res nga nyes pa med par 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas tsang btson khang sgo yang rang bzhin phye ba red/ snyam pa'i tshor snang byung / 'on kyang 'bar gas byas pa'i zhib phra'i dodan rkyen shes kyi mi 'dug de nas nga tsho btson 'jug byas pa'i star pa der khang mig bdun tsam yod pa'i nang btson pa kong po ba smin gling zla mchog zer ba zhig dang / de min hin rdu'i gsang myul red zer ba'i mi gnyis 'dug pa kho tsho gsum la rkang lcags brgyab 'dugalo de'i phyi zla 4 tshes 22 nyin dgong dro kha lag bzas rjes las byed badma rig 'dzin yong ste rkang lcags rtsa yod chen po zhig dang / lcags kyi tho ba dang lcags kam bcas 'khyer yong ste blo yon khyod mar don shog zer bshad de/ btson rogs rgya lug la bkod pa btang ste nga la rkang lcags brgyab bcug byung / rgya lug ni de sdon btson khang nang phan tshun phran bu rgyus mnga' yod pa zhig yin stabs/ kho sa nga la lcags rgyag rgyur ha cang 'tsher snang gis tho ba gcig gzhus te nga'i gdong la lta tsam byas te ya nga ba'i rnam 'gyur shugs che ston/ nga rgya lug la snying rje skyes nas kho par tud krang gis gshe gshe rag yong bsams nas 199

2༷༷ nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/nga la ya nga byed mi dbo sa/ gal te nga la bkodad pa btang yang lcags brgyag rgyu red ma gasnodags thabs shes med/ the tsho ma ma byed/ mkhyedags wa sgyu bas zhes bshad nas rkang lcags brgyab tshar rjes yar langs skabs go ma balha da ma thub pa ma zad/ rkang par rma lam seng bakhrodas/ bsgu na ro/gas lag lcags med pa gzhan gsum lnga der0lag lcags brgyab/ smin gling zla mchodag la lag0lcags dgong sa gcig brgyab rjes de'i sang nyin bkrol 'dugaskabs der bcartan khang de'i nang rkang lcags lag lcags gnyis ka sku da pa'i nga chod mi gsum dang / rkang lcags sku da pa mi gcig bcas bstodams lcags yod pa btson pa mi bzhi yod/ de nas btson khang re re byas te sgo dang /sge'u khung / the ga se gas gang sar bakhrod bce sa brgyabs nas btso na khang btsan du btang ba dang / nyin shas song rjes btson khang nang khrag gi zos pa'i stod thung dang / gyon gos khag gcig btson pa tsor 'khru ru 'jug rgyur 'khyer 'dug pa btson khang gi sge'u khung nas masgong byung /sems bzang can gyi khyod mthun ma byan des nga la0yid ches kyis da res byung ba'i tshabs che'i don skor gsang ba'i thog nas gsungs byung ba ste/ yud kre kru'u kho bros gyol du song 'dug kho pas zhing ra'i mdzod khang nang rjas do mang po yod pa de tsor 'bar rdzas bzhag pa red/ tud krang matso mo'i phru gu bu gnyis dang / tshe bsam kan se'i bza' zla g.yu 200

bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i skyed gnas/ naX1sgron dang phru gu bu mo de mnyam du shi 'dug tshe bsam dang mazo mo gnyis rmas skyon shor te sman khang du bskyal yod pa 'dra/ gang ltar da res mi bcu gcig shi ba dang / mi kha shas rmas skyon byung zhing / khang pa dang /mo ṭa mang po gtor bshig phyin/ da lta yud kre kru'u kho 'dzin bzung 'phol zhib byed par dmag mi dang las byed rnams nyin mtshan med par 'che la bar 'gro yi 'dug ces gsungs stabs/ phyi'i gnas tshul rags tsam shes rtogs byung ba ma zad/ khong gis nga la rkang lcags la dkris byed kyi dge 'dun pa'i sku gzan thab tshang gi thab phyis byed rgyur sprad pa nas lheb tsam zhig gnang byung ba/ thab phyis gzan de rkang lcags la dkris pa yin//'on kyang rkang lcags la dkris pa'i zan dmar sus sprad byung zhes dri ba sku nga dodags kyis nga rang gi nyal go sa lnga khebs nas nang sha phran bu dbral ste rkang lcags la dkris rjes gom bgrod bde po dang / rkang par rma ma bzos par phan the gas chen po byung /skabs der nga'i bsam par las 'bras ni masgyu gas wa de 'dra smin pa dang / ya nga med pa'i mi de tshor chos skyong srung mas bka' chad gnang bar ngos 'dzin byas pa yin/ yud kre kru'u zer ba'i rgya mi de de sdon nga cho mnyam du las ka byed myong zhing / kho pa lo chung la gang 'tshams stobs shugs che ba'i mi zhig yin pa dang / kho pa btson du tshud dgos pa'i nag 201

202 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/nyes gzhan gyi rgyu dngo sa kha bslus brgyab cing tshul min gyi nag nyes bsags pa zhig red/ rjes su kho pa khrims gcod 'o/ tshad gtsang nas nga tsho las mi'i nang yod cing / phran bce na khang nang thengs gnyis pa tshud nas zla gnyis tsam song rjes yud kre kru'u kho 'dzin bzung btson 'jug thengs gnyis pa byas te/ btson khang nang slebs byung yang kho par rkang lcags lag lcags brgyab mi 'dug kho pa nga chod sdod sa'i bce na khang star pa der btson 'jug byas/ skabs de'i kho pa'i gnas tshul rnams zhib phra zhus na yig sgyu ba la bsams nas zhib phra bkod med kyang / khos baXges pa'i bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i skyo gnas zer ba'i gnas tshul gsan 'dod yod na phran la bka' 'dri gnang tshe zhu 'dodad yod/yud kre kru'u yis bzos pa'i tshabs che'i don rkyen de phyi zla 4tshes 20 nyin byung stabs rgya gzhung gis bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i skyo gnas zer gyi yod/ skabs shig ring mi tshang ma ha las hon thor dgos pa'i zang zing gi skyo gnas zer ba de phran tsam nying 'jags byung rjes/ btson khang nang gi btson pa dmangs la da res bzhi pa'i nyi shu nyin mi ngan yud kri kru'u yi gtor bshig gi tshabs che'i spyod ngan spel ba'i gnad don la/khyod sa lta stangs bsam tshul legs nyes ji byung tang gi srid jus la yid ches kyis gsal po cadad dgos pa'i las 'gul spel yang / phran 202

bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i skyo gnas/ 203las 'gul der zhugs dgos ma byung / 'on kyang nga bcug sa'i btson khang kyi sge khung mdun du btson pa tshor tshogs chung khag bgos byas te/tshogs chung re'i nang mi re slangs 'dug pa de'i nang de snga nga tsho yun ring rnga chen btson khang dang / snye thang / phreng ring / 'phan po/ spo bo gsum 'dzoms bcas bsnyu na khang khag nang 'dris gshib myong pa'i btson grogs rang lo 50 tsam son pa'i 'phan po ba tshe ring dpal 'gyor zer ba yar slangs te/ khos zhi pa'i nyi shu'i don rkyen de a mi re kas gnam gru'i nang nas bzo grwar sbom dbyugs pa red/ ltos dang nam mkhar gnam gru 'gro yi mi 'dug gam/ da nga chod yar langs dgos pa'i dus la slebs pa red/ ces gzhan la ngan skul byas lugs skyon 'dzugs kyis bkyigs rdung drag po gtong gi 'dugaskabs der 'bar gas byas pa'i sbir sgras btson khang gi thog bshus brgyab yod stabs nam mkhar me lce rab tu 'phyur ba'i khrod du shog bu mes tshigs te nam mkhar bskyod par/ lta phyogs shig la gnam gru 'dra po ngas kyang mthong byung / de dang 'dra ba'i tshogs chung so so'i nang mi re gnyis bslangs te bkyigs rdung byas te nyin mang por a ra u ru'i ngu skad kyi sgra sgrog pa'i khrod du da dung ma yin yin mdog gi kha gsal la gu yangs dang / sbas skung la drag gnon zer ba mo gas kyi 'bod sgra 203

2༷4 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang bcad sbyang byung ba/ sgrogs pa dang don du 'thab rtsod kyi gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu'i nang btson pa sku ngas rdzogs dngangs skrag dang / 'jigs snang kho na'i 'og nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i dmyal ba gson myong byed dgos byung / lhag par du mi rgan bkyigs rdung gis na zug ma bzod par skad ngan ngu 'bod byed skabs/glang gog smyon pa'i skad sgra lta bu zhig thos dus mi gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ya nga sems sdug chen po byung / btso na 'jug byas pa'i btso na pa tsho'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes btsan 'phro ga dang bza' mi bu phrug dang kha bral btang ba ma zad/ da dung kho tsho ra btson khang nang mi chodas las sku ngas su 'das pa'i mnar gcod tshad med pa dang / rgyun gtan btso na pa tsho ra dud 'bo las zhan pa'i mthe nga chung dang / gnya' gnyo na bshu gazlo ga gis dka' sdug nyin nas zla ba skyel dbo sa pa dang zla bas 'o/ skyel dbo sa pa/ 'o/ nas lo skyel dgo sa pa'i rdzogs mtha' med pa'i sdug tshe skyel dgo sa stabs bce na pa tshang ma'i lus po'i gnas stangs nyam thag pa zhig sku da kyang / da dung lta srung dmag gis btson khang phyi nang du ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byed skabs/ phran bu 'ahro nyes sde da nyes byung na 'dzam gling spyi khrims las 'gal ba'i khrims gcod gtong stangs ni/ rkang rjen mar rdo'i steng shing gi bya gdang lta bu bzos te yun ring bsngangs bzhag stabs na zug ma bzod par/ sa la bab na mabo wa ra dbyug pa gzhu bar sku nga skabs lag 204

bzhi pa'i nyi shu'i skyo gnas/ 2༷5pas kha mig rang srung byed pa'i byed stangs rnam 'gyur 'dra min the na dus/'dre dmag de tso dgod bro ba bcas mi'i las dbang la rtse mo rtsed pa sogs byed kyi ye da kyang / gnam 'og pho rog ni tshang ma nag po yin tsang su la'ang bde sdug shod sa med par sdug skum mi rgyag ka med red//205

bces lja/༷/ thu gc-ig bonas sems 'du/la thebs nas shig chu shor ba/phran nas nyin ltar rang gis rang la slob gso dang skul lcag byed thabs ni rang nyid kyi mdun gnad dodan mang po thag gcod byed rgyu yod kyang / ches rtsa bar gyur ba'i gnad don gang la dam 'dzin byed dgos she na/ gzhi 'dzin rtsa don bzhi po des rang nyid kyi bsam slor slob gso rgyag rgyu der dka' spyad kyi dam 'dzin bya rgyur shugs snon rgyag dbo sa pa red/ gnad don der dam 'dzin lhod med byed thub na bsam blo'i thog ngos 'dzin gsal du 'gro ba dang / bya spyod thog yang dag po'i bkod 'doms byed thub pa dang /gal te gnad don der dam 'dzin bya rgyu dang kha bral na/ gnad don gzhan thog //gas ga tshad brgyab pa dang / rngul

ku shu gcig gis sems 'gul thebs nas mig chu shor ba 207nag ga tshod bton na'ang 'bras bu yag po thob mi thub pa ma zad/ tha na kha phyogs kyang nor srid pa'i myong tshor byung ba bzhin bsam blo'i slob gsor dam 'dzin byas te der g.yengs nas sdod skabs/ slo bur du nga'i pang kha'i nang du rdob ces cig g.yugs byung ba de ni ku shu zhig red/ ku shu de gaX༅gas mkhan su yin nam snyam nas mkhyedags po sge'u khung nas lta skabs mi gzhan su yang mi 'dug yangs can nor bu zer ba'i btson pa rgas snga zhig yod pa de goms pa kha shas sar slebs 'dug rgas pos phyi mig lta tsam byas te ku shu g.yugs yod mdog mdog gi rnam 'aglur bstan byung /skabs der nga'i bsam blo'i nang pha ma spun mched dang bza' zla bu phrug dge rgan dge phrug grogs po blos thub yin na'ang phan dza/na gcig gis gcig la yid rton mi phod pa'i nyen kha dang / dza drag che la do dam pa'i khor sdig de 'dra zhig gi nang rgas po des so so'i bde nyen la ma ltos par/gdung sems mnyam skyed dang / sha tsha snying rje/ yid ches blos 'gel gyis ku shu de sprad pa zhig yin stabs nga la sems 'gul thebs nas mig chu rang dbang med par shor ba dang chabs cig nga'i bsam par btson lha gas tshos 'jigs snang dza drag do dam 'di lta bu'i 'og tu'ang nga la gdung sems dang /sha tsha snying rje/ yid ches blos 'gel byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni rang gis 207

208 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/da phan lo mang yun ring 'thab rtsod kyi drag char rlung 'tshub nang kha phyogs dang / skyabs yul ma nor bar yang dag pa'i lta ba dang langs phyogs brtan tsam byed thub pa la brten nas byung ba red bsams nas rtsa sngagen mtha' 'aX ngas dang dka' khri khyad bsad kyi mdun bskyod bya rgyur skul ma shugs che thebs byung / rkang lcags kyis rkang par rma bakhrodas thodag gzugs ngo yongs sngo gas na nas 'gro bskyod bya rgyur dka' ngal che stabs/ snga dbo nga gsang spyod la chab gcin thengs re gtong gi yod rung gom bgrod byed ma thub par bdun phrag gnyis tsam gsang spyod la ma phyin tsang / btson khang gi sgo lcags la sdom thag mang snga btang 'dug nyin zhig batho na khang nang em chi dbang rgyal (phyis rgya gar du phebs nas bla sman pa gnang /) lags gzigs par phebs nas nga la rkang lcags lag lcags gnyis ka brgyab ste gnas stangs nyam thag pa'i rang bzhin gzigs stabs/ thugs skyo snang che mdodag gis lus wa ra brtag dpyad sman bathe sa gang legs gnang bas nad gzhi maX gas lnga drag skyed byung //phyi lo 1974 zla 9 tshes 14 nyin krang kre taso/ yon zer ba'i rgya mi de btson khang sgo lcags phye res 'khel 'dug cing / kho pas nga'i lag lcags bkrol te btson khang sgo rtsar nga tsho lcags yod pa rnams gyon gos brje len dang / khrus rgyag bcug byung / de nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod 4208

ku shu gcig gis sems 'gul thebs nas mig chu cadar ba 209tsam bar nyi ma bsro ru bcug byung zhing / de rjes btson khang nang bcug skabs lag lcags ma brgyab par kho pa phyir log song zhing / skabs der nga'i bsam par kho pas lag lcags rgyag rgyu brjed song snyam zhing / sge'u khung nas lta skabs lag lcags de sge'u khung gi phyir bzhag 'dugayun de'i ring lus ngal ba dang sems kyi sdug bsngal zung gis lus po yongs rdzogs sha skam pags skam song nas lag lcags rang bzhin gyi bud kyi 'dug pas/ skabs re dgong dro lag lcags ya gcig phud nas nyal ba dang / gnyid khug rjes lag lcags yod med khyad par med pa lta bu zhig 'dug pas/ skabs re lag lcags khyodan nas bsdad na sngon bsags/ las ngan sdig sgrib dag che ba mi yong ngam snyam pa dang / dgong dro nam phyed mtshams su rkang lcags lag lcags la zhib bsher byed pa'i las byed pas lag lcags phud pa shes na lag lcags rgyab tu brgyab pa'am/ yang na lag lcags dam du btang yong snyam nas lag lcags gyon nas sdod kyi yod/ lo 'di'i zla 9 tshes 16 nyin zhogs pa btson khang sgo lcags phye res las byed bag gros btson khang nang yong nas de ring khyod tshor gal ha cang che ba'i bka' slob cig khyab bsgrags gnang gi red/ khyod rang yang btson pa gzhan dang spyi mtshungs tshogs 'dur 'gro dgos kyi red ces bshad/ nga'i bsam par da yang drag gnon byed yas kyi khyab bsgrags shig yin gyi red bsam byung 209

210 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ba las de min re ba med/ de nas snga dro'i chu tshod 9 tsam la btson pa yongs jo gas dang / batho na khang gi las byed che phra sku ngas sgyu gas kyis cho gas chen sar nga tsho lcags yod pa'i btson pa tsho'ang 'khrid de nga tso lcags yod pa'i batho na pa chod dang / btson pa dmangs bar khyad bo ma pa gnyis tsam sar bang sgrig nas bzhag byung / da sdug pa gang shod grabs yod dam snyam nas sdod skabs rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs ritang nang gi ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa'i gras su rtsis te/ gnas dbyung btang ba'i sog po mi rigs du'u khrang khrang gis rnam 'gyur zhi dul ngang yong ba dang /de bzhin las byed tsho 'ang nam rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i ngo gnong zhig 'dug pas gang yin nam snyam pa'i mur/ du'u khrang khrang nas da res khyo/ da chor gal ha cang che ba'i bka' cesab cig gsal bsgrags bya rgyu yin zhes bshad ma thagasngo da rigs las byed phun tshogs rgyal wa sa skad bsgyur ba/ bka' slob de'i 'go brjod du hpha shi si'i zhib bsher byed stangs dor dgos zer ba de red/zhib phra'i nang don ni nye char kra'o tsung lis btson khang khag la zhib 'jug tu phebs te hpha shi si'i zhib bsher byed stangs dor dgos lugs kyi gnad ro/na rnams ma'o kru'u zhir snyan seng gis chog mchan phebs gnang ba zhig red/de sngon bcug bzung byas pa'i nyes can rnams la lus thog nyes rdung drag po gtong ba dang / sdug wa gto/nga ba'i byed stangs de chod gtan nas mi 'grigs 210

ku sdo/ gcig gis sems 'gul thebs nas mig rnayi lha ra ba 211pa zhig red/ de sngon nga tsho'i do dam las byed pas srid jus de dang 'gal ba'i nor 'khrul byung sku da pas nga tshos ngos len bya rgyu dang / slad srid jus de dang 'gal ba'i nor 'khrul las byed tshos byas tshe khyod tshos zhu drang byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ ma'o kru'u zhis 1942 lor nyes pa shor ba'i mi gang 'dra zhig yin na'ang / kho tshor snga bslab phyi sdom dang nad bcos sku ga skyob kyi spyod tshul bzung nas kho tsho sgyur bskadad byas te mi gsar pa zhig sku nga ba byed dgos/ zhes gsungs yod/yang / ma'o kru'u zhis rgyugs pa gzhu thengs gcig la mi gsod pa'i thabs shes lag len byed rgyu med ces bka' slob gnang myong sku da/ khyod tshos chod bde bag phebs ngang bsam blo'i sgyur bkod byas te mi gsar pa zhig tu bsgyur thub pa'i 'bad bce na byed dgos zer gsal bsgrags byas ma thagabatson pa chodas macad kru'u zhi khri 'i ra brtan pa shog ces 'bod sgra shugs che sgrog skabs bathongan khang las byed pa'i rgyugs khyi spyan gsal dang / hūr bce na byas te bathodan tshopa nang khul rdung rdeg galta nga mkhan de tsho'i gras lhag par sems shugs che maro/ga gi skad 'awa da byed kyi 'dug nam rgyun btson pa chodar mthodang chung sdang zug byed mkhan gyi las byed de tsho ngo gdong dmar por gyur ba dang /ha cang ngo gnong po byung song / skabs der nga rang rang bzhin gyi dga' skyo gnyis kyi mchi ma sna ra ba dang / da ni 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs 211

212 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rje'i 'od zer mi yul gyi dmyal khams der 'phros nas rang nyid srog nyen las thar te mdun lam la gzhi nas re ba gsar pa zhig byung / bsgu na khang nang yang dzamags chen gyi gnas tshul rnams bsam sduge 'khor te nam rgyun ba〉rgan pa hur bce na can tsho'i rnam 'gyur la bltas na/ bce na pas bce na par nyes rdung gtong 'dod med pa'i gnas tshul shes rtogs byung la/ de nas bzung btson khang nang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i gnas tshul spyir btang med pa lta bu zhig zu3gas/nyin shas rjes su zhu ba len par 'khrid byung bas sngon nga la dri ba byed sa'i khang chung de 'bar gas kyi shugs rkyen phog ste shul med du gyur ba mthong skabs/ chodas skyodang srung mas nga la rgyab rtsa dngos 'brel gnang gi yod par yid ches rnyed byung de nas ngas sprad pa'i zhu yig dang /stag lung ba go chas gsang skyel byas pa'i ngan dodar bzang blangs kyi cha rkyen gsum la dgag yig bris pa de dang / nyin deb/ rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan phyag dpe 7rgyal ba lnga pa'i na bza'/ ma he sa tsha bcas re re bzhin mig bstan nas de dzam rang gi yin nam/ zhes brjod de/ shog grangs re rer snag tsha dmar pos mdzub thel rgyag tu bcug nas de dag yar bkyag skabs tshal dmar mdzub thel gyi sdig nyes che mdog kha ba'i yig cha 'jigs su rung ba lta bu zhig bajo sa 'dug de rjes zla 11 pa'i nang dgong mo zhig mig gasku/na pa 'phag 212

ku shu gcig gis sems 'gul thebs nas mig chu lha ra ba 213'phag byed bzhin 'dug pas nam rgyun mig g.yon pa 'phags na/ grog cig yong ba'i snga ltas lta bu yin pa ltar/ dgong dro'i btson lto bzas rjes tud krang padma rig 'dzin gyis skad shugs chen pos lcags bzo ba rgya lug rgyang 'bod byas te/ tho ba dang / skam pa 'khyer shog ces brjod pa dang / btson khang gi sgo phye nas nga yang mar don shog ces 'bod de rgya lug la nga'i rkang lcags bkrol bcug de nas bo ma pa lha skabs nam rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i yang shig shig brjod dka' ba zhig yong gi 'dug de rjes nyin mo chu chodad gnyis tsam ma byan gyi shing gshags gro gas btang byung / ma byan snu sa las byed med pa'i dbar la thab tshang nang skad btang ste gdung sems mnyam skyed kyis ja dang / lto chas dmigs bsal bajo sa te gnang gi 'dug nyin zhig nga tsho lcags yod pa chos bathongan khang gi 'gram du nyi ma bsros bcug ste bzhag byung / de nas du'u khrang khrang gis tud krang padma rig 'dzin 'khrid yong nas las mi su red dam/ zhes brjod mur/ khong gnyis nga'i 'gram du yong ste padma rig 'dzin nas 'di red/ ces ngo sprod byas/ nga la kho pas bltas nas lo chung chung red/ lo ga tshod yin nam/ dris byung bas lo nyi shu rtsa dgu yin zhes bcadad/ du'u khrang khrang gis rnam 'gyur zhi ba'i thodag nas rjes su ngal rtsodal yag po byed dgos/ zhes sna da pa tsam las bsam blo'i sgyur bkod skor ma bshad par btson khang gzhan la lta bsnyadar du phyin/ btson 213

214 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rogs smin gling zla mchodag gis khrang khrang gis sna da stangs la dpags na/ khyed rang slod bkrol gtong bzo 'dug ces gsang ba'i ngang nas bshad/lo 'di'i zla 12 tshes 23 nyin thang ka'an si dang / rgya mi krang kre ta'o sku na/ skad sgyur tud krang phun chodags rgyal po bcas sku nga nas khyod rang lo gcig tsam gnas tshul ngos len byas pa spyir btang yag sngo/ byung yod/ der brten tang dang mi mang srid gzhung gis srid jus lag len byas te slod rgyu yin/ de sngon khyod ru khag gang du yin yang der phyir log byed dgos/ khyodad kyi gla 'o/gas thad bsgu na khang nang dus chodad ga tshod bsdad yod kyang de'i ring khyod rang gi nam rgyun gla phogs gang yod pa de phyir slog bya rgyu dang / de nas btson khang nang sdod ring gi to gla gcog 'then bya rgyu red/gal te da dung gnas tshul gsar pa lnga sa len zhu rgyu sku da na/ mu mthud zhu chog gi red/ khyodad la zhing ra'i las khungs nas thugs 'khur dang re ba chen po gnang gi yod/ 'tsho ba dang gyon gos thog dka' ngal dang re ba gang yod na'ang ru khag tud krang brgyud zhus na 'grigs kyi red la/ thad kar zhing ra'i las khungs la yong na'ang 'grigs kyi red ces rnam 'gyur legs 'jam gyi lnga ga nas bshad/214

bcu drugabatsen nas hphod 'grol metang ba/phyi lo 973zla 2tshes 26nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod bzhi pa tsam la nga tsho'i ru khag gi thad ka'i 'go khrid kre ta'o yodan bsod nams rdo rje dang /tud krang rig 'dzin gnyis yong nas blo yon nyal chas sgril dbo sa/ zhes bshad pa ltar/ nyal chas bsgril te bcesan khang nas thon skabs kre ta'o yon bsod nams rdo rje dang / tud krang rig 'dzinaganyis nas kyang nyal go sa cha shas 'khyer rogs byas byung / de nas thad kar shing gcod las yul du ma btang bar zhing ra'i las khungs kyi nye 'gram du yod pa'i las mi lag shes pa chorware kho ngas su mi khag gcig zhwa mo phud nas spyi 'bangs gcig gyur yin/ zer ba'i gras mi gnyis kyi nyal khri'i dbar la nyal sa gra sgrig byas 'dug pa der bzhag byung / glo da

216 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/'grol thob ma thag lha sar gcung mo rig pad lags su 1973 zla 12tshes 26 nyin nga glod 'grol thob ste sngar bzhin las mi'i kho ngas yod pas/ gcen gcung tsho thugs bde wa ra bzhugs rogs gnang zhes 'kho da pa'i yi ge zhig sbrag brgyud btang / rjes su las mi rin chen thub dbang lags lha sar 'khor zhag 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel 'dug pas/ khong gis phran la nang du spun mched tshor yi ge yod na ngas dam dodan gyis khungs su phul chog ces gsungs pa ltar/ gong bzhin nang don 'khod pa'i yi ge zhig bskur/rin chen thub dbang lags 'khor zhag nas phyir log skabs spun mched tshos yi ge dang rngan pa bskur ba phran la gnang ba dang / spun mched rnams bde po yin pa/ khong sbed sgrig hrūng khang gcen mo chos 'dzoms lags sar slebs ma thag gcen mo sa bu chod yon lags gang byas mo nga ngam/zhes dris/ khong gis phran lo gcig tsam 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas kyang nye lam sgru da 'grol thodab tshul gsungs kyang / gcen mos yid ma ches par gnas 'phrin sku zla ye shes bsod nams lags su phul ba kho nga gis gzigs rjes dngos gnas slod 'grol thob 'dug slo yon lags kyi yig gzugs red/ ces gsungs song bas gzhi nas a cag lags yid ches nas ha cang dga' po byung ste/ nga gcung mo rig pad lags 216

btson nas slod 'grol btang ba/ 317sar khyod rang gis bsnams pa'i gnas tshul rnams sna da par 'gro yi yin/thugs lhod por bzhugs rogs/ gsungs nas phyir phebs pa'i khang pa'i rdo skas bab skabs gcung mo rig pad lags kyis sbrag brgyud bskur ba'i yi ge de 'khyer nas gcen po'i yi ge slebs byung zhes/ gsungs par/a cag lags kyis yi ge las lhag pa'i mi 'dir slebs so/ zhes gsung res kyis khong gnyis phan tshun dga' ngu shor nas 'tham 'khyud gnang ba'i gnas tshul byung song bas/ khong yang sems skyod nas mig chu dbang med shor lugs lha ra gnas tshul gsal bshad byung skabs/ phran yang sems skyo zhing spun mched kyi brtse sems sngar bas je cher song /phyi zla 12 tshes 29 nyin ru khag drug gi las mi yongs rdzogs bzo grwar tshogs chen bskongs te/ lo re'i 'char can gyi dgun dus slob sbyong gi rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi dus bab bzang po dang /tang gi srid jus skor sogs slob 'khrid byed srol yod pa ltar byas song /de nyin ru khag khag nang yod pa'i las mi tshos nga glod 'grol btang ba'i gnas tshul lnga sa stabs/ tshang mas nga la do snang gis dga' skyo gnyis 'dres kyi rnam 'gyur bstan zhing / ru khag so so'i nang nga dang 'brel gtug mi chog pa'i bka' btang yod 'dug pas kho tshos nga dang 'phrad mi phod pa dang / res gza' nyi ma'i gung seng la tshong khang du nyo cha rgyag par 'gro 217

na18 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/skabs nga'i rjes su lkog lta byed mkhan gtong gi 'duganyin zhig nga gzugs po 'khrud skabs sha skam lpags skam dur khro/ da bdag po lta bu'i gzugs po'i gnas stangs mi kha shas kyi mthong skabs gzugs po ha cang skyod po chags 'dug ces ha las shing / kho tshos mar rgya ma gang tsam dang / phag kring re gnyis tsam dang / dngul sgor lnga dang bcu tsam brtse ba chen pos gsang thabs kyi sprod pa'i thog lo gcig tsam btson 'jug byed ring 'tsho dod gcog bya byas te/ de byings zla re'i gla phogs phyir slog gis rgya lha/ra 150 tsam sprad stabs/ gnas skabs 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal sel nas gzugs wa rim bzhin mo sa/ nam rgyun nga'i tshogs chung gcig pa rwa sgreng ba tshe ring rdo rjes yi ge bris rogs la kha g.yar te/ nga thug par sku nga nas mar rgya ma gang tsam dang rgya sgor 10sprad de mig chu 'kho ra bzhin du daskadan mchog gis gzigs nas khyod rang tshe thar song / nga tshor yang khyod rang dang 'brel ba gang yod ces mtha' bkag mang po btang / nga tshos skabs der khyed rang srog thog btang mi yong ngam snyam pa'i zas bcud gnyid bral gyi sems khral chen po byung /khyod rang btson khang du skyel mkhan go cha red/ kho yang rang gis rkang par rang gis sta re gzhus te rmas skyon phog nas sman khang la sdod dgo sa byung ba dang / sman khang nas kho pa'i rkang pa'i mdzub mo gcig gtubs nas 218

btso na nas gle da 'asgo la btang ba/ 219dbang sngo ma tshang ba chags sku/da/ las mi tshang mas las 'bras smin rgyu yod thag chod red/ ces brjod mkhan sha stag red ces bshad stabs nga btson du skyel mkhan bo cha yin pa shes rtogs rags tsam byung /las rogs blo mthun tshos sems 'khur byed stangs kyis nga la sems 'gul chen po thebs byung / rang nyid skabs der lus po'i gnasaci stangs skyo ba dang / gang byung 'gro bskyod mi chog pa/ gzhan dang 'brel ba byed mi chog pa'i bkag 'ange mas 'og gnas yod kyang / 'das pa'i lo gcig gi 'thab ce da brgyud rim la bsam blo galta nga bzhin rtsa don mtha' 'khyongs byed thub pa'i thog nas glod 'grol thob pa'i rgyal khar dga' spro dang / spobs pa shugs che skye ba zhig byung ste lus po'i gnas stangs zhan yang sems nang bde skyid zad mi shes pa zhig yong gi 'dug de nas sne gcig gis khyon yongs 'khrid/ ces pa'i slob sbyong las 'gul dmigs bsal zhig spel pa'i nang ru khag so so'i nang gi nam rgyun kho pa tsho'i kha lor mi 'bo ba'i mi rnams dbye 'byed byas pa'i nang slo mthun blo bzang tshe brtan yang 'dug mi bco lnga re yodad pa'i tshogs chung khag gsum bzos shing / nyin re slob sbyong nyin phyed dang / ngal rtsol nyin phyed kyis las phyed slob phyed zer ba zla gcig lhag tsam bzhag slob sbyong bya rim de'i nang rang gzhan su la'ang 'thab rtsod byed pa'i gnas tshul byung ma song de 219

220 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rjes las byed pas khyod la gyon gos dang las ka'i thog dka' ngal re ba gang sku da kyang nga tshor bshad na gong rim la snyan seng zhu yi yin/ bzo grwa nas khyod la thugs 'khur gnang 'dod yod lugs yang yang bshad kyang skabs der nga'i bsam blo'i thog dpal 'gyor sogs kyi bslu 'brid byed kyi 'dug bsams nas nga la dka' ngal gang yang med/ thugs 'khur gnang ba bkrin che zhes bshad de kho pa tshor re ba gang yang bton med tsang / kho tsho ngo tsha kha skyengs dang khong khro langs pa lta bu byas song /de nas sngar bzhin shing gcod las yul du rang 'jags btang byung / mi khag gcig lnga log zing 'khrug gam log spyod pa'i zhwa mo phud yod pa dang / las rogs tshang mar che chung rin pa mtho dma' ma gtogs gla phogs spar cha byas te/ gla sgyu gas rim pa dang por rgya sgor 48 dang / rim pa dma' cadas zhing las rim pa bzhi pa zer ba bzos nas rgya sgor 35 tsam 'dug nga'i gla cha ma spar bar sngar bzhin rgya lha ra 23 rang 'jags su zla drug tsam bzhag cing / las ka ni a sku nga ye shes zer ba'i gzugs stobs che la nus shugs gang tsam yod mkhan/ las kar rgyab mdun med par hur bce na byed mkhan/ las byed par ngo dga' sprel lad 'khrab thub mkhan zhig yod pa de dang lag sbrel byas te sdudag le rgyag par btang stabs kho pas ngal gso gtan nas ma brgyab 220

btson nas slod 'ahrol btang ba/ 221pas/ dka' ngal ha cang chen po byung / nyin zhig shing sdong gcig dum rgyag phyo gas thoog ngas kho pa'i kha la ma nyan tsang kho sa nga la rnom 'gyuor ngon pa bstan pa sags byas byung bas/ nga 'u thug nas bsam bla mang pa gtang yas med/ ces bshad de shing gcod sta re de len par phyin pas/ ye shes skad shor nas slo yon khos nga gsod par yong gi 'dug ces skad ngan shugs che brgyab par brten g.yas g.yon du sku da pa'i las rogs chotsho shing nags khrod nas sku nga ste bar 'dum byas shing / ye shes las yul nas thad kar bzo grwa'i 'go khrid kyi sar song nas slo yon gyis gsod par yong gi 'dug ces snyan seng zhus/ nga'i bsam par phal cher bzo grwar nga skad 'bod byed kyi red snyam nas phran bu blo mi bde ba byung yang de'i dgong dro yud tud krang zer ba'i rgya mi zhig yod pa des/ kho pa'i las shag tu ye shes nga gnyis skad btang nas da res byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams 'dri rtsad byas mthar/ sang nyin nas khyod gnyis mnyam du 'gro dang mi 'gro dris par ye shes kyis kho dang mnyam du mi 'gro/ srog mgo thon sa ma red ces bshad/ phran la dris skabs ngas tang dang mi mang srid gzhung gi bka' bzhin byed kyi yin zhes bshad par sang nyin nas las mo gas blo bzang lags zer ba'i mnyam du btang bzhin/ khong ni nga tsho blo mthun zhig yin stabs las ka ha cang las sla ru song /221

222 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/de'i sang nyin phran bzo grwa'i las khungs sku mar shog ces gsungs kyi 'dug zer lan slebs byung bas da yang rnyedag dra gang bshad grabs sku da dam snyam byung yang / bzo grwa'i gnyer pas da res zla 7 pa de nas khyod rang gi gla cha spar nas zhing las rim pa lnga pa'i gla 'bab len chog gi red zer bshad byung / zhing las rim pa lnga par zla red sgor 45tsam 'dug de nas 'chod ba phran bu legs bce sa byung / de rjes nyin zhig blo mthun rig bsam lags nas da res ngas gtam bzang zhig 'khyer yod gsungs te/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mabo na chen po mchodag gis the da kyi lha srung rnams la gnang ba'i 'phrin bskul ma smad bsku da nams zhes pa'i phyag dpe zhig gsang thabs kyi gnang byung / de'i nang chodas srid rang dbang gtsang ma'i snang ba'i dpal// 'char bar nges so dam ldan snying ma zhum// zhes gsal 'dug pa des nga tsho'i bden dodan la ring min rgyal kha thodab pa'i yid ches snying stobs la bskul ma thebs byung bas 'phrin bskul de dad sems chen pos slo rtsegacig sgril gyis nyin shas nang slo 'dzin thub pa dang / slo mthun chodar yang gsang 'grems zhu thub/de rjes gsum bcu'i dus dran thengs 12 pa'i thog 7gong sa 7 skyabs mgon chen po'i bka' slob zhig nang / dngos dodan du bod mi che sa rgya mi rigs la ngo sga la byed kyi yod na'ang ngas ni rgya mi rigs 222

brtsan nas slod 'grol btang ba/ da2zhal 'e sdang nam yang byed mi thub/ nga'i yid ches la bod kyi rang dbang ni bod mi rnams stobs shugs chen po ra 'gyur ba'i mtshams su yong nges shing / zhe sdang ni nus shugs yin la/ nus shugs kyi ldog phyogs su gyur ba'i skyon cha zhig red/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis zhe sdang gis zhe sdang 'bo ga mi thub pa gsungs pa de yang spyir btang chodas bshad tsam du gsungs pa ma yin par/ dalnga sa yod kyi ga/ nas tshul dang bstun nas gsungs pa zhig yin/ zhe sdang gi lam nas gyub 'bras ji 'dra zhig byung yang / de ni mo ra gnas mi thub la yun ring 'chod gnas mi thub/ der ma zad/ de ni snga phyi ma gtogs slar yang dka' rnyog 'bod pa'i g.yab mo yin/ da lta'i 'char nga'i mi mang gi gnas stangs ha cang dza drag 'di 'dra'i skabs su zhe sdang byas na yid la sdug bsngal snon ma zhig ma gtogs gang yang yong mi thub/ lar nas nga tshos rang nyid ci byed nam yang mi shes pa'i mi rigs shig la zhe sdang ci phyir byed/ gang yin zer na kho snu sa kyang rang gi bden don dang rgyal khab kyi ched du dka' sdug mang po myong yod/ nged rang la zhe sdang gi lam nas don 'grub par yid ches med kyang / dus rtag tu yid ches byed pa ni nyin gcig drang bden la rgyal kha thob rgyu de red/ rgya dmag sa ya mang po sku da na'ang nga'i yid ches de 'gyur med de rang yin zhes pa dang / yang gsum bcu'i dus dran 223

224 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gyi bka' slob dum bu zhig nang / rang cag bod mi rnams kyi khrod du drang bden la brtsi bkur dang / rgan rabs la zhe sa/ dka' sdug la bzod sran/ gzhan la phan sems/ nyam chung dma' sa bzung ba se gas rang re pha mes dam pa rnams kyi mig lde sa bo mas gshis bzang wa rnams yul dus gang zhig gi nang du'ang / nyams med tshul bzhin lag bstar dbo sa/ gal te gnas skabs khe grags phra motsware slad du ma rabs tshul min gyi lam du zhugs na/ 'phya dmod byed pa smos ci smra shes don go ba'i mi rigs su skyes pa'i dgos nge na ma tshang ba yin pas tshang mas ya rabs bag skudad kyi spyodad par gzho la ba gal che/ zhes bka' cadab gnang ba rnams rang la dalnga sa byung nyams myong gi thog nas bden don zhig yin pa'i nges pa rnyed de mtha' 'khyedangs bya rgyu'i dza da sems la bskul ma thebs/224

bcu medun/zugatshige(1—rurwa〉—4—rshaha — gas ge —tsu zha ga ra' sdu(ma razang ngas pa/phyi 'o/ 976 zla 9 tshes 9nyin chu chodad klad kor thog ma'o kru'u zhi shi ba'i gtam bzang ngam ring ba slo mthun bkris dbang 'dus basbra grwar sman khang du bskyod nas shes stabs/ kho nga gis spo lta kho sdug shi thebs 'dug ces dbugs hal bzhin dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te/gsang thabs kyi nga la gsungs pa dang /de rjes rlung 'phrin nas gsal bsgrags byas/ las mi'i nang 'dzig spyod kyi zhwa snang med mkhan dza mya ngan zogs chen thog bzo grwar yong dgos zhes lan 'gyor ba ltar/ kho sa mya ngan tshogs 'dur phyin/ nga tsho'i bsam tshod ltar srid 'gyur ma byung yang /spyir btang rgya dmar gyi dbang shugs rngam zil nyam pa lta bu'i tshor snang byung / nyin shas rjes las bye2twe pas mi la las nga tsho'i rlabs chen

226 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/gce 'dzin macad kru'u zhi sku gshegs nas rgyal yongs mi dmangs tshang ma yid gdung chen rnge sa mya ngan ma sangs gong glu gzhas gastogeng mkhan yod pa red/ dper na/ 'phrin las bsam grub kyis las kar gzhas gtong gi sku da pa red/ ces blo mthun 'phrin las bsam grub chodags chung nang nyin shas bkag pa dang / sa gnas gzhan la yang mi kha shas 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas pa red/btson khang dang las mir lo ltar dus chodad zla gcig lhag tsam dgun dus slob sbyong byed bcug gi yod cing / dang thog rgyal phyi rgyal nang gi dus bab bzang po yod pa dang / btsan bzo log gsum shog bu'i stag cig yin la/ kho tsho ni 'chi la nye zhing mdun lam med pa'i stobs shugs shig dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje'i stodabs shugs ni 'dzam glong yongs su gzi 'od 'phro zhing lang tsho'i dpal yon dar bzhin pa red/ ma'o kru'u zhis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs des mthar gtugs ma rtsa'i ring lugs kyi lam lugs kyi tshab byed rgyu de ni mi rnams kyis rang nyid kyi 'dod blo ltar bsgyur mi thub pa'i phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid cig red/ log spyod phyogs khag gi lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo mdun bskyod bya rgyu de bkag 'gog byed thabs gang 'dra zhig byas rung /gsar brje ni dus tshod snga phyir ma gtogs langs nges yin pa ma zad/226

ma'o kru'u zhi shi ba'i gtam bzang thos pa 227rgyal kha'ang thodab nges yin zhesnga bka' slob gnang yod/ma'o kru'u zhi'i bka' slob ni tshan rig gi chod gtam zhig dang /bka' slob tshig 'byu re re nas bden don gyi gzi 'od 'phro yi mo da/ mchod thog bskyod na gru par bsden dgos/ skyes dngos 'tshar 'o/ngas nyi mar brten dgos/ gsar brje byed par ma'o tse tung gi dgongs par rten dgos/ der brten ma'o kru'u zhi'i rtsa ba'i gsung rtsom gsum dang de min gsung rtsom dang gsung btus khag dngos sprod dang / 'phral mkho ྅ na sbyong gzugs langs grib thon byed dgos pa ma zad/ gsar brje'i khru gzhas phru ba sbyong byas te gtong shes pa byed dgos/ zhes pa sogs btsan bskul byas te ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom blo 'dzin byed du bcug gsar brje'i glu gzhas spyi tshogs ring lugs bzang zer ba dang / shar phyogs nas nyi ma dmar po shar/ zhes pa sogs nyin ltar nyin re'i kha 'don ltar snga dgong dang / las kar 'gro skabs btsan shed kyi gtong bcug bi yod/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom dang / gsar brje'i glu gzhas zer ba nga mo lo chung tshor blo 'dzin bya rgyur dka' ngal cher med kyang / lo na rgan rabs tsho rdzi rdibs stabs slo 'dzin byed mi thub pa'i sems khral dang / dka' ngal snon ma lta bu yong gi yod/ skabs 'gar tshogs chung dang cho gas chen thog btson grogs rgas sngo re gnyis bslangs nas gsung 227

228 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/rtsom dang gsar brje'i glu gzhas rgyugs len byed skabs/ ya nga dgo da bro ba'i gnas tshul 'dra min sku nga / gal te gsung rtsom dang gsar brje'i glu gzhas rgyugs mi 'phrod pa byung na/ 'jig rten lta bar sgyur bkodad dang gsar brje byed mi 'dod pa'i rtags mtshan red zer ba dang / yang na klad rnying mkhregs bzung dang log spyod bsam slo sgyur bkod gtong 'asnga da med tshul mo gas snyad 'aro/gas kyis chosags chen mdun bslangs nas bzhag pa/ lhag par ma'o/ kru'u zhi'i gsung ce ma ngag skyodar sgra dag gsal gsum ma byung bar tshig lhad dang / nor 'khrul lta bu byung na ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom 'khyog bshad dang g.yo bcos byas pa red/ ces bshad nas zhwa mo chen ngo gasku1ga pa dper na/ byang nag chu ba yin pa'i dgra 'dul zer ba'i mi rgan zhig yod pa de la rgya las krang kre ta'o/ sku na gyis dbo nga dro'i btso na pa tshang bsher gyi ming thod skru ga skabs/ btso na pa dmangs kyi mdun du bslangs te brdzod don/ dgra 'dul khyod kyis ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung btus nas dum bu gcig ngag skyor byed dbo sa zhes brjod pa ltar/ma'o kru'u zhis mi mang gi dmag dpung zhig med na/ mi mang la gang yang thob mi thub zer ba'i tshab tu dgra 'dul gyis ma'o kru'u zhis gsung dodan/mi mang gis dmag dpung gcig med na/ mi mang de dza'i thub sa med/ ces 'jigs snang 'tshab 'tshub kyis tshig sna ra cadar bar dgra 'dul nas macad 228

ma'o kru'u zhi shi ba'i gtam bzang sgos pa na29kru'u zhis mi mang dmag dpung skor gyi gal che'i bka' snyadab la dma' 'bebs 'khyog bshad byas pa red/ ces nyin mang por chodags chung nang 'thab lcangad byas stabs 'jigs dngangs dka' sdug ma bzod par mthar kho pa tsho sa bshad pa ltar ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung rtsom la dma' 'bebs 'khyog bshad byas pa'i ma nyes kha g.yodag gi zhwa mo gyon dgos byung zhing /de 'dra ba'i gnas tshul spyi tsho gas kyi thog dang / btson khang gang sar byung yad/dgun dus slob sbyodang zer ba sogs las 'gul rim pa spel ba/ rgyun gtan bza' 'khor rer 'tsho ba'i skyon brjod zer ba dang zla gsum phyogs bsdoms zer ba/ zla drug phyogs bsdoms/ 'o/ 'kho ra phyogs bsdoms zer ba'i sdug thodag sdug brtsegs kyi gasna na btsir byed pa'i las 'gul rim pa lo ltar spel ba'i nang bo nga gsal bzhin dang thog rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi dus bab bzang po yod pa'i 'og btsan bakhrod log gsum dang / mnyam sbrel rgyal cho gas/ tā la'i ru snortags bcas la re ba bce la nas srid rnying bskyar 'o/ga yong thabs med/ mo dur khrod nas log srid kyi ma red/ de bas re stong dor nas 'thab rtsod kyi gra sgrig byed dgos/ rang skyon ngos len dang / gzhan skyon ther 'don/ mi ngan las ngan la ngo rgol 'thab rtsod kyi gra sgrig byed dgos/ rang skyon ngos len 229

2zha0 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/dang / gzhan skyon ther 'don/ mi ngan las ngan la ngo rgol 'thab rtsod/phan tshun lta lta ga skul 'ded dang byas rjes bzhag nas byas nyes sel dathodas pa/ byas rjes chen ngo bzhag na so/da zer ldan pa'i mdun lam yod tshul gyi dril bsgrags phru ba gso/ zer bar kha g.yar te skabs re 'jigs skul byed pa dang / skabs re bslu 'brid kyi byed thabs sna tsho gas bed spyod byas cadag bsam med 'ga' mgo 'kho ra te/ ngo phra gyur nas ngan pa chags pa'i tha shal ba'i mi nyung shas shig gis rang nyid la byas rjes dang / mdun lam yodang res nyams chung drang tshugs ldan pa'i rgyal gces pa rnams la log spyod langs phyogs mkhregs bzung byed mkhan dang / re dkrog rmongs gsum spel mkhan/ lha 'dre gangedzin bgegs zhes pa sogs nyes ming sna gas bkal nas kho nga chod mi ngan las ngan byed mir rtsis te ther 'dodan dang / 'thab rtsod byed pa'i sems shus/sa dang gsar brje'i hur brtson rang bzhin mchodan thabs byed mkhan mi ngan tha shal ba de tsho 'o/ 'khor phyogs bsdobs skabs byas rjes yod gras su bzhag nas bstod bsngags gzigs bzos dang / bka' chad chag yang dus bkag sngon spyodad 'aspro la gtong ba/ mdor na/ hūr brtson can la bstod bsngags dang rjes lus pa la ba3kyil ma/ nyes can rnams la khrims gcogen nam/ 1steg thogeg gi nyes chad gcod srol yod/230

ma'o kru'u zhi shi ba'i gtam bzang thos pa/ 331dza drag gi gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og dus rtag du sgyur bkod byed khul dang hur brtson gyi rnam pa thodan thabs ma byas par sdod thabs bral ba lta bu dang / de bzhin tang srid dang 'gal baḍi dkrog gtam dang / ngan smad/ 'phung dkrug rmongs dad kyi chos byed pa sogs btson khrims dang mi 'gal ba'i rig pa bsgrims nas sdod ma thub par phran bu 'gro nyes sdod nyes dang / shod nyes shor na phan tshun lta rtogs bskul 'ded zer ba'i dam bsgrags shin tu che zhing gdug rtsub che ba'i thabs ngan srid jus 'og sdod dgos stabs gciog gis gcig la zhed snang dang / ri dwags rmas ma lta bu rtag tu bag zan dang kha ma bral bar gnas dgas/skabs de'i spyi chogs gnas stangs ni deng sang lta bu'i gong 'og mthun sgril dam zab dang / dgra la mnyam sdang / gnod 'tshe phogs pa'i khyim tshang la lta skyong zer ba lta ci/ rgyal gces chos gces lhag bsam can la log spyod pa dang lha 'dre gdon bgegs/ gral rim dgra bo zer ba sogs nyes ming sna tshogs bkal nas kun gyis mthong chung ngan smad dang / sdug thog sdug rtseg gi rdung rdeg byed pa bcas ha cang ya nga ba'i mi yul gyi dmyal khams su gnas sku/da/231

bco brgyad/snyegong sa mtshog gi sku tshame bod dwa phemes pa dang / nga lhadngha sar meskyod rsha/979———984430bya phos skad gsang sgrog nyid gnam cadag gsal/ phyi myong 979lo'i nang nga tsho ri khug tu yod pa'i shing gcod las yul nas bzo grwar dgong mo zhig glog brnyan blta bar mi kha shas phyin/spyodag brnyan blta ba'i mi dza gas khrod du lha sa nas rlangs 'kho ra nang shing mdung ma len par skusnang mkhan nam rgyun phran bu ngo shes pa'i rlangs 'khor kha lo ba bod rigs shig yod pa des/lha sar rgya gar nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku tshab tshogs pa zhig phebs song ba dang / de'i khongs 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku mched sku ngo mkhan po blo bzang bsam gtan zhu mkhan zhig kyaX ༷dugakhong rnam pas gtsug lag khang

7gong sa mchog gi sku tshab bod du phebs pa dang / nga lha sar bskyod pa/ 233gi yang steng nas nga tsho da res 7rgyal ba rin po ches bod mi mang la sems gso 'tshams 'dri byed par btang gnang byung / 7rgyal ba rin po che sku khams gas la thang yin pas tshang ma thugs bde sngo ra bzhugs rogs zhes bka' stsodab gnang song bas/ lha sar sku da pa'i mi mang rnams nas sku tshab chodags par dga' bsu zhu mkhan mi khri stong mang sngo slebs nas spyi bde dmag gis bkag 'doms byed ma thub pa dang / de nyin pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas rgya mi'i bkag rgya sna snu gas gtor nas 'jigs snang med par dga' skyo gnyis kyi du 'bod byed mkhan ha las pa mang po byung song / zhes pa'i gtam bzang rma bya'i rna bar dbyar rnga'i sgra thos pa ltar byung skabs/ dang thog yid mi ches shing / de rjes dngos 'brel yin pa shes skabs dga' skyo gnyis kyi mig chu dbang med du shodar ba dang / glog brnyan lta bar yong mkhan slo mthun tshor phan tshun dga' spro'i mig zhag 'khor bzhin par gtam bzang shod res byas pa dang / de'i dgong mo ri khug las yul du yod pa'i las rogs slo mthun tshor ches snyan pa'i gtam bzang de skyel bar brel 'tshab byung /pho rog gi gshog pas nyi 'od bkag mi thub par brten sku tshab tshogs pa lha sar zhabs sor 'khe da pa'i gsar 'gyur rim bzhin ri khug tu yod pa'i mi dza sa shes rjes/ mi tshang mar sems 'gul shugs che thebs nas de sngon dmar po dang hur brtson rang bzhin yod pa'i las rogs de 233

234 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/tsho'ang dga' ba'i mig chu gtong / dus de nas bzung rgya dmar gyi log spyod rdzigs nyams shugs che chag pa dang / nga tshor bden spobs skyes shing /las yul du dza drag gis ngal rtsol skul 'ded nam rgyun ltar byed mkhan med par gyur/ phan tshun lta rtog skyon brdzod byed mkhan med pa dang /gnya' gnon gyi khur po ha cang yang du song / ru khag phan tshun du yod pa'i slo mthun tsho'i sar bskyod kyang bkag 'doms dang mthong chung byed mkhan med pa/ masnga ra na nam rgyun rngam zil che ba'i rgya mi'i ba3rtan khang dang las khungs de tsho thal ba 'tshub 'tshub chags nas 'jigs snang med par gyur ste dmyal ba'i ngal gso chen po zhig byung zhing / mi tshang ma'i gshis spyod legs 'jam du gyur ba dang ri klung gang sar dro skyid kyi dpal yon bzhad pa lta bu'i tshor snang byung ba ma zad/ yang bskyar ma 'ongs mdun lam la re ba gsar pa zhig byung /phyi lo 1980 lor nga tsho chab srid kyi nyes can zer ba rnams khe gtsang bachod grwar tshogs chen bskong dza gas thog thang kan sis gtam bshad byas te/ phyi 'o/ 1959 'o/ra twa las gtso bo byas pa'i bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug nang zhugs pa'i nyes can tshor rgyun ring tang gis slob gso dang sgyur 'god gnang 'og khyod chod tshang mar tshad mi 'dra ba'i grub 'bras thob yod par brten/ de ring nas bzung dgra dang rang phyogs bar 234

7gong sa mdzadag gi sku tshab bod du phebs pa dang / nga lha sar bskyod pa/ 235gyi 'gal bar 'gyur ldog byung ste nga tsho blo mthun zhig tu gyur pa dang/khyod cho krung dwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi spyi 'bangs shig tu gyur te/ spyi 'bangs kyi dro skyid 'alto bar longs spyod byed pa'i 'gro lam du gom pa dang po spo thub pa byung bar/ nga chodas dga' bsu zhu rgyu yin zhes pa'i krung dbyang gi yig cha zer ba khyab bsgrags byas rjes spyi 'bangs kyi lag khyer zer ba'i nang du nyes can sgyur bkod byas te/ spyi 'bangs su 'aglur ba zer ba'i dmar tham 'khod pa'i shog lhe chung ngu re sprad/ de nas bzung nga tsho mi'i gras su tshud pa zhig dang / mi yul gyi dmyal khams nas skyob pa'i gnas tshul 'di lta bu nga tsho'i sa gnas 'di gcig pu ma yin par/ bod kyi rgya khyab bce na khang phyi nang kun la gcig gyur rang dbang bde skyid kyi skya rengs shar thub pa byung ba ni/ bod nang sku tshab tshogs pa snga rjes zhabs sor 'kho da thub pa'i rlabs chen rgyal kha zhig dang /mabo na skyabs chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mdzarware thabs mkhas thugs rje'i lam sdudags kyi rlabs chen rgyal kha zhig kyang yin/lo der lo mang kha bral ba'i gces pa'i pha yul lha sar brtseba'i spun mched thug 'phrad du thabs shes sna chodags kyis thar tsam byung yang sdod khang sogs btsan 'phrog gzhung bzhes byas nas chags rten med pas/gcung mo rig pad lags kyi khyim du bsdad/ 'byor med gral rim gyi 235

23snyo nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ /srid dbang sger 'dzin zer ba'i 'og gral rim dgra bo dang / log spyod par rdung rdeb/ ces pa'i las dbang phran bu rdzogs pa dang / mabo na skyabs chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mchorware thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bkrin nyag gcig la rten nas las khungs su 'gro lha da rang mo sa kyi srid jus/ zhes pa krung dbyang gi yig cha gsar pa lnga na stabs kong po shing gcod las khungs nas las mi du ma so so'i pha yul du phyir lo ga/ btang ba'i ming tho'i kho ngas phran yang thon/ za 'gra them thod dang btson khang nas las mir thodan te lo ji tsam phyin yod pa lo rer rgya sgor 30 re sprod pa de dag len par kong por las khungs su bskyod/ skabs der dod slob sde tshan las khungs nas ka kor gang 'tshams byas te nyin shas ma sprad kyang rjes su za 'byu them the dang las mir lo 12 bsdad pa'i dngul 360 sprad pa dang / nyin shas kong por sdod ring las rogs phos sne len gang yong dang / 'gro khar shing dang sgam bzo byed kyi pang leb sogs mang po bskur/lha sar 'byedar rjes lha sa'i shar phyogs thal spungs sgang nyi gtad thug 'thag baphra grwa'i nang drung yig lta bu byas te lo gcig tsam bsdad/phyi 'o/ 1984 lo 'gor nyin gcig rgya gar nas spun bo gas chod bzang chos rgyal lags kyis yi ge zhig dang 'dra dpar gcig glo bur 'byedar ba'i nang / khyod rang 'tsho bzhugs yod pa'i gnas tshul thodas byung bar dga' 236

7go nga sa mdzadag gi sku tshab nge da du phebs pa dang / nga lha sar bskyod pa/ 237spro dpag med byung / gang mgyogs rgya gar la gnyen 'phrad du dgongs pa zhus te yong thabs byed dgos/ zhes 'kho da/ lo nyi shu lhag tsam phan tshun 'chi gson gyi gnas tshul go thos med pa'i grogs po'i phyag bris 'byor bar bsam yul las 'das pa'i dga' spro dpag med dang / lha sa spyi bde thing brgyud rgya gar nang gnyen 'phrad kyi dgongs pa zhus pa ltar/zla gnyis tsam nas gnyen 'phrad kyi lag 'khyer thob rjes spun nye tsho'i phya gru mnyam 'degs kyi lam 〈snan sogs rogs ram gnang 'og 'phags ༷/la rgya gar phyo gas su bskyod thub pa byung / nyin zhig lha sa shar phyogs nyi gtad u yon lhan khang gi hri krang nas khyodad rang chab gro sa khongs 'bo dgo sa/nyin zhig ming tho len par yong gi red/ ming tho nges par rgyag dgos/chab bo sa kho ngas tshud na ce da khang dang las ka sogs gang cir thob thang legs bcos sku nga gi red ces bshad byung / phran nas de dodan zhu yi yin thugs rje che zhes bshad pa yin//237
