dga' skyo gnyis 'dres ngang rgya gar du yong ba ngang / skal bzang bde skyid kyi nyin mo/ 2397rgyal ba rin po che zhal mjal rjes phran bu thugs phan/ gsos res sdod ces bka' phebs na/ sems thag gtsang bcad kyi bsdad de rang gis shes nus gang sku/da kyi zhabs 'degs hur thag zhu dgos/ log na dga' yi red ces bka' phebs na sems thag gtsang bcad kyis phyir log dgos/da ni 7rgyal ba rin po che'i thugs rje'i bkrin la rten nas bod du 'ang sdug po yong bzo mi 'dug skyid 'go tshugs yong gi 'dug ces pa sogs sda rjes su mngags bya mang po byas/ lha sa nas spyi spyod rlangs 'khor nang 'dzul rjes spun nye blo mthun tshos mig la mchi zhag 'khor bzhin sku gzugs la thugs lcag dang / nga dzartas mngags bya zhus pa rnams thugs la bzhag lhu gas gnang nga tsho mgyogs po mjal ba'i smon lam yod/ ces lag pa g.yug g.yug byed bzhin du rlangs 'khor bskyod de sge'u khung nas mar lta dus brtse ba'i spun nye blo mthun tsho rgyang thag ring du song skabs sems skyo po byung / de rjes nga tshos dga' gces 'os pa'i pho brang po twa la'i mdun du slebs skabs lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho pho brang 'dir myur du zhabs sor 'khod pa'i smon lam gdung shugs drag pos brgyab mur/ pho brang dang rgyang thag ji ring 'gro skabs sems gting nas skyo ba'i mig chu dbang med du shor byung /bal yul du 'byor rjes rang gzhung sne len khang nas sne len lam 239

24༷ nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/ston gnang 'og bal yul gyi rtsa che'i mchod rten bya rung kha shor dang / stag re/ 'u/sa sbyin sogs gnas sa khag tu gnas skor chod yid tshims pa byung rjes rgya gar ldi li brgyud ra je pur/ lo nyi shu tsam kha bral ba'i chung grogs chod bzang lags dang khong gi sku zla shi log lags/ kho nga gnyis kyi bu phrug bcas mjal bar dga' po byung / de gar nyin shas sdod ring sud sir gnas bzhugs skra da gzhung gi gzhung zhabs bgres yol gnang ba'i pha lha mgron gnyer thub bstan 'od ldan mchog dang / sku srung mda' zur rdo rje dbang phyug mchog sras sku 'jigs dpal lags bcas lhan rgyas kyi mtshan thog phyag bris shig phul ba'i nang / gus pha lha phyag malnga da spel gong ba'i bu blo bzang yon tan nye ba'i 'o/ shas nang 7gong sa 7skyabs mgo na chen po'i thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bkrin la rten nas/ ngo da nang rgya dmar nas srid jus phran bu lhag gtong dang / gzhis byes gnyen 'phrad 'bo 'ong byed pa'i go skabs bed spyod kyis rgya gar 'phags yul tu bde 'gyor thub/ sku ngo rnams pa sku khams gsal bzhugs yod par dga' spro'i 'tshams zhu dang bkra shis bde legs zhu rgyu yin/ phran phra da nang lha da skabs bod nas sud sir gnyen 'phrad du phebs pa'i sku mched phyir log phebs mi'i mdun/ sku ngo rnams pas nga'i byams brtse'i pā lags dam pa'i bde sdug dang nga sa spel gong bu phrug tsho'i bde sdug gnas stangs 240

dga' skyo gnyis 'dres ngang rgya gar du yong ba dang / skal bzang bde skyid kyi nyin mo/ 241la/ thugs 'khur bka' rtsad kyis gdung sems mnyam skyed gnang ba dang 'brel/ sku ngo chen mo mchog nas thugs brtse chen pos spel gong bu phrug tshor ngas 'tshams 'dri yod/ nga hrū mgyogs po thug pa'i re ba yod/ ces phebs pa'i thog nas dus gnas gnam sa mgo rting log pa lta bu'i 'gyur ba phyin/ yang / nga mo dpon 'bangs dbar gyi rtsa don yod pa'i mdza' ga/cugs 'brel bar nyams chags ma byung ba ni/ rin thang ldan pa zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin zhu yi yod/ slad sku 'tshor 'gal spong 'phrod bzhes thog 'di phyogs blo bde'i phyag bris dang / thugs brtse'i bka' slob chu rgyun bzhin yong re yod/ ces sogs 'khod/de rjes 7gong sa mchog gi mjal zhu dang sbrags sku ngo malha na mnyer chen mo dang / sku srung mda' zur/ sras sku 'jigs dpal lags gtan zhal bcas sud si nas rgya gar du phebs skabs gdan zhus ltar ra je pur gnas bzhugs bka' zur kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyi bzhugs shag tu bzhugs 'dug cing / de skabs gus rang bod gzhung sdi li sa gnas bod nas gsar 'byedar bar sne len las 'khur zhabs 'degs zhu bzhin yod/ nyin zhig ldi li sku tshab don gcod nas phran la zhal par zhig phebs 'gyor nang pha lha sku ngo mahron gnyer chen mo ra je pur kun gling gzim shag tu phebs yod pas/ der khyed rang mjal 241

242 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/'phrad du 'phral mar phebs dgos gsung pa ltar/ ra je pur lam 'phral bskyosdo nas sku ngo rnams pa ngo mjal byung ma thag rten 'brel mtshon ched kyi mjal dar a she re sgron pa dang / stong min bsam pa'i mtshon byed phyag rtags phran bu 'bul lam zhus/sku ngo mabo na gnyer chen mo mchog nas pā lags rgya nag tu rgya mi'i mnar gcod 'og ltogs shi thebs lugs kyi gnas tshul go thos byung bas/ don dngos de ltar yin min skor bka' 'dri gnang / de ltar yin lugs gnas tshul skor zhu skabs a tsi nga'i phyag mdzod snying rje/zhes gsungs nas thugs skyo snang tshad med kyis zhal mdangs dmar por gyur te spyan chab bsil grabs gnang / bod nas sud sir gnyen 'phrad kyis phyir log phebs mi rnams nas gsungs don/ sku ngo mgron gnyer chen mos bod nang gi gnas stangs dang rgya mis wa da mir mnar gce da gto/nga stangs kyi lo rgyus bka' 'dri yang yang gnang ba rnams dngos yod lan 'debs zhu skabs/ sku rlung 'phar nas snyun gzhi je sdug 'gro yi yod pa'i gnas tshul go thos byung stabs phran nas sku phyar bsam shes kyi bod nang gyi gnas stangs dang pā lags kyi skyo gnas stodar zhu chodad byas/ sku ngo mgron gnyer chen mos da res khyod rang rgya gar du sleb 'byor thub par dga' po byung / khyod rang 'di gar sdod rtsis yod/ yang na bod 242

dga' skyo gnyis 'dres ngang rgya gar du yong ba dang / skal bzang bde skyid kyi nyin mo/ 243nang phyir log bya rtsis yod/ bka' 'dri gnang bar/ phran la nye lam 7gong sa mchog gi gzim chung mjal kha snga rjes thengs gnyis stsal thob byung skabs/ 7gong sa mchodag nas phran 'gro sdod skor bka' brtsad bskyangs par phran nas 7bo nga sa mchog gi bka' bzhin zhu yi yin/ zhes 7snyan seng zhu skabs/ ngas byas na bsdad tshe yag po 'dug ces bka' phebs pa ltar cadad rgyur sems thag bcad pa yin zhes zhu skabs/ sku ngo mgron gnyer chen mo mchog thugs dgyes po byung nas de sngon sud sir nga tshor btang ba'i yi ge de rang gi bris pa yin nam/ zhes bka' 'dri bskyangs par/ ngas bris pa yin zhu skabs/ bod yig 'don dag gzugs gsum 'grig nges 'dug pas gzhung zhabs zhu chog red 'dug gzhung zhabs zhu thub na 'di phyi gnyis yod red/ hūr thag byed a'/ zhes thugs brtse chen pos bka' slob gnang ba dang / phyag btags dang lag dngul yang gsol ras gnang / rjes su nga tsho phan tshun 'brel ba byed dgos/dasku sa mkho gang yod yi ge gtang na nga dza sa dam don byas yong zhes bka' phebs byung ba dang / de gar sku ngo rnam pa lhan rgyas dang nyin shas sdod pa'i go skabs thob par dga' po byung /phyi lo 1984 zla 6 tshes 20 nyin dpal ldan sku sger yig tshang nas bde srung yan lag brgyud phran de ring mjal khar yong 243

244 nga'i mi tshe dmyal me'i nang btso sbyang byung ba/dgos kyi brda lan phebs 'gyor ltar/ pho brang du bskyod par pho brang gzim chung gi snye len khang du gsol ja dang bzhes 'bras gnang snye sne len mdzad/ de nas nga cho sa nyin mtshan kun tu tshad med dran zhing myur du mjal ba'i rtag tu smon 'dun zhu ba'i mgon skyabs chen lnga 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gser zhal mjal ba dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi thos pa'i dmigs bsal skal bzang go skabs snga rjes thengs gnyis thodab pa'i thodag rang sger gyi bde sdug zhu rgyu sdug yus zhus pa lta bur 'gro rgyur snyam nas bod nang gi spyi'i gnas stangs dang / slo mthun chodas 7snyan seng zhu mngags byung ba rnams 'tshems med zhu thub pa byung zhing / de rjes 7gong sa mchog nas bod nang 'gro sdod skor bka' 'dri stsal bar phran nas 7gong sa mchog gi bka' ji gnang la brtsi srung zhu gi yin zhes snyan seng zhus par 7gong sa mdzadag nas ngas byas na bsdad na yag po 'dug ces bka' phebs pa ltar/ sdod rgyur sems thag bcad de bod gzhung bde srung las khungs kyi bka' 'brel ltar phyi 'o/ 1985 lor ldi li sne len khang du bod nas gsar 'byedar chodar sne len zhabs zhur bskyod pa nas bzung / bod gzhung gi zhabs 'degs rang nus gang yod ngo lkog med par lhag bsam hur skyed zhu rim nang / yul dus kyi dbang gis dbyin ji'i skad yig ma shes pa'i dka' ngal sna dza gas 'phrad skabs/ skabs 'gar ngo da nas 244

dga' skyo gnyis 'dres ngang rgya gar du yong ba dang / skal bzang bde skyid kyi nyin mo / 245slebs ma thag snyadab grwa zhig tu dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong byed rgyu'i go skabs zhu len ma thub par de ma thag las kar bzhugs pa ni/ lkugs pa'i sems shugs lta bu byas 'dug snyam nas blo 'gyod che yang / gzhi rtsa'i rang gis lo rgyus la phyi mig lta dus/ mi yi dad mo sa brtan po de//dmyal ba'i nang du btso sbyang byas// 'od snang rin chen gser bzhin gsal// rin chen gser la 'gyur ba med// ces pa ltar/'das pa'i lo 46 tsam dang lhag par 'o/ 20 lhag tsam nang rgya dmar btsan 'dzul pa'i g.yo sgyu dang / gdug rtsub che ba'i 'jigs bskul bslu 'brid/ rno ngar dza drag dang dka' nyen che ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi char rlung drag po'i nang kha phyogs ma sna ra bar/ rtsa don mtha' 'khyongs thub ste yul dus gang zhig dang skye bo mchog dman su zhig gi mdun du'ang ngo gnong ma dgos par chos srid kyis 'tsho bar dga' spro dang / lha bas sems kyi khengs pa'i ngang 'o/ngas spyod thub pa'i grub 'bras dang rgyal kha ni ga༄ḍa che rigs gsusla gcig bsdus/ 7rgyal mchog phyag na padmo bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'e yang dag lam phyogs kyi 'khrid lha na la brten nas thodab pa zhig dang / yang sgos rang nyid kyi brtse ba'i pha ma spun mched 'das gson tsho dang / bzang po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ mdza' brtse ldan pa'i mkhyen ldan 'thab grogs tshos mtsho na/ drang bden gtso bzung byed 245
